title: Project & Operations Associate
description:
We are an early\-stage healthcare\-technology venture building digital products in partnership with a hospital. We’re hiring a versatile, hands\-on **Project \& Operations Associate** to be based on\-site and act as our eyes, ears and hands on the ground — coordinating between the doctors, the hospital’s local IT team, and our remote product and engineering team.

This is a **generalist role that will grow with the company.** In a given week you might be gathering requirements from doctors, coordinating a rollout, troubleshooting a tech issue, testing a new app feature, or documenting a process. We’re looking for someone smart, reliable and eager to learn — the mix of work and your responsibilities will expand as the venture scales. If you want a ground\-floor role with real ownership and fast growth, this is for you.

What you’ll do

* Act as the single point of contact between the doctors, hospital staff, local IT team, and our remote team — coordinate, schedule and follow up so everyone stays aligned.
* Understand what the doctors and staff need, capture those requirements clearly, and relay them to our product/engineering team (business\-analyst work).
* Track tasks, timelines and open issues; keep deployments and trials on schedule; report progress and blockers to the founding team (project coordination).
* Handle first\-line IT troubleshooting — networking/Wi\-Fi, devices, app logins, payments, and general PC/mobile issues — fixing what you can and escalating the rest with clear notes.
* Test new versions of our apps and report bugs with clear steps and screenshots.
* Maintain simple logs, checklists and inventories so processes stay repeatable.
* Take on new responsibilities as the venture and product portfolio grow.

What we’re looking for

* 0–2 years of experience. **Freshers with the right attitude are welcome.**
* Comfortable with technology and quick to learn new tools; general troubleshooting ability is a strong plus.
* Excellent communication and coordination skills — able to talk confidently to senior doctors and to engineers, and stay calm and organized under pressure.
* Proactive, reliable and adaptable — happy to wear many hats in an evolving, early\-stage environment.
* Strong at organizing and following up — someone who closes loops without being reminded.
* Fluent in Tamil and comfortable with basic English.
* Based in or willing to relocate to Namakkal

Good to have (not mandatory)

* Any exposure to project coordination, requirement\-gathering, business analysis, or IT support.
* Experience in a hospital, clinical, or startup setting.
* Comfort with spreadsheets, documents, and app/software testing.
* Own transport to reach the workplace.

What you’ll get

* A ground\-floor role in an early healthcare\-tech venture with direct mentorship from the founders.
* A rare chance to grow quickly into a broader operations/product/technology role as we scale.
* Training and full support provided.

**Job Type:** Full\-time

**Pay:** ₹20,000–₹25,000 per month

**Experience:** Freshers and up to 2 years welcome

About Dashrath Putra Foundation

**Dashrath Putra Foundation** is a social\-impact organisation committed to **sewa, compassion and meaningful action**.

Our work focuses on creating a better society through initiatives supporting **street animals, community welfare and humanitarian causes**.

Behind every rescue, treatment, feeding drive and welfare initiative is a team of people who make it possible. We are now looking for passionate and result\-oriented **Fundraising Executives** to become an important part of that team.

* Telesales

* Customer Relationship Management
* Field Sales
* Direct Sales
* Fundraising

* Hospitality

If you have **good communication skills, confidence and the ability to build trust**, you can succeed in this role.

More importantly, we want to understand:

**What brings you to the social sector?**

If you want to use your professional skills to contribute to something beyond a conventional sales job, this could be the right opportunity for you.

Freshers Can Apply

Freshers with good communication skills and the right attitude are welcome.

Training and guidance will be provided to help you understand our campaigns, communication process and fundraising approach.

Who Will Do Well In This Role?

This role can be particularly suitable for someone who:

**✔ Enjoys talking to people**  
**✔ Can confidently explain and represent a cause**  
**✔ Is comfortable with targets**  
**✔ Doesn't give up easily after rejection**

Build Valuable Skills

Develop practical experience in fundraising, sales, communication, donor relations, outreach and relationship management.

Be Part of a Mission\-Driven Team

Work alongside people who believe that **sewa is not just a word—it is responsibility followed by action.**

We are looking for someone who can **communicate a cause, build trust and inspire people to participate in it.**

title: Transcription QA Specialist ( transcription & captioning)
description:
**About The Opportunity**
 A fast\-paced, innovation\-driven company in the AI\-enabled media \& accessibility tech space, we specialize in high\-accuracy speech\-to\-text solutions for global broadcast, edtech, and enterprise content platforms. We’re building next\-gen transcription and captioning workflows powered by cutting\-edge ASR systems—where precision, speed, and linguistic nuance meet at scale. Remote\-first, globally distributed, and obsessed with quality, we’re looking for detail\-oriented QA minds to ensure every word we deliver is clean, accurate, and contextually perfect.
   

  

**Role \& Responsibilities**
* Perform end\-to\-end quality assurance on ASR\-generated transcripts and timed captions across multiple languages and dialects.
* Identify and document transcription errors—omissions, misrecognitions, punctuation, speaker labeling, and timing drift.
* Annotate, tag, and flag low\-confidence segments for model retraining or human intervention.
* Collaborate with engineering and linguistics teams to refine ASR performance based on QA feedback loops.
* Maintain QA scorecards and KPI dashboards to track accuracy, turnaround time, and client\-specific thresholds.
* Contribute to QA playbook development—defining edge cases, style guides, and domain\-specific rules (legal, medical, technical).


**Skills \& Qualifications**
**Must\-Have**
* ASR QA
* Transcription Quality Assurance
* Speech\-to\-Text Validation
* Timecode Alignment
* Audio\-Text Synchronization
* Microsoft Excel (for QA reporting)
* Google Docs / Sheets (for collaborative annotation)
* Basic familiarity with media players (VLC, QuickTime, Auphonic)


**Preferred**
* Experience with Captioning Standards (CEA\-608/708, SMPTE\-TT)
* Linguistic or NLP background (especially phonetics or dialect mapping)
* Familiarity with ASR platforms (Whisper, Google Speech\-to\-Text, Azure Speech)


**Benefits \& Culture Highlights**
* 100% remote with flexible hours—work from anywhere in India.
* Impact\-driven culture: Your QA work directly improves AI model accuracy for millions of users.
* Opportunities to grow into ASR training, linguistics, or product roles within the AI media stack.

* Welcome and assist patients and visitors professionally.
* Register new patients and update existing patient information.
* Schedule, reschedule, and cancel appointments.
* Manage telephone calls, emails, and patient inquiries.
* Maintain accurate and confidential patient records.
* Verify patient details, identification, and insurance information where applicable.
* Coordinate appointments with doctors, nurses, laboratories, and other departments.
* Inform patients about appointment timings, required documents, and clinic procedures.
* Manage the reception area and patient waiting list.
* Prepare and maintain medical and administrative documents.
* Handle billing, receipts, payments, and basic insurance\-related paperwork.
* Maintain daily appointment schedules and doctor availability.
* Follow patient privacy and confidentiality requirements.
* Assist patients with directions and general information about hospital/clinic services.
* Coordinate laboratory reports, prescriptions, referrals, and other documents as directed.
* Maintain office supplies and report shortages to management.
* Handle complaints politely and escalate medical or administrative issues when necessary.
* Perform data entry and maintain electronic or paper\-based records.
* Follow clinic/hospital policies, infection\-control procedures, and workplace safety requirements.

Required Skills

* Good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Professional and friendly personality.
* Basic computer knowledge.
* Knowledge of MS Word, Excel, email, and appointment\-management systems.
* Good telephone etiquette.
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills.
* Ability to multitask in a busy healthcare environment.
* Attention to detail.
* Ability to maintain patient confidentiality.
* Problem\-solving and customer\-service skills.
* Ability to work effectively with doctors, nurses, patients, and administrative staff.

Educational Qualification

Typically:

* **12th pass** or equivalent for entry\-level positions.
* Diploma/certificate in **Medical Reception, Hospital Administration, Healthcare Administration, or a related field** is advantageous.
* Graduate degree in healthcare/hospital administration can be preferred for larger hospitals.

Experience

* Freshers may be considered for entry\-level positions.
* **1–3 years of experience** in a clinic, hospital, diagnostic centre, or healthcare reception is commonly preferred.
* Experience with hospital/clinic management software is an advantage.

Languages

Depending on the workplace, proficiency in:

* English
* Hindi
* Local/regional language

is useful, particularly for patient communication.

Typical Daily Duties

**Morning**

* Open and prepare the reception area.
* Check the day's doctor schedules and appointments.
* Review patient bookings and pending follow\-ups.
* Prepare registration and appointment information.

**During the day**

* Register arriving patients.
* Answer calls and respond to inquiries.
* Schedule appointments.
* Coordinate patient flow with medical staff.
* Handle billing/payment\-related tasks.
* Update patient records.
* Manage waiting lists and cancellations.

**End of day**

* Reconcile payments and receipts.
* Check appointment records.
* Complete pending documentation.
* Prepare reports if required.
* Secure patient records and reception documents.

Important Qualities

A good Medical Receptionist should be **calm, polite, organized, patient, trustworthy, accurate, and comfortable dealing with people**, especially when patients or family members are stressed or upset.

**Important:** A Medical Receptionist generally performs **administrative and patient\-service duties, not diagnosis or medical treatment**. Any clinical question or medical emergency should be directed to the appropriate healthcare professional.

* Familiarity with composite materials and lightweight structural design.
* Knowledge of MIL\-STD environmental or vibration requirements.
* Experience working in fast\-paced prototyping or product\-development environments.



  





**What We Offer** 



* Opportunity to work on advanced drone and Ground Control Station products.
* Hands\-on experience in designing, prototyping, testing, and manufacturing.
* End\-to\-end ownership of mechanical and structural subsystems.
* A multidisciplinary and fast\-paced engineering environment.

KEVOR is an electrical and power solutions company focused on servo voltage stabilizers and power protection solutions for industrial, commercial, and other critical applications.

We are building a growing business and looking for people who do not simply want to follow a sales routine—but want to take ownership of a market, build relationships, generate business, and grow with the company.

About the Role

This is a work\-from\-home and field\-based sales opportunity.

You will work from your home, coordinate with our CRM team where applicable, conduct your own cold calls, identify potential customers and distributors, and visit prospects when they are available for a meeting.

Your responsibility is not limited to making calls or visiting shops. You will be expected to develop prospects into genuine business opportunities and work toward converting them into customers.

The role is suitable for someone who understands that sales is about creating opportunities, building trust, following up consistently, and delivering results.

What You Will Do

* Generate prospects through cold calling, market research, CRM coordination, referrals, and your own network.
* Identify potential servo voltage stabilizer customers, dealers, distributors, and industrial buyers.
* Understand customer requirements and introduce KEVOR's products and solutions.
* Schedule and conduct field visits when prospects are available to meet.
* Build relationships with electrical dealers, distributors, industrial customers, and relevant business contacts.
* Follow up with prospects and work toward converting qualified leads into customers.
* Maintain regular communication and update the CRM or sales records.
* Develop your assigned market through consistent prospecting and relationship building.
* Take responsibility for your pipeline, activities, and business outcomes.

Who We Are Looking For

We are especially interested in people who have a power industry, electrical, industrial sales, servo stabilizer, or related background.

You should ideally:

* Understand what a servo voltage stabilizer is and where it is used.
* Have some understanding of servo stabilizer customers, dealers, distributors, or industrial applications.
* Be comfortable speaking with business owners, purchase managers, electrical contractors, and industrial decision\-makers.
* Have the confidence to make cold calls and initiate conversations.
* Be willing to visit customers when a genuine opportunity is available.
* Be self\-driven, consistent, and comfortable working independently.

Relevant industry knowledge is an advantage, but ownership, learning ability, and the willingness to create results matter most.

This is an opportunity to grow with a startup where your contribution can have a meaningful impact.

You may begin by working independently, generating prospects, and developing customers in your market. As the business grows and you demonstrate your ability to build business, there may be opportunities to take greater responsibility for a territory, region, or even an entire state.

The long\-term vision is not just to have salespeople in different states. It is to build capable business leaders who can eventually develop and lead their own teams.

Your current salary, designation, or lack of a large team should not be the only measure of your potential. If you have the ability and ambition to build a market, we want to hear from you.

What We Expect

This is an ownership\-oriented role, not a routine sales job.

You will be expected to:

* Take initiative instead of waiting for daily instructions.
* Build your own prospect pipeline.
* Understand your market and identify where opportunities exist.
* Follow through on commitments and follow\-ups.
* Be honest about your progress and challenges.
* Focus on quality opportunities, customer relationships, and actual business outcomes.

We understand that sales takes time and that not every prospect converts immediately. However, we are looking for people who take responsibility for the process and continuously work toward results.

Work Model

* Work Location: Work from home \+ field visits
* Hiring: Pan India
* Employment Type: Full\-time / Part\-time opportunities
* Travel: Customer visits as required
* Industry: Electrical / Power Solutions / Industrial Sales

Who Should Apply?

You may be a good fit if you are:

* An experienced electrical or power industry salesperson.
* A servo stabilizer sales professional looking for a bigger opportunity.
* A dealer/distributor network professional.
* An industrial sales executive who wants to build a territory.
* A fresher with strong communication, learning ability, and entrepreneurial ambition.
* A part\-time salesperson with relevant industry connections and the ability to generate business.

How to Apply

If you believe you can help KEVOR generate prospects, build customer relationships, and grow a market, we would like to hear from you.

Please share your resume and briefly tell us:

We are looking for people who want to grow with the company—not just work for the company.

Pay: ₹12,000\.00 \- ₹37,000\.00 per month

description:
**Description**
 Amazon Application Security is looking for a security\-focused Technical Program Manager who wants to make a difference and support Amazon builders to ensure that protecting customer data is at the forefront of all development.
   

  

 Our team approaches security challenges with empathy and curiosity to help Amazon builders identify areas of improvement and learn how to navigate the highly dynamic space of application security. Amazon Application Security focuses on enabling our builders to provide a secure and trustworthy experience to our customers without compromising the overall customer experience.
   

  

 In this role you will work directly with security teams and Amazon builders providing direct front line support and security expertise to Amazon teams.
   

  

 You’ll also find this role will routinely challenge your background in technical product ownership, process development, operational and management skills, project management, critical thinking, relationship\-building, and problem\-solving. You’ll also find yourself challenged in unique ways when operating at the massive scale of Amazon, unique to a select few corporations in the world. You must be self\-directed and open to new challenges, adept at prioritization, innovation, and collaborating with others.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Plan, organize, and manage all phases of the project lifecycle ensuring successful delivery. This includes defining success criteria, developing and managing project governance plans, project schedules, team goals, communication strategies and project milestones.
* Collaborate with internal customers (senior business leaders, development teams, application security engineering teams and other partner security teams) to understand their needs, their business and how we can improve their security posture.
* Architect and manage internal scope of work documents with the customer clearly defining success criteria and timelines. Hold all stakeholders accountable to these documents through the project lifecycle, escalating as necessary.
* Build and manage relationships with key internal stakeholders and security teams and while advocating on behalf of our customers to deliver on their security goals.
* Guide the evolution and adoption of internal security support solutions, at times with complex priorities, prioritizing the work most beneficial to Amazon builders.
* Use knowledge of software system design to scope architecture, review associated threat models, educate customers on potential severity of security findings and guide developer and security engineering teams through remediation.
* Define and implement best practice methods, processes, tools and continuous improvement initiatives aimed at scaling and increasing the efficiency of Amazon’s security guidance and builder support processes.
* Own the creation and delivery of business proposals (growth, new areas of focus, etc) and metrics to security leadership.
* Proactively identify and manage program risk, identifying paths to overcome risks, and escalating when necessary
* Work effectively and make sound decisions in a dynamic environment with changing priorities.
* Influence, negotiate, resolve conflicts and achieve results through others who are not direct reports.
* Foster a positive work environment leveraging existing skills in active listening, encouraging diverse perspectives and adapting to a variety of personality types.


**About The Team**
 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why Amazon Security
   

  

 At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.
   

  

 Mentorship and Career growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, training, and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of technical product or program management experience
* 3\+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
* Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
* 5\+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience working with security teams


 Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. At USP, we believe that scientific excellence is driven by a commitment to fairness, integrity, and global collaboration. This belief is embedded in our core value of Passion for Quality and is demonstrated through the contributions of more than 1,300 professionals across twenty global locations, working to strengthen the supply of safe, high\-quality medicines worldwide.
   

  

 At USP, we value inclusive scientific collaboration and recognize that attracting diverse expertise strengthens our ability to develop trusted public health standards. We foster an organizational culture that supports equitable access to mentorship, professional development, and leadership opportunities. Our partnerships, standards, and research reflect our belief that ensuring broad participation in scientific leadership results in stronger, more impactful outcomes for global health.USP is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer (EEOE) and is committed to ensuring fair, merit\-based selection processes that enable the best scientific minds—regardless of background—to contribute to advancing public health solutions worldwide. We provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities and uphold policies that create an inclusive and collaborative work environment.

**Project Coordinator – Language Specialist**
**German / French / Spanish / Japanese**
 Join Us and Make an Impact at the Forefront of Clinical Research Innovation
   

  

 We have successfully supported the world’s top 50 pharmaceutical companies and more than 750 biotech organizations, spanning 2,700 clinical trials across 100\+ countries over the last five years.

 **German, French, Spanish, or Japanese**

 This is an exciting opportunity to use your language skills in a global professional environment while supporting international clinical research projects and collaborating with teams and stakeholders across different countries.
   

  

**Language Requirement – A Key Part of This Role**
 We are specifically looking for candidates who are proficient in at least one of the following languages:
   

  

**German \| French \| Spanish \| Japanese**
 In addition, candidates should possess strong English written and verbal communication skills.
   

  

 Candidates with recognized language qualifications or
 **B2\-level proficiency or above (or equivalent)** 
 are preferred.
   

  

 Your language capabilities will complement your project coordination responsibilities and help you communicate effectively while working within a diverse, global environment.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a
 **Project Coordinator – Language Specialist** 
 , you will provide administrative and technical support to global project teams, independently planning, organizing, and coordinating assigned responsibilities.
   

  

 You will support initial study setup and ongoing study maintenance, maintain systems and database repositories, complete data entry, prepare reports, and collect data for analysis and review.
   

  

 You will also contribute to audit readiness, risk management, process improvement initiatives, and effective communication across project teams. Depending on your experience and assignment, you may act as a key point of contact for the Project Lead (PL) or Clinical Team Manager (CTM) and provide coordination support to junior Project Support Coordinators.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Coordinate, oversee, and complete assigned clinical trial activities in accordance with the applicable task matrix.
* Support the initial study setup and ongoing maintenance of study\-specific systems, tools, trackers, and documentation.
* Perform department, internal, country, and investigator file reviews as assigned, document findings, follow up on resolutions, and escalate issues when necessary.
* Ensure assigned activities are completed on time, within budget, and according to established quality standards.
* Support study\-specific documentation and maintain key trackers, including study team lists, project\-specific training requirements, system access management, and project\-level activity plans.
* Provide support for clinical trial systems such as CTMS, Oracle Activate, and eTMF, including access requests, study\-level document tracking, audit readiness, and follow\-up on non\-compliance.
* Coordinate and organize client and/or internal meetings, including scheduling, preparation and distribution of meeting minutes, and follow\-up on action items where required.
* Export and reconcile study metrics reports and, where applicable, analyze information and identify potential issues.
* Maintain vendor trackers and regularly review information for accuracy and completeness.
* Coordinate the compilation of Investigator Site File (ISF) templates and pharmacy binders under the guidance of the Clinical Team Manager.
* Participate in Kick\-Off and Project Launch meetings, take meeting notes when required, and support initial study setup.
* Identify potential project risks or issues in a timely manner and escalate them to the appropriate stakeholders.
* Contribute to functional and cross\-functional initiatives focused on process improvements and operational enhancements.
* Where applicable, support onboarding and training of new team members and provide coordination support to junior colleagues.


**Education \& Experience**
* High/Secondary School Diploma or equivalent, along with a relevant formal academic or vocational qualification.
* Technical positions may require an appropriate certificate.
* Previous experience providing the knowledge, skills, and abilities required to successfully perform the role.
* An equivalent combination of education, professional training, and directly related experience may also be considered.


**Language Skills**
**Required/Preferred Language Capability:**
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English, AND
* Proficiency in at least one of the following:
+ German
+ French
+ Spanish
+ Japanese

* B2 level or above, or equivalent professional proficiency, is preferred.
* Ability to communicate confidently and professionally with colleagues and stakeholders in a global environment.


**Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities**
* Strong organizational and coordination skills with excellent attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple activities efficiently and effectively.
* Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a global team.
* Strong customer focus and interpersonal skills.
* Excellent time\-management skills with the flexibility to reprioritize workload according to changing project requirements and timelines.
* Ability to analyze project\-specific data and systems to ensure accuracy and efficiency.
* Effective written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate professionally with project team members and stakeholders.
* Ability to develop and maintain working knowledge of applicable country regulations, where required, ICH Good Clinical Practice (GCP), and applicable organizational/client SOPs and working practice documents.
* Strong computer skills, including proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, and PowerPoint).
* Ability and willingness to learn relevant clinical trial systems and technologies.
* Good presentation skills.
* Ability to successfully complete required organizational training programs.
* Self\-motivated with a positive attitude and strong interpersonal skills.


**Working Conditions \& Environment**
* Work is primarily performed in an office or clinical environment with exposure to standard electrical office equipment.
* Occasional travel or visits to site locations may be required.


**Bring Your Language Skills To a Global Career**
 If you are a strong project coordinator who speaks German, French, Spanish, or Japanese and are interested in building your career in a global clinical research environment, we encourage you to apply.
   

  

 Bring your language expertise, coordination skills, attention to detail, and ability to collaborate across cultures to a role where you can contribute to clinical research projects with global impact.

* Risk assessments

* Embracing change and fostering a culture of inclusion
* Developing skills in process improvement and documentation administration

Contract Labour Management

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist – NGO / Social Impact | Pune
description:
**Find the People Who Will Help Change Lives.**

**What if recruitment wasn't just about filling positions?**

**At Lighthouse Communities Foundation, every person who joins our team contributes to creating better opportunities for young people from underserved communities.**

We are looking for a **Talent Acquisition Executive** who can own the recruitment journey end\-to\-end — from finding the right talent and conducting interviews to building a strong candidate experience and helping new team members begin their journey with Lighthouse.

If you're someone who enjoys connecting with people, spotting potential, building relationships, and wants your recruitment work to contribute to meaningful social impact, we'd love to hear from you.

About Lighthouse Communities Foundation

Lighthouse Communities Foundation works in the area of **skilling and livelihoods for underserved youth**, with a vision of enabling socio\-economic transformation.

Our Lighthouse model is built on a pioneering **Public\-Private Partnership (PPP)** approach that brings together:

**Government \+ Corporates \+ NGOs \+ Citizens \+ Communities**

The Government supports the Lighthouse centres through location and capital expenditure. Corporates contribute through CSR funding to support operational expenses, while NGOs and other partners contribute skilling and livelihood opportunities for young people.

With a strong presence across more than **400 of Pune's approximately 500 slum communities**, the Lighthouse program has expanded to **PCMC, Dombivali, Aurangabad, Delhi, Odisha, and Hyderabad**.

Our work is driven by four core values:

**Empathy \| Inclusion \| Integrity \| Courage**

About the Role

As a **Talent Acquisition Executive**, you will play a critical role in building the team that powers our mission.

You'll partner with hiring managers and internal teams to understand talent needs, source candidates, assess potential, coordinate interviews, support hiring decisions, and ensure a smooth onboarding experience.

You'll work across a range of roles and interact with candidates from diverse professional and social backgrounds.

The role requires someone who can balance:

**Speed \+ Quality \| Process \+ People \| Hiring Needs \+ Mission Fit**

We are looking for a recruiter who doesn't simply ask:

**"Can this person do the job?"**

But also asks:

**"Will this person connect with our mission, values, and the communities we serve?"**

**What You'll Do**

**Own Talent Acquisition End\-to\-End**

**Take ownership of the recruitment lifecycle for positions across the organization.**

**You will**:

* Understand hiring requirements from managers and teams.
* Clarify role expectations, competencies, and candidate profiles.
* Develop appropriate sourcing strategies for different roles.
* Source and engage potential candidates.
* Screen applications and shortlist relevant profiles.
* Conduct initial phone/video screenings and interviews.
* Coordinate interviews with hiring managers and interview panels.
* Track candidates throughout the recruitment process.
* Follow up with candidates and internal stakeholders.
* Support offer discussions and closure.
* Ensure positions are filled within agreed timelines while maintaining hiring quality.

**Job Posting \& Candidate Sourcing**

**Think beyond simply posting a vacancy.**

**You will:**

* Post job openings across relevant job portals and platforms.
* Leverage social media and professional networks for sourcing.
* Explore NGO and social\-sector specific recruitment networks.

* Experiment with different approaches to attract quality talent.

**Screening \& Interviewing**

**You will:**

* Conduct initial phone screenings.
* Evaluate candidates against role requirements.
* Assess relevant experience, skills, communication, and motivation.
* Understand candidates' career aspirations and expectations.
* Assess alignment with Lighthouse's values and mission.
* Share structured feedback with hiring managers.
* Help ensure a fair, consistent, and candidate\-friendly selection process.

We believe recruitment should be about **understanding potential, not just matching keywords on a CV.**

**Create a Great Candidate Experience**

**Every interaction with a candidate shapes how they see the organisation.**

**You will:**

* Communicate clearly and professionally with candidates.
* Keep candidates informed about interview stages and timelines.
* Respond to candidate queries.
* Ensure a respectful and inclusive recruitment experience.
* Maintain professionalism even when candidates are not selected.
* Build positive relationships with potential future candidates.

Because even when someone doesn't join us today, **they should leave the process with a positive impression of Lighthouse.**

**Support Onboarding**

**Your responsibility doesn't end when a candidate accepts an offer.**

**You will:**

* Support the onboarding process for new hires.
* Coordinate with relevant teams to ensure joining formalities are completed.
* Help new employees understand the organisation and their next steps.
* Ensure new team members feel welcomed and supported.

**You will:**

* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date recruitment records.
* Track candidate pipelines and hiring status.
* Update recruitment systems and trackers.
* Maintain candidate information systematically.
* Support recruitment reporting and hiring dashboards.
* Ensure appropriate handling of candidate information.
* Follow data privacy and confidentiality practices.

You should be comfortable working with recruitment data and using it to identify bottlenecks and improve hiring effectiveness.

**Champion Diversity \& Inclusion**

**Lighthouse works with diverse communities — and our teams should reflect that diversity.**

**You will:**

* Promote fairness and inclusion throughout the recruitment process.
* Proactively explore diverse talent pools.
* Encourage applications from candidates with different backgrounds and perspectives.
* Help reduce unconscious bias in the hiring process.
* Ensure candidates are evaluated fairly against role requirements and organisational values.

**Build the Lighthouse Employer Brand**

**Help candidates understand why Lighthouse is a place worth joining.**

**You will:**

* Communicate the LCF mission, values, culture, and impact through recruitment.
* Support recruitment campaigns and employer\-branding initiatives.
* Create compelling job\-posting and candidate communication approaches.
* Highlight the opportunities for learning, growth, and social impact at Lighthouse.

**We want candidates to understand not just what the job is, but why the work matters.**

**Organisation \& Execution**

**People \& Relationship Building**

* Ability to build trust and positive relationships.
* Empathy and active listening.

**You'll Thrive in This Role If You Are...**

title: HR Business Partner – People & Culture | Hyderabad
description:
**People Are at the Heart of Impact.**

**At Lighthouse Communities Foundation, our work is about creating opportunities for young people.**

**But sustainable impact doesn't happen without the people behind it.**

Great Centre Heads.  
Committed facilitators.  
Passionate outreach teams.  
Strong program leaders.  
People who show up every day because they believe the work matters.

**We're looking for an HR Business Partner who can help these people thrive.**

This is a hands\-on, field\-facing HR role where you'll work closely with leaders and teams across Hyderabad, understand what is happening on the ground, solve people challenges, strengthen HR practices, and help build a culture where employees can do their best work.

If you see HR as more than policies and processes — and believe that **strong people practices create stronger social impact** — this could be your opportunity.

**About Lighthouse Communities Foundation**

**Lighthouse Communities Foundation (LCF)** works in the areas of skilling, employability, and livelihoods for underserved youth.

Our Lighthouse model brings together **Government, Corporates, NGOs, and Communities** through a Public\-Private Partnership to create sustainable pathways towards employment and socio\-economic transformation.

Our centres are built around collaboration — with different stakeholders contributing resources, expertise, networks, and capabilities to help young people access better opportunities.

**Our work is guided by:**

**Empathy \| Inclusion \| Integrity \| Courage**

**Your Role: Be the Bridge Between People \& Purpose**

As an HR Business Partner, you'll partner with regional leadership, Centre Heads, program teams, and employees to make sure our people practices support both **employee experience and organisational outcomes**.

You'll work across:

**Hiring → Onboarding → Development → Performance → Employee Relations → Culture → Organisational Growth**

And because our teams work across centres and communities, this is a **field\-facing HR role**.

You won't just hear about people challenges in meetings.

**You'll go where the teams are. Listen. Understand. Solve. Build.**

**What You Will Do**

**Partner With Leaders \& Teams**

* Act as the primary HR point of contact for employees and managers across the assigned region.
* Partner with Centre Heads and program leaders on people\-related matters.
* Understand team dynamics, people challenges, and organisational needs.
* Provide practical HR guidance to managers and employees.
* Coach leaders on people management and employee\-related issues.
* Ensure HR support is timely, accessible, and solution\-oriented.

**Build Teams That Can Deliver Impact**

**Great programs need great people.**

**You'll support the complete employee journey, including:**

* Recruitment coordination.
* Candidate screening.
* Interview processes.
* Offer and joining coordination.
* Employee onboarding.
* New\-hire orientation.
* Early\-stage employee support.

**You'll work closely with hiring managers and central HR to ensure we bring in people who are not only capable, but also aligned with our values and mission.**

**Help People Grow**

* Partner with central HR teams to implement learning and development initiatives.
* Identify capability\-building needs across teams.
* Support training and development programs.
* Encourage a culture of continuous learning.
* Work with managers to identify development opportunities for their teams.

**Make Performance Management Meaningful**

**Performance management should be more than an annual form.**

**You'll support managers and employees with:**

* Goal setting.
* Performance reviews.
* Development planning.
* Regular feedback.
* Performance conversations.
* Capability\-building interventions.
* Performance improvement processes where required.

**The goal is to create clarity, accountability, and growth — while ensuring performance practices are fair and aligned with organisational expectations.**

**Support Employee Relations**

* Serve as a trusted HR partner for employees and managers.
* Listen to employee concerns and help identify appropriate solutions.
* Support resolution of workplace issues in a fair and timely manner.
* Help managers navigate sensitive people situations.
* Promote a positive, respectful, and inclusive work environment.
* Ensure organisational policies and processes are understood and followed.

**Strengthen HR Practices Across Centres**

**Our teams work across different centres and communities.**

**You'll help ensure consistency while remaining sensitive to local realities.**

**This includes:**

* Implementing HR policies and processes.
* Supporting compliance requirements.
* Ensuring employees understand relevant policies.
* Identifying gaps in HR processes.
* Working with central HR to improve employee experience.
* Ensuring HR practices are aligned with organisational goals, values, and requirements.

**Use Data to Understand People**

**Good HR decisions need more than intuition.**

**You'll:**

* Monitor HR metrics and trends.
* Track hiring, onboarding, retention, performance, and other relevant people indicators.
* Identify patterns and areas requiring attention.
* Generate insights for leadership.
* Recommend practical solutions to improve HR effectiveness.

The question isn't just:

**“What is the number?”**

It's:

**“What is the number telling us about our people?”**

Be Present Where the Work Happens

This role involves **up to 70% travel across centres in the assigned region**.

**You'll spend significant time with teams on the ground, building relationships, understanding local realities, and providing hands\-on HR support.**

**If you're someone who enjoys being close to the action rather than spending every day behind a desk, you'll enjoy this role.**

**Who Are We Looking For?**

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in **Human Resources, Business Administration**, or a related field.
* Master's degree is preferred.

Experience

* **3–4 years of HR experience**.
* Experience in areas such as:
* Talent acquisition
* Employee relations
* Performance management
* Learning \& development
* People management
* Organisational development

**Experience in a nonprofit, social\-impact, education, skilling, or field\-based organisation is an advantage.**

**Communication**

* Excellent communication skills in **English and Hindi**.
* Strong interpersonal and relationship\-building abilities.
* Ability to communicate effectively with employees across different roles and backgrounds.
* Strong listening, facilitation, and problem\-solving skills.

**You'll Thrive in This Role If...**

**You're someone who:**

* Sees HR as a business and people partner — not just a process owner.
* Is comfortable having difficult conversations with empathy and clarity.
* Can coach a manager through a people problem rather than simply quoting policy.
* Enjoys meeting people where they work.
* Can move comfortably between strategic conversations and operational problem\-solving.
* Is curious about what is happening on the ground.
* Can work with people from very different backgrounds and roles.
* Is comfortable with ambiguity and changing priorities.
* Can work independently and take ownership.
* Believes that inclusion is something you **build into everyday decisions**, not just something you write in a policy.
* Is genuinely motivated by the idea that better people practices can lead to better outcomes for young people.

**What Success Looks Like**

**In this role, success isn't simply:**

**“HR processes were completed.”**

It's when:

* The right people are hired at the right time.
* New employees feel welcomed and supported.
* Managers become stronger people leaders.
* Employees know what is expected of them.
* Performance conversations happen with clarity and fairness.
* Teams feel heard and supported.
* People challenges are addressed before they become organisational problems.
* Employees have opportunities to learn and grow.
* HR data helps leaders make better decisions.
* And ultimately, our teams are better equipped to create impact for young people.

**Why Join Lighthouse?**

**Build the People Behind the Impact**

**At Lighthouse, you'll get the opportunity to work at the intersection of:**

**People \+ Purpose \+ Field Operations \+ Organisational Development**

You'll work with diverse teams, engage with leaders across centres, and experience the realities of building people systems in a growing social\-impact organisation.

You'll also be part of an organisation where our values matter:

**Empathy \| Inclusion \| Integrity \| Courage**

Because creating opportunities for young people starts with creating an environment where the people doing the work can **learn, grow, contribute, and thrive.**

Ready to Build the People Behind the Mission?

If you're an HR professional who wants to move beyond transactional HR and become a genuine **people partner**, we'd love to hear from you.

description:
Job Description – Civil Engineer \| CAD \& Site

WorkPosition: Civil Engineer

Department: Engineering / Projects

Experience: 0–2 Years

Employment Type: Full\-Time

Location: Chinchwad

Reporting To: Project Manager / Senior Civil Engineer

**About the Role**

We are looking for a **Civil Engineer** with good technical knowledge and practical understanding of civil engineering activities. The candidate will be responsible for **CAD drafting, preparation and modification of drawings, site visits, measurements, project coordination, documentation, and providing technical support for ongoing projects**.

The role will involve a combination of **office\-based CAD/design work and field/site work**. The candidate should therefore be comfortable travelling to project sites, company locations, or client locations whenever required.

Freshers with good knowledge of **AutoCAD/CAD software**, basic civil engineering concepts, and a willingness to work on\-site may also apply.

Key Responsibilities1\. CAD \& Drawing Work

* Prepare, modify, and update **2D drawings using AutoCAD/CAD software**.
* Prepare civil engineering drawings based on project requirements and instructions from senior engineers.
* Read and interpret engineering drawings, layouts, plans, and technical specifications.
* Make necessary corrections and revisions to drawings as per project requirements.
* Assist in preparing **plans, elevations, sections, layouts, and detailed drawings**.
* Maintain proper records of drawings and ensure the latest revisions are used.
* Coordinate with senior engineers/design teams for drawing\-related requirements.
* Ensure drawings are prepared accurately and according to the required specifications.

2\. Site Visits \& Field Work

* Visit project sites/company locations as required for **measurements, inspections, coordination, and technical support**.
* Take site measurements and collect relevant technical information.
* Verify site conditions against drawings and project requirements.
* Coordinate with site supervisors, contractors, vendors, and other personnel.
* Monitor ongoing civil work and report observations to the reporting manager.
* Identify discrepancies between drawings and actual site conditions and communicate them to the concerned team.
* Assist senior engineers in resolving site\-related technical issues.
* Ensure that work is carried out according to approved drawings and instructions.

3\. Project Coordination

* Coordinate between the **office/design team and site team**.
* Assist in planning and execution of civil engineering activities.
* Follow up on project\-related requirements with internal teams, contractors, and vendors.
* Assist in ensuring timely completion of assigned project activities.
* Communicate project updates, site observations, and technical requirements to the reporting manager.
* Attend site/client meetings when required.

4\. Measurement \& Estimation Support

* Take and record measurements at project sites.
* Assist in preparing **quantity calculations, BOQs, material requirements, and estimates**.
* Check measurements and quantities against drawings and actual site conditions.
* Assist in preparing material requirement statements and project documentation.
* Maintain accurate records of measurements and project\-related data.

5\. Quality \& Safety

* Ensure civil work is carried out as per approved drawings, specifications, and quality requirements.
* Identify and report quality\-related issues observed at the site.
* Assist senior engineers in maintaining project quality standards.
* Follow company and site safety procedures during site visits.
* Ensure proper use of PPE and adherence to basic safety practices while working at project sites.

6\. Documentation \& Reporting

* Maintain project\-related drawings, documents, measurements, and records.
* Prepare daily/weekly site reports as required.
* Maintain records of drawing revisions and approvals.
* Document site observations and communicate them to the reporting manager.
* Assist in preparing project progress reports and other engineering documentation.
* Maintain organized CAD files and project folders.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The performance of the Civil Engineer will be evaluated based on:

* Accuracy and quality of CAD drawings.
* Timely completion of assigned drawings and engineering tasks.
* Accuracy of site measurements and documentation.
* Effective coordination between office and site teams.
* Timely completion of assigned project activities.
* Adherence to project specifications and quality standards.
* Ability to identify and communicate site\-related issues.
* Proper maintenance of engineering documents and records.
* Responsiveness to site and project requirements.

Required Technical Skills

* Good knowledge of **AutoCAD/CAD software**.
* Ability to read and understand civil engineering drawings.
* Basic knowledge of civil engineering principles and construction practices.
* Understanding of plans, elevations, sections, and layouts.
* Basic knowledge of quantity estimation and measurements.
* Knowledge of MS Office, particularly **Excel and Word**.
* Ability to prepare and maintain technical documentation.
* Basic knowledge of construction materials and methods.
* Knowledge of surveying/site measurements will be an advantage.

Required Soft Skills

* Good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Good problem\-solving ability.
* Willingness to travel to project sites/company locations.
* Comfortable working in both **office and site environments**.
* Ability to coordinate with contractors, vendors, supervisors, and internal teams.
* Attention to detail.
* Ability to work independently as well as part of a team.
* Good time\-management skills.
* Willingness to learn and take responsibility.
* Professional and positive attitude.

Educational Qualification

* **B.E./B.Tech in Civil Engineering** from a recognized university/institution.
* Diploma in Civil Engineering candidates with relevant skills/experience may also be considered.

Experience

* **0–2 years** of experience in Civil Engineering, CAD Drafting, Construction, Site Engineering, or related roles.
* Freshers with good **AutoCAD knowledge** and willingness to work at project sites are welcome to apply.
* Candidates with experience in both CAD and site work will be preferred.

Preferred Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate should:

* Have a **B.E./B.Tech in Civil Engineering**.
* Have good working knowledge of **AutoCAD**.

title: Product Support Engineer - Google Cloud
description:
****Synopsis of the role:**
 Ready to work on the front lines of data delivery, leveraging the power of Google Cloud? If you're a detail\-oriented problem\-solver who enjoys working with sophisticated technology and contributing to a mission\-critical platform, this role is for you!
   

  

 As a Product Support Analyst within the Technical Fulfillment team, you’ll configure, operate and monitor our high\-volume batch data delivery platform built on Google Cloud. You will play a key role in processing and enriching financial data for our clients, ensuring seamless and precise execution with a strong focus on quality and reliability gaining invaluable experience in a dynamic and evolving technological landscape.
   

  

**What you’ll do** 
 :**
**Platform Configuration and Operation:**
* Configure and execute data processing workflows on our batch delivery platform according to established procedures and client specifications.
* Deploy and manage complex data pipelines orchestrated via Apache Airflow.
* Leverage and extend Standard Airflow DAG Templates to ensure deployment consistency and rapid iteration across environments.
* Monitor the execution of data processing jobs, identifying and addressing any issues to ensure timely and accurate delivery.
* Perform data quality checks and validation to ensure the integrity and accuracy of processed information.
* Diagnose and resolve complex configuration, scheduling, and dependency issues within the GCP platform and its associated infrastructure.
* Adhere to established security protocols and maintain the highest standards of data security and privacy in all configuration activities.
* Follow SDLC (Software Development Life Cycle) guidelines for any configuration deployments or changes.
* Maintain accurate records of configurations, processes, and any issues encountered.
* Stay up\-to\-date with platform updates, new features, and relevant technical information.
* Contribute to the identification of opportunities for process improvement and automation within the configuration workflows.
* Assist in the creation and maintenance of our configuration documentation and knowledge base articles.


**Client Focus:**
* Understand the importance of accurate and timely data delivery for our clients.
* Support the team in addressing client inquiries and resolving fulfillment\-related issues.
* Take ownership of precise, high\-stakes data configurations that directly impact client trust and business outcomes.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional partners (including Engineering and Data Operations) to resolve issues and improve delivery processes.


****What experience you need:****
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology or equivalent.
* Strong analytical, detail\-oriented, and proactive approach to problem solving.
* Familiarity with data processing concepts and batch delivery systems.
* Experience working with configuration files (e.g., YAML).
* Understanding of cloud computing concepts, ideally with some exposure to GCP.
* Familiarity with different file encoding formats.
* Experience with API tools for testing and understanding data interfaces.
* Basic scripting skills (e.g., shell scripting) are an asset.


****What could set you apart:****
* Ability to verify issues by testing in higher environments, be on\-call support for Production Incidents as needed.
* Experience with GCP services such as Dataflow, Composer, Cloud Storage, or BigQuery.
* Familiarity with monitoring and logging tools within a cloud environment (e.g., Google Cloud Logging and Monitoring)
* Proficiency in scripting (Python) or object\-oriented programming languages (Java).


**If you're eager to dive into the Google Cloud and the world of data delivery, apply now to join our innovative team!**

title: Transport Modeler
description:
****JOB DESCRIPTION****
 Are you enthusiastic about how transportation, land use, socioeconomics, and technology intersect and its real\-world impacts on people’s lives and communities? Do you have a passion to empower regional planning policies and decisions with state\-of\-the\-art transportation planning tools? Are you ready to take on the challenge to deliver highly innovative transportation planning projects that will shape and inspire a sustainable, prosperous, and resilient future? If so, consider joining our innovative Planning team at WSP ! for Canada Business. We are looking for a Junior or Intermediate Transportation Planner/Engineer/Data Scientist to join our team.
   

  

 We focus on the development and application of travel demand models to support multi\-modal transportation planning and policy projects. We specialize in advanced, activity\-based demand modelling techniques to forecast regional population travel patterns and future transportation networks given proposed land uses, transportation infrastructure, and policies. Our proven record for developing industry\-leading solutions include the Cities, Municipalities and Regional Travel Demand Model and its implementations. We are trusted advisors and close collaborators with municipal, regional, and provincial governments, transportation agencies, and academia.
   

  

 We are also actively growing Transportation Planning practice that is rooted in our team’s strong data analytics and visualization capabilities. This involves developing bespoke software solutions to help clients analyze large and complex data sources to derive useful insights and answer complex questions.
   

  

 As a member of the GCC Planning team, you will be part of a forward\-thinking team that seeks to improve transportation mobility through the delivery of travel demand models and data\-driven insights. Depending on the project, work may involve a combination of macro/meso/microscopic modelling, and data science. You will also be part of the broader, multi\-disciplinary Transportation Planning and Science practice and will closely collaborate with other planners and engineers on transportation master plans, secondary plans, environmental assessments, policy studies, and other transportation planning projects.
   

  

 We offer a team\-focused environment that encourages rapid career growth, flexible work arrangements, and a highly competitive benefits package. Join us and be part of a leading national professional services firm that is committed to designing and planning sustainable cities!
   

  

****RESPONSIBILITIES****
**What Skills and Qualifications are needed?**
* A Bachelor’s degree or higher in Engineering, Urban Planning, Computer Science, Economics, or a related discipline, and/or 1\-3 years of equivalent work experience
* Demonstrable experience with computer programming (preferably Python and/or R)
* Strong and proven background in statistics and data analysis
* Strong oral and technical writing communication skills
* Excellent attention to detail
* A great fit working within our close\-knit team culture
* Knowledge of travel demand model design and application, including experience with activity\-based models and platforms
* Proficiency with travel demand modelling software (EMME, VISUM, TransCAD, Cube)
* Experience in meso/microscopic traffic simulations (Aimsun, VISSIM, Viswalk, DYNAMEQ, Synchro, Sidra, HCS)

* Experience building and applying machine learning models
* Experience with data visualization front\-end development using HTML, CSS, and common web libraries and frameworks


**MICROSIMULATION**

* Compiling and analyzing transportation data;
* Undertaking transportation studies, including complex traffic operations studies including capacity analysis using modeling tools such as Synchro/SimTraffic, Vissim, Aimsun Next;
* Conduct traffic impact studies, traffic signal and intersection improvement evaluations, traffic management plan evaluations and safety reviews;
* Liaising with team members;
* Preparing technical reports;
* Other duties as assigned/required.


****QUALIFICATIONS****
* Post\-secondary education in Civil Engineering or Transportation Engineering from an accredited university;
* Excellent attention to detail
* Proficiency in traffic simulation modelling (Synchro/SimTraffic, VISSIM, Aimsun Next, SYDRA, ARCADY) and travel demand modelling (EMME, TransCAD);
* Skills and experience in traffic engineering; specifically travel demand forecasting, traffic operations analysis, and safety analysis;
* Ability to work independently, with minimal supervision, and in a team environment;
* Ability to communicate effectively, orally and in writing; including the ability to prepare and present complex technical reports, research and analysis;
* Ability to develop analysis tools, applications, and macros using computer programming (e.g. VBA, Python, C\#, etc.) would be an asset.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**DevOps Engineer**
**Opening Paragraph**
 As EY continues to evolve and modernize its digital platforms, we are seeking a talented DevOps Engineer to help accelerate the delivery, reliability, and scalability of our enterprise solutions. This role sits at the intersection of development, operations, automation, and cloud infrastructure, enabling teams to deliver innovative business capabilities faster and more securely. You will play a critical role in supporting modern digital experiences, driving automation, and ensuring our platforms operate efficiently and securely across a global environment.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 This is an exciting opportunity to join a high\-performing technology team focused on delivering business\-critical services and digital capabilities. As a DevOps Engineer, you will be responsible for building and maintaining the infrastructure, automation, and deployment processes that support our applications and platforms.
   

  

 You will work closely with development, operations, architecture, and business stakeholders to implement modern DevOps practices, improve operational efficiency, and enhance platform reliability. This role offers exposure to enterprise\-scale systems, cloud technologies, automation frameworks, and continuous improvement initiatives while providing opportunities to influence the future direction of our technology landscape.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
 As a DevOps Engineer, you will be responsible for supporting and enhancing the infrastructure, deployment pipelines, and operational processes that enable successful delivery of applications and services.
   

  

**Key responsibilities include:**
* Design, implement, and maintain infrastructure solutions that support application hosting, data processing, analytics, and enterprise services.
* Develop and manage Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) pipelines to streamline software delivery and improve deployment quality and consistency.
* Implement monitoring, alerting, and logging capabilities to ensure system health, availability, and performance visibility.
* Automate operational and administrative tasks to reduce manual effort, increase efficiency, and improve reliability.
* Collaborate with development, operations, product, and business teams to ensure solutions meet business requirements and are delivered successfully.
* Support software releases, deployments, and infrastructure maintenance activities as required.
* Ensure platforms and services comply with organizational security standards, governance requirements, and regulatory obligations.
* Develop and implement best practices for access management, data protection, and system security.
* Analyze system performance, identify bottlenecks, and implement optimization strategies to improve scalability and operational efficiency.
* Participate in troubleshooting and root\-cause analysis of production issues, driving long\-term corrective actions and continuous improvement.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
 Success in this role requires a combination of technical expertise, problem\-solving ability, collaboration, and a passion for automation and continuous improvement. You will be effective in a fast\-paced environment where you can balance operational excellence with innovation and partnership across multiple teams.
   

  

**To Qualify for the Role, You Must Have**
* Experience designing, implementing, and supporting enterprise infrastructure environments.
* Experience developing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation.
* Knowledge of monitoring, logging, and observability tools and practices.
* Experience automating operational processes using scripting and automation technologies.
* Understanding of security best practices, access controls, compliance requirements, and infrastructure governance.
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills with the ability to solve complex technical problems.
* Experience working collaboratively with cross\-functional teams in an Agile delivery environment.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.


**Ideally, You'll Also Have**
* Experience with cloud platforms and modern cloud operations practices.
* Exposure to Infrastructure as Code (IaC) methodologies and automation frameworks.
* Knowledge of performance tuning, scalability planning, and system optimization.
* Experience supporting enterprise application deployments and release management processes.
* Experience working within large, globally distributed teams.
* Relevant DevOps, cloud, or infrastructure certifications.


**What We Look For**
 We are looking for individuals who are curious, collaborative, and committed to continuous learning. The ideal candidate is proactive, adaptable, and comfortable taking ownership of challenges while working across global teams. You will be someone who embraces innovation, shares knowledge openly, and consistently seeks opportunities to improve processes, technology, and outcomes. A positive attitude, strong communication skills, and the ability to balance independent work with effective teamwork will be critical for success.
   

  

**What Working At EY Offers**
 At EY, you'll have the opportunity to build a career as unique as you are, supported by a global scale, an inclusive culture, and technology to help you become the best version of yourself. You'll work on meaningful projects that impact our people, clients, and business while collaborating with talented professionals across diverse disciplines and geographies.
   

  

 We invest in our people through continuous learning, professional development, mentoring, and leadership opportunities. You'll be empowered to bring your ideas forward, challenge the status quo, and contribute to innovative solutions that help shape the future of our organization.
   

  

**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

description:
**Job Description**
**About the Role**
 Kaleris is a private equity\-backed software firm focused on supply chain optimization, headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. We are a global leader in the supply chain execution market, focused on accelerating the transformation of digital supply chain for industrial and finished goods shippers and carriers by combining best\-in\-class solutions for challenges tied to yard management, shipment visibility, and asset management, across rail, truck, and multi\-mode transportation.
   

  

 We’re looking for a forward\-thinking engineer to join our team in supporting and monitoring our ever\-expanding Cloud platform.  You will execute on our key strategic initiative of ushering the maritime industry in the modern computing era.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Protect, maintain, and enhance the software and systems supporting Navis' cloud solutions, ensuring they consistently meet or exceed strict SLA requirements for mission\-critical systems powering global trade.
* Establish and promote standardized tools, processes, and frameworks across a diverse portfolio of solutions with varying levels of maturity, complexity, and criticality.
* Collaborate with engineering teams to implement security best practices, conduct audits and testing, and share results with all stakeholders.
* Define response protocols for monitoring alerts and contribute to a growing playbook of procedures. Lead Post Incident Reviews, enforce best practices, and provide recommendations for process improvements and operational efficiencies.
* Develop automation solutions to proactively prevent problem recurrence, ultimately aiming to automate responses to all non\-exceptional service conditions.
* Deliver 24/7/365 support and incident management for a portfolio of approximately a dozen Cloud SaaS solutions. Participate in on\-call support to ensure stability and performance of production environments.


**Requirements**
* 3\-5 years of experience in DevOps, Engineering, or Engineering in Test roles, including supporting and maintaining critical production environments.
* Demonstrated experience working with various Azure\-based PaaS and SaaS services such as Azure AD, Azure SQL, BLOB storage, Redis cache, and Azure Web Services.
* Proficient in managing Microsoft Azure environments, including VMs, NSGs, and Resource Groups. Familiarity with Docker and related orchestration technologies, including Docker, Rancher, Kubernetes, and Helm.
* Skilled in both Windows and Linux administration, including knowledge of bash commands such as ssh, scp, sed, awk, grep, netstat, etc.
* Familiarity with cloud security guidelines, such as Security Operation Center (SOC) guidelines, and compliance requirements like GDPR and FIS.
* Extensive knowledge of networking, including protocols, virtual networks, subnets, and firewalls.
* Strong scripting experience in languages such as Python, PowerShell, Ansible, and Terraform. Additional ability to write SQL queries and investigate DB logs is a plus.
* Understanding and practical application of methodologies like ITIL, Agile, Scrum, DevOps, and SRE.
* Proficient in monitoring and logging tools like ELK, Site 24x7, New Relic, and Splunk.
* Collaborative mindset with exceptional interpersonal and communication skills.
* Ability to remain calm and composed in high\-pressure situations, such as during major service outages.
* Excellent problem\-solving skills with the ability to analyze distributed systems on a global scale.
* Strong attention to detail, follow\-through, and ability to quickly prioritize tasks when dealing with multiple items.


*The duties and responsibilities described are not a comprehensive list and additional tasks may be assigned from time to time or the scope of the position may change necessary to business demands.*
 Kaleris is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

 Prime Video is a premium streaming service that offers customers a vast collection of TV shows and movies \- all with the ease of finding what they love to watch in one place. We offer customers thousands of popular movies and TV shows including Amazon Originals and exclusive licensed content to exciting live sports events. We also offer our members the opportunity to subscribe to add\-on channels which they can cancel at anytime and to rent or buy new release movies and TV box sets on the Prime Video Store. Prime Video is a fast\-paced, growth business \- available in over 200 countries and territories worldwide. The team works in a dynamic environment where innovating on behalf of our customers is at the heart of everything we do. If this sounds exciting to you, please read on.
   

  

 Our Playback Operations Systems Group is looking for a motivated, results\-oriented, dedicated and operationally focused System Development Engineer to support the fast\-evolving and expanding device automation systems, that support our live events and 24/7 linear operations. You will have an enormous opportunity to work within multiple systems analyzing and identifying the common issues, and driving the teams towards resolution to have a positive impact on customer experience. This job requires you to learn quickly and work on disparate and overlapping tasks.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Design and deliver systems and automation that scale Prime Video's Live OTT delivery and 24/7 linear operations
* Own the operational health of device automation and monitoring systems — identify resilience risks and deliver solutions that eliminate them
* Improve monitoring capabilities and system reliability, reducing manual operational load across the team
* Define and maintain operational metrics and service level objectives, with alarming based on service health
* Drive resolution of difficult performance, reliability, and availability issues, leaving systems better than you found them
* Partner with adjacent Live Ops engineering teams to improve how systems interact and integrate


 A day in the life
   

  

 Your morning starts by reviewing operational dashboards and alerts, ensuring live services are healthy. When issues arise—latency spikes, availability drops—you collaborate with the team to diagnose and resolve them quickly.
   

  

 Mid\-morning shifts to development: enhancing automation scripts, improving device monitoring workflows, and testing changes in staging environments to reduce manual intervention during live events.
   

  

 Afternoons bring cross\-team collaboration—troubleshooting priority tickets with encoding and operations engineers, deploying fixes before high\-profile events go live, and designing monitoring solutions that scale with Prime Video's growing live sports portfolio.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The Playback Ops Systems Group build and maintain reliable, high performance customer experience monitoring tooling and infrastructure. We take ownership of the end\-to\-end live monitoring experience \-\- from a Living Room device, through our encoding and analysis platform, out through to our Live Ops AVOCs (Amazon Video Operation Centres). Our team makes a big impact because nothing is more important to us than delighting our customers, continually earning their trust, and thinking long term. If you crave a sense of ownership, this is the place to be.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Experience programming with at least one modern language such as C\+\+, C\#, Java, Python, Golang, PowerShell, Ruby
* Experience in automating, deploying, and supporting large\-scale infrastructure
* Experience with Linux/Unix
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines build processes
* Experience with distributed systems at scale


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems
* Experience utilizing AWS cloud solutions in a DevOps environment

* Experience in major facilities incident management
* Experience in creating process improvements with automation and analysis, or experience working in a large team or fast\-paced corporate environment
* supporting or automating physical device fleets, encoding appliances, or hardware infrastructure
