title: Abuse Mitigation & Compliance Associate
description:
**Who We Are.**
 Newfold Digital is a leading web technology company serving millions of customers globally. Our customers know us through our robust portfolio of brands. We have some of the industry's most prominent and storied go\-to\-market brands, including Bluehost, HostGator, Domain.com, Network Solutions, Register.com and Web.com. We help customers of all sizes build a digital presence that delivers results. With our extensive product offerings and personalized support, we take pride in collaborating with our customers to serve their online presence needs. The strength of our company lives in the intersection of our people, our customers, and our brands.
   

  

**What you’ll do \& how you’ll make your mark.**
* Review the dashboards and data provided by the technical and product teams to find customers taking advantage of our unmetered hosting policy by storing files that are prohibited by our acceptable usage policy.
* Email the clients to inform them of the policy breach and help them in deleting the restricted files.
* To address any queries the clients may have, you will be expected to work closely with the product and technical teams.
* Publish monthly reports to stakeholders about the number of cases handled and the results.
* Create, maintain, and improve processes for detection and mitigation of abusive activity perpetrated through usage of our products
* Liaison with various representatives of the intelligence community, domestic and global law enforcement, industry, and cyber\-crime watchdogs that specialize in abuse mitigation to enable rapid exchange of data and take prompt action against miscreants
* Perform forensic analysis of malware, spam, phishes/spoofs and other abuse incidents to understand modus operandi and implement countermeasures in partnership with support and system admin teams
* Proactively track and review abusive activity within our client base and take appropriate action, ensuring that our Terms of Usage are strictly adhered
* Work with and guide our dedicated operations team that receives complaints from Internet users about abusive activity, and communicates with clients and channel partners to take appropriate action
* Gather actionable intelligence and understand threats by using data obtained from various black lists, browsing various fraud forums, communicating with affected parties and so forth
* Participate in discussions within the Internet security community at large, with a view to gather intelligence and refine our processes based on industry/technology trends
* Educate our channel partners about best practices in abuse and fraud mitigation by conducting webinars and presentations, blogging etc.


**Who you are \& what you’ll need to succeed.**
* Experience: 0\-1 years in Customer Service or similar capacity, preferably on an IT platform
* Outstanding communication skills
* Sound knowledge of Internet, web technologies, operating systems and networking concepts; ability to rapidly learn new concepts
* Excellent presentation skills
* High level of interest in cyber security
* High degree of motivation, with excellent follow through skills
* Logical and analytical bend of mind, with a penchant for solving complex problems
* Good investigative skills and consummate attention to detail
* Inclination towards research, data analysis, problem solving
* Must be willing to work in shifts (including at night and on holidays)
* Prior training or experience in cyber forensics/cyber law or network security.
* Experience in a customer interaction capacity, preferably in a technical field


**Why you’ll love us.**
* We’ve evolved; we provide three work environment scenarios. You can feel like a Newfolder in a workfrom\-home, hybrid, or work\-from\-the\-office environment.
* Work\-life balance. Our work is thrilling and meaningful, but we know balance is key to living well.
* We celebrate one another’s differences. We’re proud of our culture of diversity and inclusion. We foster a culture of belonging. Our company and customers benefit when employees bring their authentic selves to work. We have programs that bring us together on important issues and provide learning and development opportunities for all employees. We have 20 \+ affinity groups where you can network and connect with Newfolders globally.
* We care about you. . At Newfold, taking care of our employees is our top priority. we make sure that cutting edge benefits are in place to for you. Some of the benefits you will have: We have partnered with some of the best insurance providers to provide you excellent Health Insurance options, Education/ Certification Sponsorships to give you a chance to further your knowledge, Flexi\-leaves to take personal time off and much more. Building a community one domain at a time, one employee at a time. All our employees are eligible for a free domain and WordPress blog as we sponsor the domain registration costs.
* Where can we take you? We’re fans of helping our employees learn different aspects of the business, be challenged with new tasks, be mentored, and grow their careers. Unfold new possibilities with \#teamnewfold!

title: TC-CS-CTM-Pentest-Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Attack \& Penetration Testing \- Senior**
 As part of our Cyber Security team, you shall perform penetration testing which includes internet, intranet, wireless, web application, social engineering and physical penetration testing. You shall also perform in\-depth analysis of penetration testing results and create report that describes findings, exploitation procedures, risks and recommendations.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 We’re looking for Security Consultant / Senior Security Consultant with expertise in penetration testing. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in the growth of a new service offering.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Perform penetration testing which includes internet, intranet, web application, wireless, social engineering, physical penetration testing.
* Execute penetration testing projects using the established methodology, tools and rules of engagements.
* Execute red team assessments to highlight gaps impacting organizations security postures.
* Identify and exploit security vulnerabilities in a wide array of systems in a variety of situations.
* Perform in\-depth analysis of penetration testing results and create report that describes findings, exploitation procedures, risks and recommendations.
* Convey complex technical security concepts to technical and non\-technical audiences including executives.
* Strong knowledge of OWASP Top 10 web and the ability to effectively communicate methodologies and techniques with development teams
* Understanding and experience with Active Directory attacks.
* Understanding of TCP/IP network protocols.
* Develop automated solutions that mitigate risks throughout the organization.
* Ability to automate DAST/SAST solutions and reporting
* Support SDLC and agile environments with application security testing and source code reviews.
* Provide technical leadership and advise to junior team members on attack and penetration test engagements.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Understanding of web\-based application vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10\).
* Good understanding of enterprise security controls in Active Directory / Windows environments
* Understanding of TCP/IP network protocols.
* Understanding of network security and popular attacks vectors.
* Ability to communicate detailed technical information to a non\-technical audience clearly
* Experience with Operation Technology / Internet of Things, Cloud technologies (AWS, Azure, GCP), Active Directory and 802\.1x penetration testing
* Strong understanding of security principles, policies, and industry best practices
* Demonstrable flair for technical writing, including engagement reports, presentations and operating procedures


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* BE/ B.Tech/ MCA or equivalent
* Minimum of 6 years of work experience in penetration testing which may include at least three of the following: internet, intranet, web application penetration tests, wireless, social engineering, physical and Red Team assessments.
* One of the following certifications: OSCP, OSCE, OSEP, OSWE, CREST, CRTE, eCPTX, or eWPTX
* Knowledge of Windows, Linux, UNIX, any other major operating systems.
* 3\-4\-9 years of work experience in Strategy and Operations projects
* Strong Excel and PowerPoint skills.


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Project management skills
* Certifications: CISSP, GPEN, GWAPT.


**What We Look For**
* Who can perform penetration testing which includes internet, intranet, wireless, web application, social engineering and physical penetration testing and provide analysis for the testing results.


**What Working At EY Offers**
 At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
   

  

 You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
   

  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

 We are looking for an AI Data Protection Field Engineer to help deploy, integrate, test, and troubleshoot AI\-enabled data protection solutions for global clients.  Join a globally connected cybersecurity practice helping clients protect sensitive data in an AI\-driven world. **About DHL Blue Dart Express India:**


  

**Blue Dart Express Limited**, a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. We are proud to be consistently ranked among **India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work**, combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an **Employer of Choice** is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.

Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross\-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.


**Position Overview:**


  

The **Ops Staff** is responsible for supporting day\-to\-day operational activities within Blue Dart's Service Centres, Hubs, Processing Units (PUDs) and Warehouses by ensuring efficient shipment handling, processing and movement across the network.


The role performs a wide range of operational activities including shipment receiving, sorting, scanning, bagging, tagging, loading, unloading, shipment reconciliation and data entry while ensuring adherence to operational procedures, safety standards and service commitments. As a frontline operations employee, the incumbent plays a critical role in maintaining shipment accuracy, operational productivity and service quality while representing the Blue Dart brand through professional conduct, discipline and operational excellence.


**Job Purpose:**


  

To support efficient shipment processing and operational activities by ensuring accurate handling, sorting, scanning and movement of shipments while maintaining high standards of productivity, safety, quality and compliance with Blue Dart's Standard Operating Procedures.


**Key Roles \& Responsibilities:**


  

**Shipment Processing \& Operations*** Receive, segregate, sort and process inbound and outbound shipments accurately.

**Data Entry \& Operational Documentation*** Perform basic data entry and shipment updates using approved operational systems.

**Operational Support*** Support day\-to\-day operations across Service Centres, Hubs, Warehouses and Processing Units.

**Safety, Security \& Compliance*** Follow all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) while performing operational activities.

**Workplace Discipline \& Brand Representation*** Maintain high standards of personal grooming, hygiene and professional appearance.

* Demonstrate discipline, punctuality and professionalism at all times.
* Follow workplace rules, operational discipline and company policies.
* Represent the Blue Dart brand positively through behaviour, teamwork and commitment to service excellence.

**Teamwork \& Continuous Improvement*** Work collaboratively with colleagues across operational teams.
* Participate in operational briefings, safety meetings and training programmes.
* Share ideas for improving operational efficiency and workplace safety.
* Support implementation of new operational processes and initiatives.
* Contribute towards maintaining a positive and productive work environment.

title: LinkedIn Executive
description:
LinkedIn \& Personal Branding Associate

We are looking for someone who is curious about marketing, understands how LinkedIn works, and wants to get really good at personal branding, content, engagement and lead generation.

You do not need years of experience for this role.

If you have 3 to 4 months of experience in marketing, social media, content, sales, outreach or a related field, and you have the hunger to learn, you can be a great fit.

You will work closely with our team to manage and grow the LinkedIn presence of founders, CEOs and senior professionals. We will train you on our processes, how we approach personal branding, how we write content, how we engage with the right people and how we turn LinkedIn activity into meaningful business conversations.

What You Will Do

* Manage and maintain LinkedIn profiles for founders, CEOs and senior professionals
* Help plan and execute LinkedIn content based on the client's positioning, industry and goals
* Research topics, ideas, people and conversations relevant to each client
* Assist with writing and refining LinkedIn posts
* Manage daily LinkedIn engagement and interact with relevant people in a thoughtful way
* Identify the right people and companies for networking and outreach
* Build relevant connections and write meaningful connection notes
* Support LinkedIn outreach and lead generation activities
* Track conversations, follow\-ups and prospects
* Monitor the overall presence and reputation of clients on LinkedIn
* Keep client profiles active, relevant and aligned with their positioning
* Use AI tools to improve research, content creation, ideation and day\-to\-day execution
* Work with the team to continuously improve content, engagement and outreach based on what is working

What We Are Looking For

You do not need to be an expert.

We are looking for someone who:

* Understands the basics of LinkedIn and knows how the platform works
* Understands what outreach means and why targeted outreach matters
* Knows what makes a good connection request and connection note
* Has a basic understanding of marketing and communication
* Can write clear, simple and grammatically correct English
* Is comfortable researching people, companies, industries and topics
* Has basic knowledge of AI tools and is comfortable learning new tools
* Has a genuine interest in LinkedIn, personal branding, content and marketing
* Pays attention to details and can follow a process consistently
* Is proactive, curious and willing to learn
* Can understand a client's voice and communicate in a way that feels natural rather than robotic
* Has the ability to take feedback and improve quickly

Experience

3 to 4 months of experience in marketing, social media, content, sales, outreach or a similar role is enough.

Freshers can also be considered if they have a strong understanding of LinkedIn, good communication skills and a genuine interest in learning.

What matters more to us than years of experience is your ability to learn, execute and improve.

Training \& Growth

You will receive training on:

* LinkedIn personal branding
* Content strategy and content writing
* LinkedIn engagement
* Founder and CEO positioning
* LinkedIn outreach
* Lead generation
* Prospect research
* Client profile management
* AI tools and workflows
* Managing the LinkedIn presence of senior professionals

You will not be expected to figure everything out on your own from day one.

We will teach you the process. Your job is to learn it, execute it well and keep getting better.

The Ideal Person

You might be a great fit if you are someone who sees LinkedIn and thinks:

"I want to understand how this actually works."

You enjoy learning about marketing, people, businesses and content.

You notice why some posts get attention while others don't.

You are curious about how founders build their reputation online.

You like talking to people, researching businesses and finding the right prospects.

And most importantly, you have the fire to become really good at something rather than simply looking for another job.

What This Role Can Become

This is an opportunity to build real expertise in one of the fastest\-growing areas of modern marketing: LinkedIn personal branding and founder\-led growth.

As you grow, you can take ownership of larger clients, strategy, content, engagement, outreach and eventually entire LinkedIn growth accounts.

If you are willing to learn and execute, there is a lot of room to grow here.

title: Interactive Web Developer (Contract-to-Perm) — 3D, Motion & HW-SW | Three.js · WebGL · GSAP · Framer
description:
**Company Description** 
 Antariksha Labs is focused on transforming education and innovation through practical, hands\-on learning experiences built around cutting\-edge hardware modules and a robust developer platform. The company specializes in satellite\-inspired technologies and modular hardware solutions that bridge the gap between theory and real\-world applications, from educational model satellites to industry\-grade systems. Its platforms support space technology exploration, aerial testing, and scalable research projects, giving learners and professionals the flexibility to prototype and deploy bold ideas. Antariksha Labs partners with educators, industry leaders, and creators to foster a collaborative community where new solutions can be developed, tested, and commercialized. Through its one\-stop platform, creators can bring their designs to market and leverage data\-driven tools for real\-world use cases.
 



  





**Role Description** 
 The Interactive Web Developer (Contract\-to\-Perm) will design, build, and maintain highly interactive 3D and motion\-rich product websites using technologies such as Three.js, WebGL, GSAP, and Framer. In this part\-time/contract remote role, the developer will collaborate with design, product, and hardware plus software teams to translate complex technical concepts into engaging, performant web experiences that showcase Antariksha Labs’ platforms and solutions. You will build two product websites — one for an energy intelligence platform spanning consumer, commercial, and utility products, and one for a modular space\-technology hardware line used in education and research.
 



  





 Both brands sell technical products that need to be understood before they are bought: hardware that must be seen from every angle, software interfaces that need to be shown in motion, and systems whose value only lands when the visitor can see how the pieces connect. We are looking for someone who can build product experiences — 3D hardware visualisation, scroll\-driven explanation, purposeful motion — not someone who assembles pages from a template. The technology stack is deliberately open. We have not decided whether these sites are best built hand\-coded, in Framer or Webflow pushed past their defaults, or as a hybrid. Part of what we want from you is that judgment. Come with a point of view on what each brand actually needs, and the range to build it either way.
 



  





 You will work closely with our graphics designer and marketing associate, not in isolation. Design direction, copy, brand assets, and campaign requirements will come from them, and you will be in continuous conversation with both — advising on what is technically feasible, what will hurt performance, and where a design needs to change to survive contact with the browser. Collaborative working is a requirement of this role, not a preference.We expect and encourage the use of AI development tools. What we assess is the finished site — its quality, performance, and maintainability — not how it was produced.
 



  





 Both websites to be delivered within 2 months at a fixed rate of ₹12,000 per month, followed by an ongoing maintenance retainer at a rate agreed at handover.
 



  





**What You'll Build** 



* Two complete product websites, concept through launch, each with its own distinct visual identity
* Interactive 3D product visualisation — hardware devices and satellite modules the visitor can rotate, explore, and inspect
* Scroll\-driven narrative sections explaining how technical systems work
* Product and application pages for both consumer and enterprise audiences
* Campaign landing pages and microsites on fast turnaround
* CMS structures the marketing team can update independently, without returning to you
* Component systems and design tokens that hold consistent as the sites grow
* Performance, accessibility, and responsive behaviour across devices and connection speeds
* On\-page SEO foundations — semantic structure, metadata, sitemaps, page speed
* Ongoing maintenance, content updates, and incremental feature work post\-launch



  





**Core Technical Requirements** 




 Frontend Engineering
 


* Expert JavaScript — modern ES, modules, async patterns, DOM performance
* HTML5 and CSS3 at depth: Grid, Flexbox, custom properties, container queries
* Fluid responsive design across the full range, not three fixed breakpoints
* Framework experience — React, Next.js, Astro, Svelte, or equivalent
* Build tooling and version control: Vite, npm, Git



 3D \& WebGL
 


* Three.js and WebGL in production — scenes, materials, lighting, camera work
* Model optimisation: glTF, Draco compression, LOD, texture and draw\-call budgets
* Graceful degradation where WebGL is unsupported or the device cannot sustain it
* GLSL shader fundamentals (advantageous, not essential)



 Motion \& Interaction
 


* GSAP — timelines, ScrollTrigger, complex sequencing
* CSS animation and the Web Animations API
* Genuine motion judgment: easing, timing, restraint, and knowing when not to animate
* Scroll\-driven experiences that do not wreck performance or accessibility



 Visual Development Platforms
 


* Framer — advanced use including code components, CMS, and custom interactions
* Webflow — custom interactions, CMS collections, and custom code beyond platform limits
* Clear understanding of where each platform's ceiling sits and when to move to code



 Design \& Animation Tooling
 


* Spline — 3D scene creation and web integration
* Rive — interactive, state\-driven animation and runtime integration
* Working fluently from Figma, with the judgment to improve on a design where needed



 Collaboration
 


* Working daily alongside a graphics designer and a marketing associate
* Translating design direction into technical reality, and explaining constraints clearly
* Taking brand, copy, and campaign input and integrating it without friction
* Direct communication on timelines, trade\-offs, and what a shortcut will cost later



  





**Advantageous** 



* Lottie / After Effects motion assets
* Headless CMS — Sanity, Contentful, Payload
* Physics, particle, or generative systems — Cannon, Rapier, custom
* WebGPU or advanced shader work
* Serverless functions, API integration, form handling
* Analytics and conversion instrumentation — GA4, Search Console, event tracking
* Deployment on Vercel, Netlify, or Cloudflare
* Prior work on hardware, deep\-tech, space, energy, or B2B technical products
* Fluent use of AI\-assisted development tooling



  





**Qualifications** 



* Candidates should possess strong Front\-End Development and Web Design skills, with experience in modern frameworks and tools for building interactive, responsive user interfaces.
* Candidates should possess solid Back\-End Web Development skills, including working with APIs, server\-side logic, and integrating data services into dynamic web applications.
* Candidates should possess broad Web Development skills that span both client\-side and server\-side considerations, including performance optimization and cross\-platform compatibility.
* Candidates should possess Programming skills with proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript and familiarity with libraries and tools such as Three.js, WebGL, GSAP, and Framer for 3D and motion experiences.
* Candidates should possess experience in interaction design, accessibility best practices, and responsive layouts to ensure inclusive and reliable user experiences.

title: Embedded Hardware Design Engineer — PCB, Analog & Sensor Systems
description:
**Company Description** 
 Antariksha Labs is an education\-focused technology company that delivers practical, hands\-on learning through advanced hardware modules and a versatile developer platform. The organization specializes in satellite\-inspired and modular hardware solutions that bridge the gap between theory and real\-world applications, ranging from educational model satellites to industrial\-grade systems. Antariksha Labs collaborates with educators, industry partners, and learners to build a community where experimentation and innovation are encouraged. The platform also enables creators to commercialize their designs, offering a one\-stop space to create, test, and sell hardware solutions. With strengths in modular hardware, collaborative research platforms, industry\-grade testing, and data\-driven solutions, Antariksha Labs supports projects that move from concept to deployment.
 



  





**Role Description** 
 The Embedded Hardware Design Engineer — PCB, Analog \& Sensor Systems will focus on designing, prototyping, and validating hardware modules for satellite\-inspired and sensor\-based applications. We build intelligent connected hardware across two domains: energy monitoring and metering devices that sense real electrical loads in homes and facilities, and modular space\-technology hardware used in education and research. Both are physical products that have to work reliably outside a lab. This is the hardware half of a two\-person embedded team. You design the schematics, lay out the PCBs, select and qualify components, bring the boards up, and prove they work — and our embedded software developer writes firmware on top of what you deliver. When a sensor reads wrong, when a rail is noisy, when a board draws more current than the budget allows, it lands with you.
 



  





 This is a hands\-on hardware role. You will spend your time in the schematic editor, at the bench with a scope, and with a soldering iron in hand for prototyping, buying components from local shops and working with assembly houses for production. You will handle analog signal chains for electrical measurement, power supply design, RF layout, sensor interfacing, and thermal and mechanical constraints — and you will be responsible for a board that measures accurately, not just one that powers on.
 



 You will work directly with our engineering leadership and with the firmware, mechanical, and product teams from schematic through to production. We are hiring at graduate level. Portfolio and hands\-on project depth matter far more than years of experience — if you have designed, fabricated, and debugged your own boards, we want to see them. Engagement at Rs. 10,000 per month during the probationary period, with an increase based on performance, and conversion to a full\-time role with time.
 



  





**What You'll Own** 



* Schematic design around ESP32, STM32, and other ARM microcontrollers
* Analog front\-end design for electrical measurement — current and voltage sensing, signal conditioning, filtering, ADC interfacing
* Power supply design: SMPS, LDOs, battery charging, sequencing, protection
* Sensor interfacing over I2C, SPI, UART, CAN, and analog inputs
* Multi\-layer PCB layout, from schematic to fabrication\-ready output
* Mixed\-signal layout discipline — grounding, return paths, analog/digital separation
* RF and antenna layout: impedance control, placement, keep\-outs
* EMI/EMC\-aware design, thermal management, and design for manufacture
* Board bring\-up, rail verification, bus validation, and systematic debugging
* Measurement accuracy validation against reference instruments; power profiling
* Component selection with attention to sourcing, cost, and availability
* Schematics, BOMs, assembly drawings, and revision control
* Board support documentation the firmware developer can work from directly
* Prototype procurement, vendor coordination, and production test fixtures



  





**Core Requirements** 




**PCB \& Circuit Design** 



* Hands\-on with KiCad, Altium, Eagle, or OrCAD
* Schematic capture and multi\-layer layout for a board you actually had fabricated
* Working from datasheets, reference designs, and application notes
* Understanding how layout affects signal integrity and noise



**Electronics Fundamentals** 



* Analog: op\-amps, filters, amplification, ADC front\-ends, noise sources
* Digital: logic levels, level shifting, bus loading, terminations
* Power: regulator topologies, efficiency, ripple, decoupling strategy
* Measurement understanding — resolution, accuracy, drift, sampling, calibration



**Platforms \& Protocols** 



* ESP32, STM32, ARM Cortex\-M, or Raspberry Pi hardware
* I2C, SPI, UART, CAN at hardware level
* Wireless integration: Wi\-Fi, BLE, LoRa, GSM — module selection and RF layout



**Bench Skills** 



* Oscilloscope, logic analyser, multimeter, bench supply
* Soldering and rework including fine\-pitch SMD
* Systematic fault isolation rather than part\-swapping



  





**Advantageous** 



* Energy metering ICs, current transformers, shunts, Hall sensors, isolation for mains\-referenced circuits
* Mains\-voltage design — creepage, clearance, isolation, safety practice

title: Associate Product Manager
description:
**Job Title: Associate Product Manager**
**Shift:** 
 UK
   

  

**The Team**
 Morningstar’s Analytics group develops and delivers proprietary methodologies, calculations, and analytical capabilities that help investors evaluate investments and make informed decisions. The Managed Investment Calculations team translates Morningstar’s research and intellectual property into accurate, scalable, and consistent analytics used across Morningstar products.
   

  

**The Role**
 We are seeking a Associate Product Manager with strong business analysis and data analysis skills to lead the development and ongoing enhancement of managed investment calculation capabilities.
   

  

 This role combines product ownership with hands\-on analytical work. You will partner with methodology experts, quantitative researchers, engineering, and quality assurance teams to translate investment methodologies and business needs into detailed calculation specifications and reliable production capabilities. You will analyze complex investment datasets, prototype and validate calculations, investigate discrepancies, and ensure that implementations faithfully reflect Morningstar’s proprietary methodologies.
   

  

 The ideal candidate brings analytical rigor, relevant investment knowledge, and the ability to learn complex financial concepts quickly. You should be comfortable both prioritizing a product backlog and using SQL to investigate underlying data. Prior knowledge of Morningstar’s products or methodologies is not required.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Own product priorities and delivery: Manage the tactical roadmap and backlog for managed investment calculations, balancing new capabilities, methodology enhancements, data quality, and platform improvements.
* Define business requirements: Partner with product teams, research, operations, and client support to clarify user needs, assess business impact, and establish scope and success criteria.
* Translate methodologies into calculation specifications: Work with methodology owners to document formulas, input requirements, eligibility rules, calculation frequency, exceptions, and expected outputs.
* Perform detailed data and business analysis: Use SQL and analytical tools to investigate datasets, assess coverage and quality, map data sources, and understand dependencies and downstream impacts.
* Prototype and validate calculations: Develop calculation examples and independently verify results, including edge cases, missing data, historical changes, and differences across fund structures and share classes.
* Drive execution with engineering and QA: Develop actionable user stories and acceptance criteria, resolve implementation questions, and partner on test scenarios, regression coverage, and release readiness.
* Safeguard calculation quality: Investigate discrepancies and production issues, identify root causes, and prioritize fixes based on investor, client, and business impact.
* Manage methodology and implementation changes: Evaluate effects on historical results and consuming products, coordinate stakeholder review, and maintain traceability between approved methodologies and production logic.
* Build shared understanding: Maintain clear calculation documentation and support materials that help global teams explain analytics and resolve client questions.
* Measure outcomes and communicate progress: Track calculation accuracy, timeliness, coverage, and adoption, while communicating priorities, dependencies, and delivery risks.


**Required Qualifications**
* 2\+ years of experience in product management, business analysis, or data analysis, preferably within investment analytics, financial data, or financial services.
* Strong hands\-on SQL skills and experience analyzing complex datasets to validate results and investigate issues.
* Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous business needs and financial methodologies into precise requirements, calculation logic, and acceptance criteria.
* Understanding of managed investments, including mutual funds, ETFs, share classes, and concepts such as investment performance, risk, fees, and peer group comparisons.
* Ability to learn complex financial concepts and methodologies quickly, question assumptions, and apply that understanding to data analysis and calculation requirements.
* Experience specifying, prototyping, or validating analytical calculations, with close attention to data dependencies, exceptions, and reproducibility.
* Experience prioritizing requirements or managing a backlog and collaborating with engineering and QA teams throughout the development lifecycle.
* Excellent critical thinking and problem\-solving skills, including the ability to distinguish data issues from methodology or implementation issues.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex analytical concepts to technical and business audiences.
* Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively across global teams.
* Bachelor’s degree in finance, economics, mathematics, statistics, computer science, engineering, or a related discipline.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience working with investment datasets, financial calculations, or proprietary analytical methodologies.
* Python or similar programming skills for data analysis, calculation prototyping, and validation.
* Familiarity with centralized calculation services, APIs, data pipelines, and cloud analytical platforms.
* Experience with data lineage, reconciliation, and automated calculation quality controls.


 Morningstar is an equal opportunity employer.
   

  

 Morningstar's hybrid work environment gives you the opportunity to collaborate in\-person each week as we've found that we're at our best when we're purposely together on a regular basis. In most of our locations, our hybrid work model is four days in\-office each week. A range of other benefits are also available to enhance flexibility as needs change. No matter where you are, you'll have tools and resources to engage meaningfully with your global colleagues.

description:
**Company:** Amplus Subsidy Solutions  
**Department:** Sales \& Business Development  
**Job Title:** Telecaller / Inside Sales Executive  
**Reporting To:** Sales Head / Business Development Manager  
**Location:** Nashik, Maharashtra  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Experience:** 0–2 Years  
**Education:** 12th Pass / Graduate  
**Industry:** Government Subsidy, MSME, Manufacturing \& Business Consulting

ABOUT AMPLUS

Amplus Subsidy Solutions works with MSMEs, manufacturers and entrepreneurs to help them identify and access relevant Government Subsidies, Incentives, Finance\-linked Schemes, Compliances, Licences, Approvals and Project\-related Government Support.

We are building a professional sales team focused on **quality conversations, genuine opportunities, disciplined follow\-ups and long\-term client relationships.**

PURPOSE OF THE ROLE

The Telecaller / Inside Sales Executive will be responsible for:

**Calling → Connecting → Understanding → Qualifying → Follow\-up → Appointment Setting → CRM Update**

The primary objective is to convert available leads and prospect databases into **qualified business conversations and appointments for the Business Development/Sales Team.**

This is not simply a calling job.

The candidate should learn to identify whether a business has a potential requirement related to:

* Government Subsidy
* Industrial Incentives
* MSME Schemes
* Compliance
* Licences
* Approvals
* Project\-related Government Support

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES1\. Outbound Calling

* Make outbound calls to prospective MSMEs, manufacturers and entrepreneurs.
* Contact leads received through:
* Website
* Digital marketing
* Social media
* Campaigns
* Existing databases
* Referrals
* Events and exhibitions
* Business networks
* Introduce Amplus professionally.
* Understand the prospect's basic requirement.
* Create interest in a relevant discussion.

2\. Lead Qualification

Ask relevant questions to understand:

* Business/industry
* Manufacturing activity
* Business location
* New project or existing business
* Expansion/modernization plans
* Approximate investment
* Machinery purchase/plans
* MSME/Udyam status
* Subsidy/incentive requirement
* Compliance/approval requirement
* Project timeline
* Decision\-maker availability

The objective is to identify:

**Raw Lead → Interested Lead → Qualified Lead → Appointment**

3\. Appointment Setting

The Telecaller will be responsible for scheduling qualified prospects with the:

* Business Development Executive
* Sales Executive
* Sales Head
* Relevant Amplus Team Member

Before scheduling a meeting, the Telecaller should ensure that the basic requirement and interest of the prospect are understood.

4\. Follow\-Up Calls

* Follow up with interested prospects.
* Follow up on scheduled meetings.
* Reconnect with prospects who requested a callback.
* Follow up on incomplete information.
* Maintain systematic calling schedules.
* Reactivate older leads wherever relevant.

5\. WhatsApp \& Communication

Where appropriate:

* Share approved Amplus information.
* Send meeting confirmations.
* Send basic company/service information.
* Follow up professionally through WhatsApp.
* Maintain professional communication standards.

Only company\-approved information should be shared.

6\. CRM MANAGEMENT

Every meaningful conversation must be updated in CRM.

CRM information should include:

* Lead name
* Company name
* Contact details
* Lead source
* Industry
* Requirement
* Qualification status
* Conversation outcome
* Meeting status
* Follow\-up date
* Next action
* Remarks

**No important lead should remain without a defined next action.**

7\. LEAD NURTURING

Not every prospect will be immediately ready.

The Telecaller should:

* Identify interested but not\-ready prospects.
* Maintain follow\-up dates.
* Reconnect at the appropriate time.
* Share approved information where required.
* Move suitable prospects toward a sales conversation.

8\. COORDINATION WITH SALES TEAM

The Telecaller will work closely with the BDE/Sales Team.

Responsibilities include:

* Informing the salesperson about qualified leads.
* Providing relevant lead background before meetings.
* Confirming scheduled appointments.
* Updating meeting outcomes.
* Following up on missed appointments.
* Supporting lead reactivation.

IMPORTANT: NO FALSE COMMITMENTS

The Telecaller must **never guarantee**:

* Subsidy amount
* Eligibility
* Government approval
* Sanction
* Processing timeline
* Financial benefit

The correct approach is to communicate that the requirement will be assessed and eligibility/benefit will be validated by the relevant Amplus team.

This is particularly important because subsidy eligibility and benefit amounts require proper validation.

REQUIRED SKILLSCommunication Skills

* Clear verbal communication
* Active listening
* Good questioning ability
* Professional telephone etiquette
* Confidence while speaking
* Ability to communicate in English/Hindi/Marathi

Sales Skills

* Outbound calling
* Lead qualification
* Appointment setting
* Follow\-up
* Basic objection handling
* Lead nurturing

Technical Skills

* Basic computer knowledge
* CRM usage
* WhatsApp
* Email
* Google Sheets / Excel
* Basic internet research

IDEAL CANDIDATE

We are looking for someone who is:

* Confident on calls
* Energetic
* Positive
* Patient
* Good listener
* Target\-oriented
* Comfortable making multiple calls
* Persistent but polite
* Professional
* Willing to learn
* Comfortable using CRM
* Comfortable speaking with business owners

EDUCATION \& EXPERIENCE

**Education:**

* 12th Pass / Graduate
* Graduate preferred

**Experience:**

* 0–2 years
* Freshers can apply
* Telecalling experience preferred
* BPO / Inside Sales / Customer Calling / Lead Generation experience is an advantage
* B2B calling experience is an advantage

Freshers with strong communication skills and a positive learning attitude are welcome.

KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs)

Performance will be evaluated on:

Activity KPIs

* Daily outbound calls
* Meaningful conversations
* Follow\-ups completed
* Leads contacted

Quality KPIs

* Qualified leads
* Appointment rate
* Meeting attendance rate
* Lead\-to\-opportunity quality

Discipline KPIs

* CRM accuracy
* Follow\-up completion
* Calling discipline
* Timely updates

Business KPIs

* Qualified opportunities generated
* Meetings converted into opportunities
* Contribution to sales pipeline

**Quality of conversations is more important than simply making a high number of calls.**

DAILY RESPONSIBILITIES

A typical day may include:

**Morning**

* Review assigned leads
* Prioritize follow\-ups
* Plan daily calling

**During the day**

* Make outbound calls
* Qualify prospects
* Schedule meetings
* Follow up with interested leads
* Coordinate with BDE/Sales Team

**End of day**

* Update CRM
* Complete pending follow\-ups
* Review appointments
* Report important lead developments

CAREER GROWTH

**Telecaller / Inside Sales Executive**  
↓  
**Senior Telecaller / Inside Sales Executive**  
↓  
**Business Development Executive**  
↓  
**Senior BDE / Sales Executive**  
↓  
**Business Development Manager**  
↓  
**Sales Manager**

WHO SHOULD NOT APPLY?

This role may not be suitable for someone who:

* Does not enjoy speaking on calls
* Is uncomfortable making outbound calls
* Does not want targets
* Avoids follow\-ups
* Is unwilling to learn
* Does not maintain CRM
* Gives false commitments to prospects
* Requires constant supervision
* Gives up easily after rejection

CORE SUCCESS STATEMENT

**Your responsibility is to turn conversations into qualified opportunities.**

A great Telecaller at Amplus does not simply make calls.

They **identify the right businesses, understand their basic requirements, create interest, qualify genuine opportunities, schedule quality meetings and maintain disciplined follow\-ups.**

* Good communication and interpersonal skills

* Basic MS Excel / Google Sheets knowledge
* Ability to communicate professionally with candidates and employees
* Willingness to learn HR processes

title: HR Intern
description:
Instawork is on a mission to create meaningful economic opportunities for skilled hourly professionals in communities around the globe. Our AI\-powered labor marketplace helps local businesses scale, and enables global technology companies to push the frontiers of robotics and AI. Backed by world\-class investors like Benchmark, Spark Capital, Craft Ventures, Greylock, Y Combinator, and others, we’re looking for exceptional talent to reimagine the way the world works.
   

  

* 📍 Location: Koramangala, Bangalore
* 🕒 Working Days: 6 days/week, 1 rotational weekly off
* ⏰ Shift Timings: 9:00 AM – 7:00 PM (Standard office hours)
* 💼 Experience: Fresher (0–1 year)
* 📅 Contract Duration: 3 Months


**About The Role**
 We are looking for a highly motivated and highly organized Talent Acquisition Intern to join our team at Instawork. In this role, you will get hands\-on experience working on end\-to\-end recruitment, serving as the critical bridge between our hiring teams and prospective candidates.
   

  

 If you enjoy speaking with people, thrive in a fast\-paced environment, and want to build a strong foundation in human resources and talent acquisition, this opportunity is a great starting point.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Manage End\-to\-End Recruitment: Support the full recruitment lifecycle for various open positions.
* High\-Volume Outreach: Source, screen, and make 100–150 outbound calls daily to prospective candidates.
* Interview Coordination: Take ownership of lining up and scheduling interviews between candidates and internal hiring teams.
* Candidate Communication: Manage ongoing follow\-ups, gather feedback, and ensure a smooth and positive candidate experience throughout the hiring journey.
* Data Management: Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date records of calls, candidate statuses, and interview schedules.


**Requirements**
* Excellent verbal communication skills with a confident and professional phone presence.
* Strong organizational skills, multitasking abilities, and exceptional attention to detail (crucial for interview coordination).
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced, high\-volume calling environment.
* Prior experience in HR, recruitment, or customer\-facing roles is preferred but not mandatory.


**Compensation \& Benefits** 
  

  

* 💰 Base Stipend: ₹20,000 per month
* 🍱 Food Allowance: ₹200 per day
* Perks \& Benefits:
+ Collaborative team culture and vibrant office environment.
+ Hands\-on exposure to full\-cycle talent acquisition and HR operations.
+ Strong career growth opportunities by learning the core mechanics of tech and business hiring.


**Our Values**
* Empathy, Trust \& Candor We put ourselves in the shoes of our colleagues and customers and don’t shy away from uncomfortable conversations, instead building trust through honest and direct feedback.
* Bias for Action We practice high\-velocity decision\-making, clear\-eyed that we often operate with incomplete information. Growing quickly means it’s OK to be wrong, so long as we learn from our mistakes and course correct!
* Always Be Learning We’re a curious bunch, and with AI transforming our workplace we encourage everyone to learn from each other, compounding our knowledge and experience to help us change an entire industry.
* Act Like an Owner We work long, hard, and smart, building products that delight our users and drive growth. Your ability to impact Instawork is limited only by your courage and conviction, not your job description.


**About Instawork**
 Founded in 2015, Instawork is the nation’s leading online labor marketplace for food services, hospitality, light industry, and logistics, connecting more than 7M skilled workers with local restaurants, hotels, warehouses, stadiums, and more. Our AI\-powered platform serves thousands of businesses across more than 50 major markets in the United States and Canada. We're not just helping fill shifts, we're supporting local economies—and we're just getting started!
   

  

 Instawork has been featured by CBS News, The Wall Street Journal, The Washington Post, and the Associated Press. Forbes included us on their Next Billion Dollar Startups list; RetailTech Breakthrough named us Workforce Hiring Solution of the Year for 2025; and Inc. 5000 recognized us as one of the country's top 10% fastest\-growing companies two years in a row. But what matters most is our impact. We're solving real problems for real people, and we’re doing it at scale.
   

  

 Join our team to help us build something that matters! We’re looking for superstars who want to help us shape the future of work. With hubs in San Francisco, Bangalore, and Chicago, city offices in New York, Phoenix, and Singapore, we're back to working together in\-person five days a week because we believe the best ideas happen when great people collaborate face\-to\-face. We also value diverse perspectives and encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds.
   

  

 Ready to make an impact? Learn more at www.instawork.com/about.

Earthful is building India's most trusted clean\-label, plant\-based wellness brand for women's health, backed by Fireside Ventures and V3 Ventures. Hiring well is core to how we grow, and this role is where a lot of that hiring actually gets done — sourcing, screening, coordinating and closing the people who join our creative, marketing, sales and operations teams.
 



  





**Office Location : Mumbai, Lower Parel** 




  





**Role Overview** 




 The TA Intern is the engine room of hiring at Earthful — the person who keeps candidates moving, interviews on calendar, and the applicant tracker honest. You'll work closely with the founders and hiring managers across functions, getting real, hands\-on exposure to how an early\-stage D2C brand builds its team. This is a fresher\-friendly role: you don't need prior recruitment experience, just strong communication, ownership, and a genuine interest in how great teams get built. You'll learn to evaluate candidates, not just find them, and you'll have a direct hand in closing the people Earthful eventually hires.
 



  





**What You'll Own** 



* Screen candidates for open roles using job portals and LinkedIn, building shortlists hiring managers can act on quickly.
* Schedule and coordinate interviews with hiring managers, keeping both sides informed on next steps.
* Coordinate with candidates through the process and follow up on assignments so nothing quietly stalls.
* Update the applicant tracking system (ATS) with accurate, current candidate details.
* Assist in creating job descriptions and posting roles across the right portals.



  





**What We're Looking For** 



* Freshers are welcome; 0–1 year of experience is a plus, not a requirement.
* Able to work full\-time, in\-office, from our Lower Parel, Mumbai location.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills — comfortable speaking with candidates and senior team members alike.
* High ownership, urgency and attention to detail.
* Genuine interest in talent acquisition, startups and D2C brands, rather than a generic "any internship will do" attitude.
* A degree in HR, Business Administration or a related field is a plus, though not a requirement.

title: Trainee - Recruitment Coordinator
description:
**About The Team**
 Our Human Resources team operates as a strategic partner to the business, focused on cultivating a high\-performance culture where exceptional talent thrives. Our work is fundamentally guided by the DICE (Democratize Internet Commerce for Everyone) mission, which underpins our approach to all people strategies. Our core mandate centers on two critical pillars: driving world\-class Talent Density and continuously elevating Employee Experience. We achieve this by relentlessly attracting, developing, and retaining the highest caliber of professionals, ensuring that every individual contributes significantly to our success. Concurrently, we are committed to shaping an unparalleled employee experience—one defined by transparent communication, meaningful development, and a deeply engaging, inclusive culture. As stewards of the company's most valuable asset—its people—we design, implement, and champion people strategies that directly translate into sustained business growth and a position as one of India’s most sought\-after e\-commerce destinations.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As Talent Acquisition Trainee, you’ll work closely with the TA team and will help in handling the hiring process for our multiple vacancies. You’ll work on numbers, and get an idea of what a metrics\-driven team looks like. You'll also support the team in preparing reports and dashboards.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Collaborate with all stakeholders through strong candidate/employee/alumni orientation.
* Scheduling and coordinating interviews for candidates while ensuring good candidate experience.
* Coordinating for the end\-to\-end interview process.
* Managing virtual interview drives \& events.
* Creating job\-posts; assisting with screening of resumes and applications; communicating effective feedback to the candidates.
* Preparation of reports and dashboards, updating data as and when needed.


**What You Will Need**
* 0\-1 years of similar experience(s) are preferred; Freshers can apply.
* Graduate/Post\-Graduation required.
* Preferred experience in recruitment in a fast\-moving, high\-growth/large\-scale organization.
* Ability to communicate effectively with stakeholders and candidates.

title: HR MANAGER (Compliances)
description:
Job Description – HR Manager (Payroll \& Compliance)

**Position:** HR Manager – Payroll \& Compliance (IMMEDIATE JOINER)  
**Department:** Human Resources  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Experience:** 5–8\+ years, preferably with strong hands\-on experience in payroll and statutory compliances  
**Location:** VIKASPURI

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced **HR Manager** with strong knowledge of **payroll processing, statutory compliances, labour laws, HR operations, and employee lifecycle management**.

The candidate should be capable of independently managing monthly payroll, statutory deductions and filings, employee records, HR policies, attendance and leave management, compliance documentation, and coordination with Finance, consultants, auditors, and government authorities.

The role requires a person who is **hands\-on, detail\-oriented, process\-driven, and capable of ensuring error\-free payroll and timely statutory compliance**.

Key ResponsibilitiesPayroll Management

* Independently manage **monthly payroll processing** for employees.
* Verify attendance, leaves, incentives, bonuses, deductions, reimbursements, arrears, and other payroll inputs.
* Ensure accurate calculation of salary, overtime, incentives, full \& final settlements, and statutory deductions.
* Manage employee salary structures including **CTC, Gross Salary, Basic, HRA, allowances, employer contributions, and deductions**.
* Prepare payroll reports, salary sheets, bank transfer files, and salary slips.
* Reconcile monthly payroll with employee records and coordinate with the Finance/Accounts team.

Statutory \& Labour Law Compliance

* Ensure timely and accurate compliance relating to:
* **EPF / PF**
* **ESI**
* **Payment of Gratuity**
* **Payment of Bonus**
* **Minimum Wages**
* **Leave and Holiday regulations**
* **Maternity Benefit provisions**
* **POSH compliance**
* Other applicable labour and employment laws.
* Ensure timely deposit of statutory contributions and filing of applicable returns.
* Maintain all statutory registers, records, challans, returns, and employee documentation.
* Monitor changes in labour laws and ensure implementation of necessary changes in company policies and payroll.
* Coordinate with labour consultants, auditors, PF/ESI authorities, and other statutory bodies whenever required.
* Support statutory, internal, and payroll audits and ensure proper closure of observations.

HR Operations

* Manage the complete **employee lifecycle** from joining to separation.
* Prepare and maintain:
* Offer Letters
* Appointment Letters
* Confirmation Letters
* Increment / Promotion Letters
* Transfer Letters
* Warning / Disciplinary Letters
* Experience and Relieving Letters
* Manage employee onboarding, documentation, background verification, confirmation, transfers, and exits.
* Maintain complete and updated employee personnel files and HR database.
* Handle attendance, leave records, biometric data, and employee master records.
* Manage **Full \& Final Settlement (F\&F)** and exit formalities.
* Ensure proper recovery of company assets and clearance at the time of separation.

HR Policies \& Employee Relations

* Draft, implement, and regularly update HR policies and SOPs.
* Ensure employees understand and comply with company policies.
* Handle employee grievances and disciplinary matters in a professional and confidential manner.
* Support management in performance management, increments, promotions, and manpower planning.
* Drive employee engagement and maintain a positive work environment.
* Assist management in resolving employee\-related issues while balancing employee welfare and organizational requirements.

Recruitment \& Manpower Management

* Coordinate manpower requirements with department heads.
* Manage recruitment for junior, middle, and managerial positions as required.
* Screen candidates, coordinate interviews, negotiate compensation, and manage joining formalities.
* Maintain recruitment MIS and monitor open positions and hiring timelines.

HR MIS \& Reporting

* Prepare and maintain periodic HR MIS relating to:
* Headcount
* Payroll
* Attendance
* Leave
* Attrition
* New Joiners
* Separations
* Recruitment
* Statutory compliance
* Employee cost
* Provide accurate HR data and reports to management for decision\-making.
* Maintain confidentiality and accuracy of employee and payroll information.

Required Skills \& Knowledge

* Strong practical knowledge of **Indian payroll processing and statutory compliance**.
* Sound understanding of **PF, ESI, Gratuity, Bonus, Minimum Wages, Maternity Benefits, POSH, and applicable labour laws**.
* Good knowledge of **salary taxation and TDS on salary**.
* Strong understanding of payroll reconciliation and employee cost calculations.
* Good knowledge of attendance, leave, F\&F settlement, and employee lifecycle processes.
* Ability to independently handle statutory filings, documentation, and compliance calendars.
* Strong command of **MS Excel**, including VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, IF formulas, and payroll\-related data analysis.
* Experience with HRMS / Payroll software will be preferred.
* Strong communication, drafting, interpersonal, and problem\-solving skills.
* High level of confidentiality, accuracy, and integrity.
* Ability to coordinate effectively with Finance, Management, Auditors, Consultants, and Government Authorities.

Educational Qualification

* MBA / PGDM in Human Resources, MHRM, or equivalent qualification.
* Additional qualification or certification in **Payroll, Labour Laws, or HR Compliance** will be an advantage.

Preferred Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate should be a **hands\-on HR professional rather than only a policy\-level manager**. The candidate must have personally handled payroll and statutory compliances and should be comfortable taking complete ownership of HR operations.

Preference will be given to candidates who have independently managed:

**Payroll \+ PF \+ ESI \+ Labour Compliance \+ TDS on Salary \+ Attendance \& Leave \+ F\&F \+ Employee Documentation \+ HR MIS.**

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* 100% accurate and timely payroll processing.
* Zero delay in statutory deposits and returns.
* Zero major observations in payroll/statutory audits.
* Accurate and updated employee records.
* Timely completion of joining, confirmation, and exit formalities.
* Effective closure of employee grievances and HR issues.
* Accurate HR MIS and management reporting.
* Timely closure of recruitment requirements.

Pay: ₹15,662\.43 \- ₹54,652\.61 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Senior Manager – Human Resources (Fluent Hindi Mandatory)
description:
Senior Manager – Human Resources (Fluent Hindi Mandatory)
 



**Company:** 
 Amadora Gourmet Ice Cream Pvt Ltd
 **Location:** 
 Chennai (Velachery) — with travel to Bangalore and Hyderabad
 **Reports to:** 
 Managing Director
 **Team:** 
 HR \& Admin executives, recruitment support
 **Employment type:** 
 Full\-time, on\-site
 



 About Amadora
 



 Amadora is a premium artisanal ice cream brand founded in Chennai in 2011\. Everything we sell is made from scratch at our central kitchen — no premixes, no shortcuts. We operate roughly 30 company\-owned and franchise stores across Chennai, Bangalore and Hyderabad, alongside a growing bakery, sauces and frozen novelty line. We are in an active expansion phase, which means the HR function has to scale ahead of the store count rather than behind it.
 



 Role Summary
 



 We are looking for a Senior Manager – HR who can own the entire people function end to end: hiring, payroll, documentation, statutory compliance and the HR team itself. A large share of our kitchen, production and store workforce is drawn from Hindi\-speaking states, so
 **fluency in Hindi is non\-negotiable** 
 — you will interview, onboard, counsel and resolve grievances in Hindi every single day. This is a hands\-on role in a founder\-led business; you will build the systems and also run them until the team is deep enough to take over.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



 End\-to\-End Recruitment
 


* Own the full hiring cycle for all roles — store crew, production and kitchen staff, supervisors, and corporate/management positions across all three cities.
* Build and maintain a reliable sourcing pipeline: migrant labour channels and contractors, hotel management and catering institutes, job portals, referral schemes and local walk\-in drives.
* Run screening, interviews, salary negotiation, offer rollout and document verification; keep offer\-to\-joining drop\-offs low with structured follow\-up.
* Maintain a live manpower plan against store openings and seasonal peaks, so hiring starts before the vacancy bites.
* Own onboarding and induction end to end, including accommodation coordination and documentation for outstation hires.



 Managing the HR Team
 


* Lead, allocate work to and develop the HR and admin executives; set weekly priorities and review output.
* Build capability in the team so recruitment, payroll input and compliance filing continue without escalation to you or the MD.
* Act as the single escalation point for people issues across the central kitchen, stores and franchise network.



 Payroll
 


* Own the monthly payroll cycle end to end — attendance and biometric reconciliation, leave, overtime, incentives, deductions, full\-and\-final settlements — and close it on a fixed date every month with zero slippage.
* Validate payroll inputs against rosters and store\-level attendance before processing; investigate and resolve discrepancies rather than passing them through.
* Coordinate with Accounts on salary disbursement, payroll accruals, reimbursements and statutory payments.
* Maintain salary structures and bands, and support the MD on compensation benchmarking and revision cycles.



 HR Documentation
 


* Maintain complete, audit\-ready employee files: offer letters, appointment letters, KYC and ID documents, background checks, confirmation letters, increment and transfer letters, warning letters and exit paperwork.
* Own and keep current the employee handbook, HR policies, SOPs and the code of conduct; ensure they are communicated in both Hindi and Tamil where the workforce requires it.
* Maintain the HRMS/employee database and all trackers — headcount, attrition, leave, probation and confirmation status — as the single source of truth.
* Draft and issue all disciplinary documentation, show\-cause notices and inquiry records in a legally defensible format.



 Statutory Compliance
 


* Ensure full compliance across all locations with PF, ESI, Professional Tax, Gratuity, Bonus, Shops \& Establishments, Labour Welfare Fund, Contract Labour (Regulation \& Abolition) Act and POSH.
* Manage timely returns, challans, registrations and renewals; maintain statutory registers for every establishment.
* Handle labour department inspections, notices and audits, and coordinate with consultants and legal counsel where required.
* Ensure contractor and third\-party manpower compliance, including verification of their statutory filings.
* Constitute and run the Internal Committee under POSH; conduct mandatory awareness sessions.



 Employee Relations \& Engagement
 


* Manage grievances, disciplinary action and conflict resolution across a largely frontline workforce.
* Run confirmation and performance review cycles; work with Operations and Training on appraisal inputs.
* Drive retention initiatives and track attrition by store, role and tenure with actual root\-cause analysis.
* Conduct exit interviews and convert findings into corrective action.



 Qualifications \& Competencies
 


* MBA/PGDM in HR or equivalent; 8–12 years of HR experience with at least 3 years in a managerial capacity.
* **Fluency in Hindi is mandatory** 
 — speaking, reading and writing. You will use it daily with the kitchen, production and store workforce. English is required; Tamil is a strong advantage.
* Proven end\-to\-end ownership of payroll and statutory compliance for a workforce of 200\+, ideally multi\-state.
* Background in food service, QSR, retail, hospitality or manufacturing strongly preferred — high\-volume frontline hiring and high attrition are the norm here, not the exception.
* Working knowledge of Indian labour law and hands\-on experience handling inspections and audits.
* Strong Excel skills and comfort with HRMS/payroll software and biometric attendance systems.
* Ability to operate independently in a founder\-led, fast\-moving business with limited support structures — this is a builder's role, not a caretaker's.
* Willingness to travel to Bangalore and Hyderabad, and to be present at stores and the central kitchen, including during peak season.



 What Success Looks Like (First 12 Months)
 


* Time\-to\-fill for store and kitchen roles is cut to under 15 days, with a standing pipeline that lets new store openings be staffed before launch day rather than after.
* Payroll closes on the same fixed date every month with under 1% error rate, and full\-and\-final settlements are completed within 30 days of exit.
* Zero statutory non\-compliance findings across Chennai, Bangalore and Hyderabad; all registers, returns and registrations current and inspection\-ready at any time.
* Employee documentation is 100% complete and digitised — every active employee has a full file, and confirmation, increment and exit letters are issued on time without prompting.
* Frontline attrition is reduced measurably against the current baseline, with the drivers identified store by store and at least two retention interventions implemented and tracked.
* The HR team runs recruitment, payroll input and compliance filing independently, escalating only exceptions.

Description \- About the role
-----------------------------



You’d be doing a wide variety of things \- talking to the Founding team and CXOs to understand what they are looking for in the crucial person to join their team. Then, picking people who you think are up for the challenge. Communicating and coordinating with them to get a candidate placed in the firm. You’d also analyse trends in which candidates get selected, use internal tools to find the best talent, and understand trends across industries.

This role could **lead to a Founder’s office** role in a year or two.
Who are we looking for:
-----------------------


**An exceptional communicator**: Your communication is clear, you have the ability to communicate with CXOs confidently, and you can talk to candidates with clarity and empathy. The energy and enthusiasm to talk, express and “listen” in a conversation. English fluency is a must, and other languages are a plus.
**Hustler mindset**: high agency, strong personal accountability, and a preference for direct hands\-on execution \- essentially a go\-getter attitude.
**Coachable, detail\-oriented and action\-oriented**: You are willing to learn, absorb feedback rapidly, and adapt accordingly, looking forward to acting and not just observing. You have a keen eye for detail, and you don’t let go until your final work is polished.
**No hiring experience is required**; you’ll learn in our 4\-6 week training program \- you get full pay during this period :)
What’s in it for you
--------------------


**Recruitment**: You’d learn the skills to be a world class recruiter in a couple of years
**Conversations with Business leaders**: You get to interact with Founders (on the hiring front) and top talent across the world (on the recruitment side). Build an invaluable network across the world’s best talent.
**Regular interaction with leadership**: Currently, we are a very small team, so you'll interact and learn directly from the founders and the leadership team.
**Work from anywhere**: We are happy for you to work from home or the mountains or the beach, as long as you have a stable internet connection.
**Insurance coverage**: We have strong insurance coverage to protect you in case of an unfortunate incident.
**Team events**: We are a fun, young team, so you decide how it could be :)
The recruitment process
-----------------------



We value your time; the whole process is planned in a way that we’ll wrap up in 5 \- 10 days.  

**HR Round**: Let’s get to know each other and we’d want to clarify about the role
**Group Discussion**: We’d like to see you work with your peers
**Arithmetic ability test**: Let’s assess your analytical and arithmetic skills
**Interview with Hiring managers**: The people you’d work with will want to know you
**Interaction with a founder**: A brief conversation before you join Weekday, with one of the founders to see if Weekday is a good fit for you and vice\-versa.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

 We are looking for a customer obsessed Business Intelligence Engineer who is comfortable with ambiguity and excited to build intelligence systems that help Account Managers and leaders make better, faster decisions at scale. You should be comfortable working across the full stack of BI and applied ML: writing production SQL, building data pipelines, developing and evaluating ML models (classification, scoring, ensemble methods), designing MCP tool definitions and knowledge schemas, and delivering actionable insights through dashboards and AI powered interfaces. You will work closely with product, science, and engineering teams
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Design and build MCP server as a centralized knowledge repository, exposing lead context, seller signals, program rules, and historical outcomes to AI agents and tools across Amazon MCP compliant platforms
* Develop and maintain ML driven scoring and prioritization models (intent scoring, conversion prediction, multi signal ensemble models) working alongside the shared Data Scientist, with ownership of feature engineering, model evaluation, and production deployment
* Create, support and continuously improve reports and metrics that support the business operations
* Design and implement data pipelines (SQL, Python, Airflow) that process seller signals, engagement data, and pipeline metrics into actionable intelligence
* Drive automation of repetitive reporting and assignment tasks to scale intelligence delivery across regions
* Convert data into digestible business intelligence and actionable information using tools like QuickSight/Tableau
* Shape and deliver key metrics, reports, and indicators by which our business will assess its performance
* Dive deep into large data sets to answer specific business questions using Excel, SQL and other data manipulation languages
* Work directly with business teams to utilize metrics and analysis to determine improvement opportunities
* Identify process improvement opportunities and drive automation to scale reporting solutions
* Mentor junior analysts and provide guidance on best practices for data analysis and reporting
* Independently manage end\-to\-end project delivery with minimal supervision


**Basic Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of analyzing and interpreting data with Redshift, Oracle, NoSQL etc. experience
* 2\+ years of Tableau Desktop, Quicksight or other relevant data visualization software experience
* Bachelor's degree or above in business administration, finance, economics, computer science, data science, engineering, or other related field, or 2\+ years of Amazon RME (BB/3P) Full Time Exempt experience
* Experience with data visualization using Tableau, Quicksight, or similar tools
* Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines
* Experience in Statistical Analysis packages such as R, SAS and Matlab
* Experience using SQL to pull data from a database or data warehouse and scripting experience (Python) to process data for modeling
* Experience using SQL (Structured Query Language) to pull data from a database or data warehouse
* Experience using Python scripting to process data for modeling
* Proficiency in Python for data manipulation, automation, and ML model development


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Master's degree or above in BI, finance, engineering, statistics, computer science, mathematics or equivalent quantitative field
* Knowledge of Microsoft Excel at an advanced level, including: pivot tables, macros, index/match, vlookup, VBA, data links, etc.
* Experience with AWS solutions such as EC2, DynamoDB, S3, and Redshift
* Experience in data mining, ETL, etc. and using databases in a business environment with large\-scale, complex datasets
* Experience developing and presenting recommendations of new metrics allowing better understanding of the performance of the business
* Experience building or integrating with MCP servers, API gateways, or similar knowledge serving architectures
* Experience with ML model deployment in production: scoring pipelines, A/B testing frameworks, model monitoring and retraining

* Collaborate with business stakeholders and other teams to gather requirements and deliver technology solutions.

* Experience designing and developing Power BI dashboards, reports, and data visualizations, with strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, to support business reporting, analytics, KPI tracking, and data\-driven decision\-making.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills, with experience supporting business\-critical applications in production environments.
* Experience in requirements gathering, feasibility analysis, business process analysis, documenting functional and technical requirements, and translating business needs into scalable technical solutions.
* Familiarity with ServiceNow and enterprise IT processes, including managing requests related to server provisioning, environment setup, access management, configuration changes, infrastructure support, and production deployments.
* Knowledge of SQL databases, system integrations, application architecture concepts.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, documentation, and collaboration skills, with the ability to effectively engage business users, technical teams, and cross\-functional stakeholders.
