title: Core AI & Computer Vision Systems Engineer
description:
**Position Title:** 
 Real\-Time Computer Vision \& Edge AI Engineer (Founding Engineering Team / Core LLD)
   

**Reporting Structure:** 
 High\-Level AI Architect (Principal ML Scientist, Google)
   

**Domain:** 
 Sub\-16ms Edge AI, 3D Pose \& Shape Estimation (SMPL\-X), TensorRT C\+\+ Inference, Zero\-Copy Systems
   

**Performance Benchmark:** 
 Hard locked 60 FPS (\<16\.6 ms total frame budget) on dedicated RTX hardware
   

**1\. Position Overview \& Architecture**
 We are building a proprietary, ultra\-low\-latency spatial computing platform centered on high\-fidelity 100% 3D Digital Twin architecture and real\-time human digitization.
   

 In this role, you will serve as the Low\-Level Design (LLD) Core AI Engineer, working directly alongside a Lead AI Scientist from Google. Your primary mandate is to solve complex surface occlusion and volumetric estimation challenges by building an ultra\-fast C\+\+ inference pipeline. This system must accurately regress a subject's true underlying 3D body shape and skeletal pose directly from a live camera feed. You will deploy models that extract parametric data (SMPL\-X shape/pose parameters) and bridge these joint rotations seamlessly into our Vulkan graphics engine via shared GPU memory.
   

**System Architecture:**
 ● Hardware Camera Ingestion: (V4L2 / GStreamer / CUDA)
   

*↓ Raw RGB Frames (Zero CPU Copy)*
 ● Edge AI Inference: (TensorRT / ONNX C\+\+ API for 3D Pose Tracking, Kinematic Anchoring, SMPL\-X Shape)
   

*↓ 3D Skeletal Transforms \& Shape Parameters*
 ● Zero\-Copy Shared Memory: (CUDA\-Vulkan Bridge feeding directly into OpenRigLogic / MetaHuman Engine)
   

  

**2\. Key Responsibilities \& Deliverables**
**A. Real\-Time 3D Pose \& Shape Estimation**
 ● Deploy and optimize state\-of\-the\-art 3D human body reconstruction models (e.g., Shapy, SMPLify\-X, CLIFF) to accurately regress the user's underlying skeletal structure and body volume, effectively bypassing unpredictable surface topologies and complex environmental occlusions.
   

 ● Extract mathematically stable shape parameters (β) and pose parameters (θ) to drive the skeletal hierarchy of a high\-fidelity digital avatar.
   

**B. Edge Inference Pipeline (TensorRT)**
 ● Translate Python\-based research models into production\-grade C\+\+ inference engines using NVIDIA TensorRT and ONNX Runtime.
   

 ● Implement INT8/FP16 quantization, layer fusion, and custom CUDA plugins to ensure the entire AI inference pass executes within a strict \<10 ms budget per frame.
   

**C. Temporal Smoothing \& Anti\-Jitter Kinematics**
 ● Implement highly optimized temporal filters (Kalman filters, One\-Euro filters, optical flow tracking) in native C\+\+ to eliminate all high\-frequency jitter from the output joint rotations before they reach the graphics engine.
   

 ● Ensure kinematic constraints (e.g., fixed bone lengths) are strictly maintained to prevent the digital asset from stretching or warping dynamically.
   

**D. Zero\-Copy Ingestion \& Engine Synchronization**
 ● Build hardware\-accelerated video capture pipelines using V4L2 or GStreamer to ingest raw camera frames directly into GPU memory.
   

 ● Bridge the output coordinate data and transformation matrices to the graphics team using POSIX shared memory and CUDA\-Vulkan interop (VK\_KHR\_external\_memory\_fd), eliminating CPU staging overhead.
   

  

**3\. Technical Qualifications \& Tech Stack**
 ● Core Programming: Production\-level Modern C\+\+ (C\+\+17/20\), Python (strictly for model training/validation), and CUDA C/C\+\+.
   

 ● AI \& Acceleration Frameworks: NVIDIA TensorRT, ONNX Runtime (C\+\+ API), PyTorch.
   

 ● Computer Vision Libraries: OpenCV (CUDA backend), MediaPipe C\+\+ bindings.
   

 ● Mathematical Foundations: 3D Kinematics, Matrix Transformations, Quaternions/Euler angles, statistical body modeling (SMPL/SMPL\-X architecture).
   

 ● Systems Architecture: Low\-latency memory management, multi\-threading (std::jthread, lock\-free queues), SIMD vectorization.
   

  

**4\. Relevant Projects \& Demonstrable Experience (Preferred)**
 Candidates will be preferred if they present functional codebases, GitHub repositories, or thesis work covering:
   

 ● Real\-Time Body Fitting / Pose Estimation: Practical experience deploying 3D human pose or shape reconstruction models on live video feeds.
   

 ● TensorRT / C\+\+ Deployment: Demonstrable experience stripping a PyTorch model out of Python and running it natively in C\+\+ using TensorRT or ONNX, ideally with custom CUDA layers or INT8 calibration.
   

 ● High\-Throughput Vision Pipelines: Built a C\+\+ video processing pipeline that aggressively minimizes latency and avoids memory garbage collection pauses.
   

 ● Kinematics \& Smoothing: Applied mathematical filters to raw sensor or AI data to produce smooth, mechanically accurate 3D rotations.
   

  

**5\. Compensation \& Engagement Structure**
 ● Compensation: ₹1,00,000 to ₹2,00,000/month
   

 ● Mentorship: Direct architectural guidance, algorithm review, and technical leadership from a Principal ML Scientist at Google.
   

 ● Hardware: Dedicated high\-end workstation equipped with discrete NVIDIA RTX hardware.

title: Maintenance Technician
description:
**Preventive Maintenance**
* Level 1: Perform simple preventive maintenance operations according to standard operating procedures and schedules.
* Level 2: Prepare and perform preventive maintenance on all equipment (electrotechnical, automated, mechanical, pneumatic, hydraulic, etc.). Work on programmable logic controllers, robots, and manipulators.
* Level 3: Study, prepare, and perform preventive maintenance on all factory equipment, including programmable logic controllers, robots, and manipulators.


**Corrective Maintenance**
* Level 1: Intervene on machinery to resolve simple breakdowns under the supervision of a more qualified technician. Analyze failure causes and propose improvements. Perform necessary modifications on equipment.
* Level 2: Resolve breakdowns autonomously. Analyze and implement modifications on equipment across all technical domains. Improve reliability, capacity, and maintainability.
* Level 3: Propose and implement actions to improve reliability, capacity, and maintainability using new technologies.


**Other Activities**
* Level 1: Actively participate in the maintenance workshop's 5S program. Participate in QRQC (Quick Response Quality Control) within their domain. Update intervention tracking logs to ensure traceability.
* Level 2: Participate in daily and monthly meetings as well as improvement workshops. Contribute to specifications during the receipt and commissioning of new resources.
* Level 3: Lead improvement projects, consult with subcontractors, and guarantee follow\-up and results. Draft and distribute assembly, disassembly, or adjustment procedures and provide training.

description:
**Company:** Amplus Subsidy Solutions  
**Department:** Business Development \& Sales  
**Job Title:** Business Development Executive (BDE)  
**Reporting To:** Sales Head / CEO  
**Location:** Nashik, Maharashtra  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Experience:** 1–3 Years preferred  
**Education:** Graduate  
**Industry:** Government Subsidy, MSME, Manufacturing \& Business Consulting

ABOUT AMPLUS

Amplus Subsidy Solutions works with MSMEs, manufacturers and entrepreneurs to help them identify and access relevant **Government Subsidies, Incentives, Finance\-linked Schemes, Compliances, Licences, Approvals and Project\-related Government Support**.

Our objective is to become a trusted business partner for MSMEs by helping entrepreneurs understand and access opportunities available through Government policies and schemes.

We are building a high\-performance, knowledge\-driven, ethical and result\-oriented business development team.

PURPOSE OF THE ROLE

The Business Development Executive will be responsible for **generating qualified business opportunities, developing relationships with MSME owners and manufacturers, understanding their business requirements and converting genuine opportunities into meetings, proposals and clients.**

The role involves both **business development and consultative selling**.

The BDE should be able to move a prospect through:

**Prospecting → Qualification → Discovery → Meeting → Opportunity → Proposal → Follow\-up → Closure**

The candidate should focus not only on selling a service, but on understanding:

**“What is the client trying to achieve, and what Government support or professional assistance may be relevant?”**

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES1\. Lead Generation \& Prospecting**

* Identify MSMEs, manufacturers, industrial businesses and entrepreneurs.
* Generate leads through:
* Outbound calling
* LinkedIn
* WhatsApp
* Email
* Industrial areas
* Business associations
* Exhibitions and events
* Referrals
* Existing databases
* Networking
* Build and maintain a healthy prospect pipeline.
* Identify promoters, founders, directors and decision\-makers.

**2\. Lead Qualification**

Understand and record important client information such as:

* Industry
* Manufacturing activity
* Location
* New project / expansion / modernization
* Investment size
* Machinery investment
* Turnover
* Employment
* Udyam/MSME status
* Land/building status
* Project stage
* Existing approvals
* Subsidy/incentive requirement
* Compliance requirement
* Financing requirement
* Expected project timeline
* Decision\-making authority

The BDE must distinguish between:

**Lead → Qualified Lead → Genuine Opportunity**

3\. Business Opportunity Identification

Identify potential requirements related to:

* Government Subsidies
* Industrial Incentives
* MSME Schemes
* Finance\-linked Government Schemes
* Compliance
* Licences
* Approvals
* Project\-related Government support

The BDE should identify opportunities but **must not independently guarantee subsidy eligibility or benefit amounts**.

Final eligibility and benefit validation will be handled by the relevant Amplus Research/Process Team.

**4\. Client Meetings**

* Schedule meetings with MSME owners and decision\-makers.
* Conduct discovery conversations.
* Understand the client's business/project.
* Present relevant Amplus services.
* Explain the broad process and commercial value.
* Handle basic objections.
* Ensure every meeting has a clearly defined next action.

**5\. Follow\-Up**

* Follow up with prospects and opportunities systematically.
* Maintain follow\-up schedules.
* Track decision\-makers and expected closure dates.
* Follow up on proposals and pending information.
* Prevent opportunities from becoming inactive.

Every opportunity should have a defined:

**Next Action \+ Follow\-up Date \+ Expected Closure Date**

**6\. CRM Management**

Maintain accurate CRM records for:

* New leads
* Lead source
* Qualification
* Client requirement
* Meetings
* Opportunities
* Proposals
* Follow\-ups
* Expected closure
* Lost opportunities
* Revenue
* Payment status
* Handover status

CRM discipline is an important part of the role.

**7\. Relationship \& Referral Development**

* Build professional relationships with MSME owners.
* Develop referral opportunities.
* Identify additional genuine requirements from existing prospects/clients.
* Develop long\-term business relationships.

**REQUIRED SKILLS: Sales \& Business Development**

* Lead generation
* B2B sales
* Lead qualification
* Appointment setting
* Consultative selling
* Follow\-up
* Objection handling
* Negotiation
* Basic closing skills
* Pipeline management
* CRM management

**Communication**

* Excellent verbal communication
* Good listening skills
* Professional WhatsApp/email communication
* Ability to speak confidently with business owners
* Ability to ask the right questions

**Business Understanding**

Candidate should have an interest in learning:

* MSME ecosystem
* Manufacturing businesses
* Government schemes
* Industrial incentives
* Subsidies
* Business compliances
* Government approvals
* Industrial projects

Knowledge of Government schemes is **not mandatory at joining**, but willingness to learn is essential.

**IDEAL CANDIDATE**

We are looking for someone who is:

* Confident
* Target\-oriented
* Hungry to achieve results
* Comfortable speaking with business owners
* Good at relationship building
* Curious about businesses
* Persistent but not pushy
* Self\-driven
* Professional
* Ethical
* Comfortable with rejection
* Willing to learn Government schemes
* Comfortable with CRM and technology

**EDUCATION \& EXPERIENCE**

**Preferred:**

* Graduate in any discipline
* 1–3 years of experience in:
* B2B Sales
* Business Development
* MSME Sales
* Industrial Sales
* Financial Services
* Consulting
* Business Loans
* Compliance Services
* CA/CS/Legal Services
* Industrial Products

**Freshers with exceptional communication, confidence and sales potential may also be considered.**

PERFORMANCE KPIs

The BDE will be evaluated on:

* Qualified leads generated
* Client meetings scheduled
* Genuine opportunities created
* Proposal opportunities
* Conversion rate
* Revenue generated
* Follow\-up completion
* Pipeline value
* New clients acquired
* Referral opportunities
* CRM discipline

**DAILY EXPECTATIONS**

* Prospect every working day.
* Make planned business calls.
* Follow up with active prospects.
* Generate new opportunities.
* Schedule meetings.
* Update CRM.
* Review pipeline.
* Learn about schemes/industries.
* Record the next action after every meaningful interaction.

CAREER GROWTH

**Business Development Executive**  
↓  
**Senior Business Development Executive**  
↓  
**Business Development Manager**  
↓  
**Sales Manager**  
↓  
**Sales Head**

**WHY JOIN AMPLUS?**

* Work in the growing MSME \& Government policy ecosystem.
* Learn about Government subsidies, incentives and business opportunities.
* Interact directly with entrepreneurs and business owners.
* Develop B2B consultative sales skills.
* Performance\-driven career growth.
* Opportunity to build expertise in a specialized business domain.

**WHO SHOULD NOT APPLY?**

This role may not be suitable for someone who:

* Dislikes targets
* Avoids calling prospects
* Is uncomfortable speaking with business owners
* Does not like follow\-ups
* Does not want to learn
* Requires constant supervision
* Is uncomfortable with rejection
* Does not maintain CRM
* Focuses only on activities rather than results

**CORE SUCCESS STATEMENT**

**Your responsibility is not simply to generate calls or leads.**

Your responsibility is to **identify genuine MSME opportunities, build relationships with decision\-makers, create business opportunities for Amplus and convert them into long\-term clients.**

 At Juspay, Associate Product managers take end to end product ownership, juggling between building the product, managing operations and evangelizing our creation with our customers.

 :

1. Aspiration for value creation

4. Openness and patience to learn harder things

6. Attitude and ability to get\-things\-done

* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to plan, coordinate and execute assigned tasks via collaboration with multiple cross functional teams

***Payments.. big deal?***




 Yes, it is a big deal.  You get the opportunity to work in a free liberal environment with some of the best engineers and entrepreneurs.  Our consumer product team is small and growing. You'll help set how we work: our routines, our standard for specs and experiments.
 



  





**What you'll do** 



* Own one consumer area and its main metric. It could be discovery and search, cart and checkout, the post\-order experience, or growth and retention.
* Find the problems worth solving through customer interviews, usability tests, funnel data, app reviews and customer support tickets.
* Build a quarterly roadmap tied to business goals, and be clear about what you're not doing and why.
* Write clear specs with a hypothesis and a success metric, and ship with your team every sprint.
* Design and read A/B tests, and keep improving after launch until the metric moves.
* Work closely with our Commercial \& Operations product team on the places where their decisions show up in the app: stock availability, delivery times, pricing and promotions.
* Keep noon's platform teams aligned on what's shipping and why.
* Build for customers in the middle east, and know where their needs differ.



  





**What you'll need:** 



* 3 to 5 years of experience in building consumer products
* A record of moving a consumer metric such as conversion, retention or order frequency, and the ability to explain how you did it.
* Strong data and AI skills. You pull and analyse data (SQL is a plus), and you know how to design and read experiments. Ability to orchestrate agents and run evals on AI product features.
* Outstanding product sense for mobile experiences, and a close working relationship with design.
* Enough technical understanding to make trade\-offs with engineers.
* Commercial judgement: you can weigh conversion against basket size, discounts and delivery cost.
* Experience in quick commerce, food delivery, online grocery or marketplaces.
* Experience with personalisation, search, e\-commerce and lifecycle products.
* Knowledge of GCC consumers. Arabic is a plus.
* Experience mentoring other PMs.



  





**Who will excel?** 



* We’re looking for people with high standards, who understand that hard work matters.
* You need to be relentlessly resourceful and operate with a deep bias for action.
* We need people with the courage to be fiercely original.
* noon is not for everyone; readiness to adapt, pivot, and learn is essential.

title: Specialist, Technology Delivery
description:
**Role: Specialist, Technology Delivery** 




 Role Overview
 



 We are seeking a talented Specialist, Technology Delivery to oversee the successful execution of product and project deliverables for our customers. The ideal candidate will possess a strong blend of leadership, accountability, product development, problem\-solving abilities, and communication skills.
 



 In addition to delivery execution, this role is responsible for coaching Agile teams toward higher levels of effectiveness, fostering psychologically safe team environments, and driving continuous improvement through data\-informed decision making.
 



 The Specialist, Technology Delivery will lead a development team and collaborate closely with other teams to ensure delivery of products on time and within budget and scope. This role plays a critical part in representing and advocating for the Agile team at the program level, balancing stakeholder needs with team sustainability and delivery health.
 



 This role is vital to fostering strong relationships, driving positive change, and enabling teams to deliver high\-quality, customer\-centric outcomes.
 



 Core Responsibilities
 


  

  
* Deeply understand the context of capabilities and epics (created by Product Management) in order to effectively break down, create, and refine user stories with development team members, including clearly articulating functional and non\-functional requirements and user story acceptance criteria.
* Support teams in facilitating Agile ceremonies, including daily stand\-ups, backlog refinement, sprint planning, and sprint reviews.
* Coach Agile teams beyond ceremony facilitation by improving team maturity, enabling self\-management, and guiding teams toward ownership of outcomes.
* Lead and oversee the successful delivery of products, ensuring they are completed on time, within budget, and meet defined quality standards and requirements.
* Lead and inspire project teams, fostering a collaborative, results\-driven culture.
* Promote effective and transparent communication across teams and stakeholders.
* Cultivate a psychologically safe team environment where all voices are heard and healthy conflict is managed constructively.
* Maintain a strong pulse on team health, morale, and engagement, proactively addressing challenges that impact performance.
* Establish and sustain a culture of continuous improvement (kaizen), leveraging retrospectives, experimentation, and feedback loops.
* Promote learning, capability building, and cross\-functional collaboration within and across teams.
* Encourage teams to adopt a mindset of ongoing growth, adaptability, and performance optimization.
* Prioritize commitments with development teams while incorporating product feedback to maximize customer value.
* Ensure prioritization decisions optimize value delivery, focusing on outcomes rather than output.
* Partner with Product Management to align team execution with product vision and business goals.
* Effectively communicate work in progress, outcomes, and delivery status to stakeholders, accommodating and negotiating needs while maintaining alignment with organizational priorities.
* Act as the primary advocate for the Agile team, representing team needs, constraints, and trade\-offs to stakeholders and leadership.
* Protect team focus by managing external demands and minimizing unnecessary disruptions.
* Identify and manage dependencies collaboratively across teams.
* Proactively coordinate with internal and external teams to optimize end\-to\-end delivery flow.
* Ensure alignment between team\-level execution and broader program objectives.
* Rapidly identify, communicate, and escalate risks and impediments with appropriate urgency.
* Continuously assess risks by evaluating probability, impact, and dependencies.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to develop and execute effective risk mitigation strategies through to resolution.
* Track and socialize team performance goals and metrics, including velocity and capacity.
* Analyze delivery metrics such as flow efficiency, cycle time, and throughput to identify systemic issues.
* Use data to inform planning, forecasting, and continuous improvement efforts.
* Facilitate the creation, maintenance, and accountability of team ways of working.
* Maintain proper tool hygiene for team artifacts, including user stories, backlogs, dashboards, and reporting tools.
* Continuously improve team and departmental delivery practices.
* Develop a strong understanding of the team's technical work and systems to effectively guide delivery decisions and facilitate meaningful discussions.
* Act as a translator between technical and non\-technical stakeholders when necessary.
* Contribute to the Delivery Management community of practice by sharing knowledge, mentoring peers, and promoting cross\-team alignment.
* Support consistency and excellence in delivery management practices across the organization.
* Ensure delivery outcomes align with budget expectations and organizational priorities.
* Maintain awareness of delivery\-related financial considerations, including labor allocation where applicable.
* Leverage AI\-enabled tools to enhance team productivity, decision\-making, and delivery outcomes.
* Continuously explore and apply emerging AI capabilities to improve delivery efficiency, reduce manual overhead, and enable more data\-informed insights across the team.
* Champion a customer\-centric mindset by ensuring team decisions and priorities are consistently aligned to delivering meaningful customer value and solving real user problems.
  


  


 Qualifications
 


  

  
* Bachelor’s Degree or 3 to 5 years of relevant experience (e.g., delivery manager, scrum master, project manager, product owner) or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to interact professionally with a diverse group of stakeholders.
* Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.
* Experience collaborating with or managing fully remote teams.
* Proactive problem\-solving skills, with the ability to identify issues and develop effective solutions.
* Experience leading teams without formal authority and fostering accountability.
* Strong customer\-centric mindset with the ability to clearly communicate requirements and scope.
* Excellent organizational and leadership skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
* Passion for education and experience working in an educational or product\-driven environment.
* Proficiency in Agile and other development or project management frameworks.
* Experience coaching Agile teams and improving team maturity beyond basic facilitation.
* Experience fostering psychologically safe, high\-performing team environments.
* Strong understanding of delivery metrics and experience using data to drive continuous improvement.
* Ability to manage the full lifecycle of delivery risks, from identification through resolution.
* Experience working across teams to manage dependencies and optimize system\-level delivery outcomes.
* Experience working with software development teams and Agile SDLC processes.
  


  


  

  





**Who we are:** 




 At Pearson, our purpose is simple: to help people realize the life they imagine through learning. We believe that every learning opportunity is a chance for a personal breakthrough. We are the world's lifelong learning company. For us, learning isn't just what we do. It's who we are. To learn more: We are Pearson.

title: Product Delivery Manager - Moveworks
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**EY\-ServiceNow – Supervising Associate (Product Delivery Manager – Moveworks)**
**Role Overview:**
 The ServiceNow Product Delivery Manager is responsible for the end\-to\-end management and delivery of one or more ServiceNow technology solutions within EY. The role ensures that solutions are aligned with the overall EY ServiceNow strategy, integrate effectively within the enterprise technology ecosystem, and consistently deliver high\-quality business outcomes.
   

  

 As the primary representative and advocate of ET ServiceNow, the Product Delivery Manager is accountable for the success of assigned products and services. This includes ownership of product planning, roadmap development, backlog prioritization, stakeholder engagement, and delivery oversight throughout the product lifecycle. The Product Delivery Manager is accountable for evaluating emerging ServiceNow capabilities, aligning them with business objectives, driving stakeholder awareness and adoption through demonstrations and consultations, and establishing a prioritized roadmap and implementation backlog to maximize platform value.
   

  

 The Moveworks Product Delivery Manager is responsible for the successful implementation, adoption, and ongoing evolution of the Moveworks platform across the enterprise. The role is responsible for evaluating new Moveworks features and innovations, assessing their applicability to business needs, driving stakeholder awareness and adoption, and prioritizing implementation initiatives that maximize value realization. The Product Delivery Manager ensures that solutions are delivered in accordance with governance standards, within agreed timelines and budgets, and meet quality, security, and user experience expectation.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
**Product Strategy \& Lifecycle Management:**
* Ensure products align with the EY ServiceNow strategy and broader enterprise technology objectives.
* Evaluate new ServiceNow platform capabilities and features, assess business value, and drive adoption opportunities.
* Develop and maintain the product implementation backlog based on business priorities and platform capabilities.


**Stakeholder Management:**
* Serve as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor between ET ServiceNow and business stakeholders.
* Collaborate with business teams to understand requirements, challenges, and strategic objectives.
* Translate business needs into scalable ServiceNow solutions while promoting platform best practices and standardization.
* Work with multiple stakeholders/ vendors to clear business/ technical impediments/ blockers


**Product backlog and Planning:**
* Own and govern the product backlog, ensuring alignment with business priorities and strategic goals
* Work closely with Product Owners to define, prioritize, and refine features, enhancements, and technical requirements
* Balance business demands with platform capabilities, technical constraints, and long\-term solution sustainability (strong functional understanding of ServiceNow is a must. Development experience expected).


**Delivery Management:**
* Successfully execute the project to agreed schedule, budget and scope
* Manage the demand process
* Monitor risks, dependencies, and delivery milestones, implementing mitigation plans as required.
* Coordinate with cross\-functional teams, including architecture, development, testing, operations, and vendors.
* Coordinate UAT and production go\-live


**Governance and Continuous improvement:**
* Establish and maintain governance processes for product performance, quality, and compliance.
* Track product KPIs, adoption metrics, and customer satisfaction measures.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to optimize business processes and maximize platform value.


**Innovation and Platform enablement:**
* Stay current with ServiceNow roadmap developments and emerging platform capabilities.
* Demonstrate new features and innovations to business stakeholders and leadership teams.
* Identify opportunities to improve user experience, operational efficiency, and business outcomes through ServiceNow.


**Knowledge and Skills Requirements:**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field
* 3\+ years of hands\-on experience in ServiceNow development.
* Understanding of ITIL processes and HR Services
* Strong understanding of the Move works platform, including enterprise search, conversational AI, natural language understanding (NLU), employee support automation, and AI\-driven workflow orchestration.
* Knowledge of Move works integration capabilities with ServiceNow, Microsoft Teams, Slack, HR systems, identity platforms, and enterprise applications
* Understanding of conversational experiences, virtual agents, knowledge management, and self\-service adoption strategies.
* Advanced comprehension of agile SAFe project management methodology, tools and templates (includes project planning, schedule development, scope management and cost management)
* Strong problem\-solving, analytical, and communication skills
* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) certification


**What are we looking for?**
* A team player and leader with strong technical acumen and leadership capabilities
* Proactive problem\-solving mindset with a focus on operational excellence
* Ability to manage multiple stakeholders and priorities in a fast\-paced environment
* Passion to learn and adapt to new technologies
* Strong functional/ technical understanding of ServiceNow applications (ITSM, ITOM, HRSD).


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Consultant
description:
**About ICP**
 ICP is a global leader in Content Operations, partnering with some of the world's most recognizable brands, including Unilever, Diageo, Coca\-Cola, Mars, P\&G, Starbucks, Coty, L’Oréal, NBCU, and Aetna. Our expertise spans content management, logistics, creative operations, production, and digital commerce enablement, ensuring a seamless flow of content across all systems and channels. We empower brands to achieve operational excellence and confidently manage their content. Content confidently.™
   

  

 With offices in
 ****Atlanta, London, Mexico City, Mumbai****
 , and
 ****Shanghai****
 , we operate on a global scale, delivering world\-class solutions that drive exceptional business outcomes.
   

  

**Who We Are**
 At ICP, our values define us: we are Curious, Focused, Creative, Trustworthy, and Inclusive.
   

  

**We're A People First Company**
 At ICP, we provide benefits that matter to our people and enable us to be engaged both in and outside of work. We foster a culture where
 **work/life**
 balance is nurtured and encouraged, offering hybrid working, generous paid time off, paid holidays, volunteer time off, and Summer half\-day Fridays. We also take care of our people with competitive medical, dental, and vision benefits, mental health support, and a robust savings plan.
   

  

****Bring the Confidence****
 Are you a relationship\-focused, driven professional with a growth mindset? Do you thrive on breaking through challenges and excelling in competitive environments? You're not expected to have all the answers, but your passion for uncovering solutions and building strong partnerships makes you the perfect fit for this role. We’d love to hear from you!
   

  

 The Consultant is a core contributor within the Strategy \& Consulting team, responsible for owning discrete portions of deliverables and workstreams. This role balances strong execution with emerging strategic thinking — ensuring work is delivered with clarity, accuracy, and purpose.
   

  

 As ICP continues to evolve into an integrated, insight\-led partner to our clients, this role is essential to:
   

  

* Delivering structured, high\-quality work that drives decisions forward
* Translating direction into clear, client\-ready outputs
* Increasing alignment and communication across internal and client teams
* Beginning to connect client insights back into ICP methods, frameworks, and scalable learnings


 This role blends hands\-on delivery, thoughtful problem\-solving, early client interaction, and growing confidence in shaping work outputs. Consultants may contribute through strategic framing, solution structuring, or specialist depth expertise, depending on background and account needs. Both paths are valued as part of the consulting craft. Consultants may support multiple projects and collaborate closely with Senior Consultants, Principals, Solutions Leads, and Client Partnerships.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
****Delivery \& Workstream Ownership****
* Own and manage defined portions of a workstream—from planning to execution—with increasing independence.
* Produce client\-ready deliverables and narratives with limited redirection or rework, leveraging either strategic consulting frameworks or specialist subject\-matter depth to strengthen clarity, feasibility, and impact.
* Apply ICP frameworks and consulting approaches consistently to drive clarity and structure.
* Participate actively in internal and client discussions — sharing progress, questions, risks, and recommendations clearly.
* Contribute to problem\-solving by organizing information, identifying themes, and shaping next\-step plans — either through structured strategic framing or application of specialist expertise, depending on the workstream need.


****Client Engagement****
* Maintain positive working relationships with mid\-level client stakeholders through clear, consistent communication.
* Present updates or components of deliverables in client meetings when appropriate.
* Ask thoughtful questions that help clarify objectives and business context.


****Collaboration \& Knowledge Sharing****
* Work collaboratively with cross\-functional teams to ensure alignment and smooth handoffs.
* Bring forward relevant client observations or patterns that may inform reusable frameworks, templates, or best practices.
* Engage in feedback loops and coaching sessions with Sr. Consultants / Team Leads.


****Growth \& Development****
* Actively build consulting capabilities in strategic framing, communication clarity, synthesis, and stakeholder engagement.
* Complete required training and proactively pursue development aligned to career goals and growth levers.


****Ideal Candidate Profile****
* Experience in content creation and management, particularly focused on transformation to a modular approach.
* Experience with change strategy, training strategy, and governance. Ability to drive strategic user adoption and engagement initiatives across global markets.
* Experience with Pharma marketing processes, MLR workflows, communications, and approvals.
* Experience with Aprimo DAM capabilities a plus.
* Brings strategic problem\-solving capabilities that enhances the quality of deliverables and strengthens client outcomes.
* Strong executor who can organize complex information and translate direction into structured outputs.
* Communicates clearly — written, verbal, and visual — and seeks clarification before moving forward.
* Curious, proactive, and continuously improving; asks thoughtful questions to understand the “why.”
* Comfortable collaborating across teams and navigating ambiguity with growing confidence.
* Demonstrates accountability, ownership, and commitment to producing high\-quality work.

* Analytical troubleshooting

**Job Purpose:**


We are looking for a dynamic and people\-oriented People Experience Partner to support the HR function at our manufacturing plant in Arakkonam.


The role will be responsible for day\-to\-day HR operations, employee welfare, employee engagement, HR documentation, benefits administration and employee lifecycle activities at the plant. The role will also support the Plant HR Head in Industrial Relations, statutory compliance, contract labour management and workforce\-related activities.


The position will serve as an important interface between employees, contract workmen, supervisors and the HR team, ensuring timely resolution of employee queries and delivery of a positive employee experience at the plant

**Key Responsibilities:**

**HR Operations \& Employee Lifecycle**

* Manage day\-to\-day HR operations for plant employees and support end\-to\-end employee lifecycle activities.
* Coordinate with Payroll and relevant stakeholders on attendance, leave, payroll inputs and employee\-related queries.
* Support preparation of regular HR MIS and plant HR reports.

**Employee Welfare \& Engagement**

* Act as a point of contact for employee welfare\-related matters and provide timely support to employees.
* Understand employee concerns and grievances and escalate matters appropriately to the Plant HR Head.
* Coordinate employee welfare activities, celebrations, recognition initiatives and other plant\-level employee engagement programmes.
* Maintain a positive and employee\-friendly work environment while ensuring alignment with business requirements.
* Support awareness programmes relating to employee welfare, safety and wellbeing.

**Employee Relations \& Industrial Relations Support**

* Maintain regular interaction with employees and shop\-floor teams to understand workplace concerns.
* Support disciplinary and employee\-relations processes, documentation and follow\-up as directed by the Plant HR Head.

**Statutory Compliance \& Regulatory Coordination**

* Support the Plant HR Head in ensuring compliance with applicable labour laws, employment regulations and factory\-related requirements.
* Maintain required HR, employee welfare and statutory records and registers.
* Support preparation of documents and information required for statutory inspections, audits and reviews.
* Coordinate with relevant internal teams and external agencies for compliance\-related activities.
* Assist in ensuring timely renewal, documentation and maintenance of relevant licences, registrations and records.
* Support liaison and coordination with statutory authorities and external agencies whenever required.

**Contract Labour Management**

* Support the Plant HR Head in the administration and monitoring of contract labour.
* Coordinate with contractors regarding attendance, manpower deployment and employee documentation.
* Support monitoring of statutory compliance by contractors, including PF, ESI, wages, bonus and other applicable requirements.

**Recruitment \& Workforce Support**

* Support hiring of shopfloor, blue\-collar and other plant positions based on manpower requirements.
* Coordinate with recruitment consultants, local sourcing channels, ITIs, skill centres and other sources as required.
* Assist in screening, interview coordination, selection documentation and joining formalities.
* Coordinate pre\-employment documentation and Background Verification (BGV) processes for Pan India locations.

**Background Verification \& Employee Documentation**

* Liaise with BGV agencies and internal stakeholders to ensure timely completion of verification.
* Track pending cases, follow up on exceptions and maintain appropriate records.
* Ensure employee documentation is complete, accurate and appropriately maintained.

**Employee Benefits \& Insurance Administration**

* Support Corporate People Experience team in administration of Group Medical Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance, Life Insurance and other applicable employee benefit programmes.
* Coordinate employee enrolment, additions, deletions and corrections under applicable benefit schemes.
* Support employees with insurance claims and coordinate with brokers, TPAs and service providers for resolution of queries and escalations.
* Support annual renewal and related employee communication activities.

**HR MIS, Employee Communication \& Audit Support**

* Prepare and maintain regular HR MIS relating to headcount, attendance, attrition, recruitment, employee movements, welfare activities and other plant HR metrics.
* Conduct or coordinate employee communication sessions and awareness programmes.
* Support internal and external HR audits and provide required documentation.
* Maintain appropriate records of vendor activities, audits and corrective actions.

**Other Responsibilities**

* Undertake any other HR, employee welfare or plant\-related responsibilities assigned by the reporting manager.
* The incumbent will be the designated Welfare Officer for the Arakkonam plant and will discharge the responsibilities of the Welfare Officer as applicable to the plant.

**Preferred Experience \& Qualifications**

* MLM / MSW in Human Resources or a related discipline.
* 4\-7 years of experience in HR, preferably in a manufacturing, industrial or plant environment.
* Freshers with relevant academic qualifications and strong interest in Plant HR / Employee Relations may also be considered.
* Exposure to labour laws, Industrial Relations or employee welfare will be an advantage.
* Strong interest in working closely with shop\-floor employees and the plant workforce.
* Strong interpersonal, follow\-up and coordination skills.
* Comfortable working with MS Excel, PowerPoint and HR systems.
* Knowledge of HRMS platforms such as Workday, SAP, Oracle, or PeopleSoft.

**Company Description** **Are you ready to trade your job for a journey? Become a FlyMate!**  

  

Passion, excitement \& global collaboration are all core to what it means to be a FlyMate. At Flywire, we’re on a mission to deliver the world’s most important and complex payments. What more do we need to truly be unstoppable? Perhaps, that is you!

**Who we are:**


Flywire is a global payments enablement and software company, founded more than a decade ago to solve high\-stakes, high\-value payments. We’ve scaled into new regions and industry verticals and expanded our product offerings to deliver meaningful value to our clients around the world.


Today we support more than 5,300 clients across the global education, healthcare, travel \& B2B industries, with diverse payment methods across 240 countries \& territories and more than 140 currencies.


With over 1,400\+ global FlyMates, representing more than 40 nationalities, and in 15 offices world\-wide, we’re looking for FlyMates to join the next stage of our journey as we continue to grow.

 **Job Description** **The Opportunity**


Flywire is seeking a highly skilled Senior People Analytics Specialist (Workday) to strengthen the People team's ability to make timely trusted data\-informed decisions. This role will own the design, development, maintenance and continuous improvement of People reporting and analytics within Workday.


You will partner closely with People leaders, People Operations, People Technology, Finance and Business Intelligence teams to translate business questions into scalable reporting solutions. This is an ideal opportunity for a technically strong Workday reporting professional who is equally comfortable working with stakeholders, improving data quality and turning complex workforce data into clear actionable insights.

**What you will do**

* Design, build, test and maintain Workday reports, dashboards, scorecards and data extracts that support People, Finance, executive and board\-level reporting needs.
* Translate stakeholder needs into clear reporting requirements, including metrics definitions, data sources, security considerations, delivery cadence and expected business outcomes.
* Develop advanced Workday reporting solutions using Report Writer, calculated fields, dashboards, composite reports, matrix reports and related Workday capabilities.
* Partner with People Technology and Workday implementation stakeholders to support a successful post\-go\-live reporting model, including prioritisation and delivery of critical People reports.
* Establish trusted consistent definitions for core workforce metrics such as headcount, attrition, hiring, internal mobility, diversity, organisational structure and talent outcomes.
* Validate report logic and data accuracy, investigate discrepancies and resolve issues through disciplined testing and root\-cause analysis.
* Build and maintain documentation covering reports, metrics, data sources, business logic and operating procedures.
* Partner with Business Intelligence and data teams when advanced analytics, cross\-functional data sets, automation or enterprise\-level insights are required beyond native Workday reporting.
* Identify opportunities to simplify manual reporting, improve self\-service access to data and strengthen the overall People analytics experience.
* Support reporting governance by ensuring appropriate data security, confidentiality, access controls and adherence to applicable privacy requirements.
* Provide guidance and enablement to People team stakeholders on how to interpret and use reports effectively.

  

**Qualifications** **Here's what we're looking for**

* 5\+ years of experience in People Analytics, HRIS, Workforce Analytics or a related analytical role.
* Demonstrated hands\-on experience building and maintaining reports in Workday, including advanced and matrix reports, calculated fields and composite reporting.
* Experience with Workday Dashboards and Discovery Boards, along with Worksheets.
* Strong knowledge of Workday HCM data structures, business processes, security domains and reporting best practice.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including complex formulas, pivot tables, data validation and data analysis.
* Experience transforming ambiguous business questions into practical scalable reporting solutions.
* Strong analytical judgement and attention to detail, with the ability to validate data accuracy before communicating findings.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts and insights clearly to nontechnical audiences.
* Experience partnering with Finance, People Operations, HR Technology and/or Business Intelligence teams.
* A strong commitment to data privacy, confidentiality and responsible handling of employee information.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-moving global environment.

**Preferred qualifications**

* Experience supporting a Workday implementation, stabilisation period or major Workday reporting transformation.
* Experience with workforce planning, organisational analytics, talent analytics or executive People reporting.
* Knowledge of Workday EIB, Orchestrator, Studio and Extend.
* Experience with Prism Analytics.
* Workday Reporting or a related certification is an advantage.
* Familiarity with BI and visualisation tools such as Tableau, Power BI, Looker or similar platforms.
* Experience with data querying, data modelling or integrating HR data with enterprise data sources.
* Experience working in a global matrixed organisation.

**Technologies we use**

* Workday HCM and Workday Reporting
* Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets
* Business intelligence and visualisation tools
* Jira and collaboration tools, including Slack and Google Workspace

  

**Additional Information** **What We Offer:**

description:
A Maintenance Engineer for Data logger/ RTU/ PLC and SCADA systems ensures the maximum uptime, reliability, and continuous operation of industrial automation infrastructure. Their core responsibilities include preventive maintenance, troubleshooting hardware and network failures, updating software logic, and performing emergency breakdowns to minimize production or utility downtime.

**Key Responsibilities**

· **Routine Maintenance:** Execute scheduled preventive and predictive maintenance on Data Logger, RTU, PLC panels, SCADA workstations, HMI screens, and industrial networks.

· **Fault Diagnostics:** Troubleshoot system faults, I/O module failures, communication drops, and loop errors under high\-pressure breakdown conditions.

· **Logic Modification:** Perform minor programming changes, logic updates, and backup management for PLC programs and SCADA graphic configurations.

· **Calibration \& Instrumentation:** Verify and maintain field instruments (sensors, transmitters, VFDs, actuators) interfacing with the control system.

· **Network Maintenance:** Monitor and maintain industrial communication links, including Modbus, Profibus, Profinet, and Ethernet/IP networks.

· **Documentation:** Maintain detailed logs of breakdowns, history cards, calibration reports, change management tracking, and inventory of critical spares.

**Essential Qualifications**

· **Education:** Diploma or Bachelor’s Degree in Instrumentation, Electronics, Electrical, or Automation Engineering.

· **Experience:** Fresher / 1 year of hands\-on maintenance experience in Electronics/ PLC \& SCDA

· **PLC/SCADA Expertise:** Working knowledge of major platforms such as Schneider Electric, or Siemens

description:
**Human Resources Intern** 




 Helping Build the Culture, One Detail at a Time
 



**Who Are We?** 
  
 



 Millipixels Interactive
 
 is where creativity, technology, strategy, and innovation come together to build meaningful digital experiences for clients across 16 countries. We partner with startups, growing businesses, and enterprise brands globally to create immersive digital products and technology solutions.
 





 We’re a team that thrives on ideas, ownership, experimentation, and execution. We like people who take initiative, think beyond the obvious, and bring energy into everything they do.
 




  






 If you’re someone who enjoys building, collaborating, and making a visible impact, you’ll probably enjoy being here.
 




  





**About The Role** 

  
 





 Good culture isn't an accident \- it's built through consistent, well\-run people processes surveys that lead to real action, reports and dashboards that leadership can actually use, events that people look forward to, and an onboarding experience that makes new hires feel at home from day one.
 

  
 





 As the Human Resources Intern, you'll work closely with the Human Resources team to support exactly that. You'll get hands\-on exposure across engagement, dashboards \& reporting, training coordination, and day\-to\-day HR operations, learning what it actually takes to run a people function, not just observe one.
 




  





**You’ll Be The Person Who** 




  




* **Drives Engagement Initiatives:** 

 Assists with engagement surveys and initiatives, helping capture how the team is really feeling.
* **Makes the Numbers Tell a Story:** 

 Helps build and maintain HR reports and dashboards, keeping people's data accurate and current.
* **Coordinates Learning:** 

 Supports the planning and coordination of training sessions, handling logistics and scheduling.
* **Brings People Together:** 

 Helps plan and coordinate HR events and engagement activities, from idea to on\-the\-day execution.
* **Smooths the Onboarding Journey:** 

 Assists with onboarding new hires, so their first few weeks feel organised and welcoming.
* **Keeps the Records Straight:** 

 Handles general HR documentation and maintains employee records, so nothing falls through the cracks.



  





**Is This You?** 




  




* You're proficient in MS Excel/Google Sheets and PowerPoint, and familiar with task tracking tools like ClickUp.
* You communicate clearly — in writing and out loud — and can put together basic content for engagement posts and announcements.
* You're strongly organised, reliable with recurring tasks, and good at juggling multiple priorities at once.
* You have an eye for detail, take data accuracy seriously, and can think analytically to put together reports that make sense.
* You've got some experience with (or genuine interest in) event planning and coordination.
* You're proactive, creative, and enthusiastic, with a collaborative mindset that works well across teams.



  





**Benefits Of Working At Millipixels** 




  




* **Flexible work, your way:** 

 Work where you do your best thinking. We measure outcomes, not hours at a desk.
* **Life admin handled:** 

 Regular expert\-led sessions on finance, tax, and healthcare, so the boring stuff doesn't eat into your weekends.
* **Real mentorship:** 

 Work closely with an experienced HR team that invests in your growth, not just your task list.
* **Hands\-on learning:** 

 Get exposure to real HR projects and processes from day one — not just coffee runs and admin.
* **Room to grow:** 

 Continuous learning and real development in a global team, with space to turn this internship into something more.
* **Ownership, not red tape:** 

 Small team, big trust. Bring the idea, run with it, and watch it ship.

title: Talent Partner-G&A
description:
**Talent Partner, G\&A**
------------------------


**Location:** Bengaluru, India — Hybrid **Department:** People — Talent Acquisition

  

### **About the Role**


You'll lead hiring for Rubrik's G\&A organization in India, and be the talent voice in the room when leaders decide how those teams get built. This is a senior individual\-contributor seat: you'll run the hardest G\&A searches yourself — Finance, Legal, People, IT, Business Operations — while advising VPs on leveling, location, and org shape, and setting the standard the wider Talent Partner team follows.


### **About the Team**


Rubrik's India Talent Acquisition team hires across Engineering, Go\-to\-Market, and G\&A from our Bengaluru site, one of the company's fastest\-growing locations. You'll be among the most senior recruiters here, partnering with functional leaders and their global counterparts, and looked to by peers on how full life\-cycle recruiting should be done.


### **What You'll Do**


* Lead full life\-cycle recruitment for Rubrik's most complex and senior G\&A searches in India — leadership hires and scarce specialist roles alike.
* Advise Senior Manager and above stakeholders on hiring strategy, driving leveling decisions, team composition, and location choices rather than reacting to them.
* Design and run sourcing strategies across channels and modalities without direction, using competitive intelligence to move passive talent who weren't looking.
* Make diverse pipelines structural to every search: build them into intake, involve interview panels in sourcing, and evidence the outcome req by req.
* Bring internal talent and mobility into the conversation with your business partners, treating early\-career and internal\-promotion paths as real options.
* Lead a Talent Acquisition initiative that outlasts a single req — candidate experience, interviewer calibration, reporting, or process improvement — and pull the team into it.
* Set the bar on tools and process: model best practice in the ATS, teach peers, and challenge how we work when there's a better way.

### **What You'll Bring**


* 6\+ years of full life\-cycle recruiting, with several years owning senior and leadership hiring for G\&A or corporate functions.
* A record of independently running complex searches to close across more than one function or business unit.
* Credibility with Senior stakeholders — evidence that your talent recommendations changed a hiring decision, a level, or an org design.
* Fluency with market and competitive intelligence data, and the judgment to forecast a search with reliable accuracy.
* Advanced command of an ATS and sourcing stack, at the level where peers come to you for guidance.
* Persuasive communication under pressure: you can close a senior candidate and reframe a panel's view of a profile in the same week.
* Deep knowledge of the Indian talent market across cities and functions.

### **Bonus Points**


* Building or scaling G\&A hiring at a public or recently public technology company.
* Leading a cross\-functional TA initiative with measurable results.
* Partnering with HR and Finance on headcount and location planning.
  

You'll embody Rubrik's RIVET values — Relentlessness, Integrity, Velocity, Excellence, and Transparency — in how you collaborate, make decisions, and show up for Stakeholders and teammates.


**Join Us in Securing and Accelerating the World's AI Transformation**
----------------------------------------------------------------------


Rubrik (RBRK), the Security and AI Operations Company, leads at the intersection of data protection, cyber resilience, and enterprise AI acceleration. Rubrik Security Cloud delivers complete cyber resilience by securing, monitoring, and recovering data, identities, and workloads across clouds. Rubrik Agent Cloud accelerates trusted AI agent deployments at scale by monitoring and auditing agentic actions, enforcing real\-time guardrails, fine\-tuning for accuracy and undoing agentic mistakes.

  


**Inclusion @ Rubrik**
----------------------


At Rubrik, we are dedicated to fostering a culture where people from all backgrounds are valued, feel they belong, and believe they can succeed. Our commitment to inclusion is at the heart of our mission to secure the world’s data.


Our goal is to hire and promote the best talent, regardless of background. We continually review our hiring practices to ensure fairness and strive to create an environment where every employee has equal access to opportunities for growth and excellence. We believe in empowering everyone to bring their authentic selves to work and achieve their fullest potential.


### **Our inclusion strategy focuses on three core areas of our business and culture:**


* Our Company: We are committed to building a merit\-based organization that offers equal access to growth and success for all employees globally. Your potential is limitless here.
* Our Culture: We strive to create an inclusive atmosphere where individuals from all backgrounds feel a strong sense of belonging, can thrive, and do their best work. Your contributions help us innovate and break boundaries.
* Our Communities: We are dedicated to expanding our engagement with the communities we operate in, creating opportunities for underrepresented talent and driving greater innovation for our clients. Your impact extends beyond Rubrik, contributing to safer and stronger communities.

**Equal Opportunity Employer/Veterans/Disabled**
------------------------------------------------


Rubrik is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability.


Rubrik provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability or genetics. In addition to federal law requirements, Rubrik complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.


Federal law requires employers to provide reasonable accommodation to qualified individuals with disabilities. Please contact us at hr@rubrik.com if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job or to perform your job. Examples of reasonable accommodation include making a change to the application process or work procedures, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.

PHR Certification or equivalent desired**Required years of experience –**10\+ years of relevant experience in a similar role. **AON IS IN THE BUSINESS OF BETTER DECISIONS**


At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.


As an organization, we are committed as one firm to our purpose, united through trust as one inclusive, diverse team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.


**INFORMATION ABOUT THE BUSINESS**


Aon is a leading global professional services firm providing a broad range of risk, retirement, and health solutions. Our colleagues provide clients in over 120 countries and sovereignties with advice and solutions that give them the clarity and confidence to make better decisions to protect and grow their business. **GENERAL DESCRIPTION OF ROLE:**


The People Operations function delivers the operational, administrative, and transactional services that enable the People Organization to focus on strategy, advisory, governance, and risk management.
Within People Operations, regional teams provide end‑to‑end operational support across the employee lifecycle, which may include, but is not limited to:* Benefits and rewards operations
* Workforce data and administration
* HR knowledge management and colleague‑facing support (e.g., HR portals, FAQs)


The **Regional Workforce Admin Lead** leads these regional operational teams and will report into the People Operations Leader and partners closely with regional People Organization leaders and specialist teams (e.g., Benefits, People Matters, Talent, Total Rewards). The Regional Workforce Admin Lead is responsible for overseeing and continuously improving regional HR operations across the full employee lifecycle. This role leads teams that perform operational and administrative work to support the Colleague experience, ensuring services are delivered accurately, efficiently, and in line with defined Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs). While the People Organization owns program, policy, and advisory responsibilities, this role ensures that the underlying operations, processes, systems, and data that support those activities are efficient, consistent, accurate, and well‑coordinated. **JOB RESPONSIBILITIES**:  

The colleague is responsible for:
* The Regional Workforce Admin Lead will have a variety of interactions with People Operations, the People Organization, managers, colleagues, and external providers, including:
* 
* **Team Leadership \& People Management:**
	+ Directly manage and develop a team, delivering HR operational services across the employee lifecycle
	+ Plan and manage team capacity, work allocation, and coverage across multiple processes and queues, ensuring support for peak periods, regional time zones, and urgent or sensitive matters
	+ Build a high‑performing, service‑oriented culture focused on accuracy, accountability, and continuous improvement
	+ Set clear objectives, priorities, and development plans for team members in line with regional and global People Operations strategies
* **HR/People Operations Across Employee Lifecycle**:
	+ Oversee delivery of end‑to‑end HR operational processes, such as hiring, job and data changes, benefits and rewards administration, employee relations operations support, and exits/retirements, as applicable in the region
	+ Ensure operational processes are aligned to People Organization policies, local legal/regulatory requirements, and global People Operations standards
	+ Support cyclical HR activities (e.g., performance and compensation cycles, benefits renewals and enrollment, engagement initiatives) from an operational execution and readiness perspective
	+ Ensure that new or evolving HR services can be successfully transitioned into regional People Operations, including defining scope, processes, controls, knowledge content, and success measures
	+ Promote a consistent experience for colleagues and managers across all lifecycle touchpoints and channels
* **Operational Excellence \& Knowledge Management:**
* Design, implement, and maintain KPIs, SLAs, and operating standards that define expectations for quality, timeliness, and colleague experience
* Own and continuously improve SOPs, process maps, and work instructions for regional HR operations, ensuring documentation is accurate, accessible, and regularly reviewed
* Oversee HR operational knowledge bases and colleague‑facing content (e.g., HR portal, FAQs, standard communications) in partnership with the People Organization, ensuring content is current, clear, and operationally feasible
* Monitor performance against KPIs/SLAs; identify trends, root causes, and areas for improvement; and lead remediation and enhancement plans
* Partner with HR Technology, Data \& Analytics, and global People Operations to standardize processes and leverage tools, digitization, and automation where possible
* **Governance, Risk, and Third\-Party Management:**
* Establish and facilitate regular governance forums with People Organization counterparts, People Partners, and other stakeholders to:
	+ Review operational KPIs, SLAs, and service metrics
	+ Discuss trends, risks, and colleague experience feedback
	+ Agree on priorities and roadmap of continuous improvement initiatives
* Ensure appropriate controls, documentation, and audit trails are in place to manage operational risk and support compliance, privacy, and regulatory requirements across HR operations
* Coordinate with Internal Audit, Compliance, and other control functions as needed to prepare for and respond to audits and reviews
* Oversee relationships with third‑party providers supporting People operations in the region, working with Procurement and the People Organization to monitor performance, conduct regular service reviews, resolve escalations, and assess opportunities for improvement or change
* **Stakeholder Management \& Collaboration:**
* Act as the primary People Operations point of contact for regional HR partners, clearly communicating process expectations, timelines, and operational impacts
* Build strong partnerships with People Organization leaders and specialist teams (e.g., Benefits, People Matters, Talent, Total Rewards), People Partners, Employment Law, Compliance, Finance, Payroll, and other key stakeholders
* Represent the regional operational perspective in HR program and policy design discussions, ensuring operational feasibility, scalability, controls, and colleague experience are considered
* Capture and share regional feedback and insights, including operational data and colleague experience themes, to inform global and regional People strategies and decision‑making
* **Continuous Improvement, Change Management, and Service Delivery:**
* Identify and implement processes, technologies, and organizational improvements that enhance service quality, efficiency, and colleague satisfaction
* Lead or support transition and change activities when new work, new processes, or new tools are introduced into People Operations (including operational readiness planning, UAT, training, and cutover support)
* Encourage a culture where colleagues challenge the status quo, propose ideas, and use data and feedback to drive improvements
* Oversee service recovery for escalated issues or service failures, ensuring root causes are addressed and learnings are embedded into processes and controls

 **SKILLS/COMPETENCIES REQUIRED** :  

* Varied experience in HR operations/People Operations or a related shared services environment, preferably with regional or multi country scope
* Demonstrated experience leading operational teams across multiple HR process areas and through periods of change or growth
* Proven ability to design and manage SLAs, KPIs, and SOPs, and to use data and metrics to drive performance and decision making
* Experience working with HR systems, case management, and workflow tools, and comfort with introducing and embedding new technologies and processes.
* Strong people leadership skills, including coaching, performance management, and building high performing teams.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate across geographies, cultures, and functions.
* Strong process and continuous improvement mindset, with a track record of simplifying, standardizing, and automating processes.
* High level of attention to detail, data accuracy, and governance, with the ability to manage confidential and sensitive information appropriately.

**HOW WE SUPPORT OUR COLLEAGUES**
In addition to our comprehensive benefits package, we are proud to be an equal opportunity workforce. At Aon, we believe a diverse workforce is an innovative workforce. Our agile, inclusive environment allows colleagues to manage their wellbeing and work/life balance while empowering you to be your authentic self.


Furthermore, all colleagues enjoy two “Global Wellbeing Days” each year, encouraging them to take time to focus on themselves. We offer a variety of workstyle options through our Smart Working model, but we also recognize that flexibility goes beyond just the place of work... and we are all for it!


Our continuous learning culture inspires and equips colleagues to learn, share and grow, helping them achieve their fullest potential. As a result, Aon colleagues are more connected, more relevant, and more valued.

title: Data Platform Consultant (DBT)
description:
### **Description**

  

**The headlines...**  

  

**Immediate Joiners Preferred**  

**Location** \- Hybrid in our central Pune office  

  

**A few application tips…**  

  

We want to help you put your best foot forward. Here are a few things we look for:* Clear, specific examples of your work and impact
* Relevant experience aligned with the role’s focus
* A thoughtful response to any application questions
* A resume that highlights both what you did and why it mattered

If you’re unsure whether your background is the “perfect fit,” we still encourage you to apply. We value potential and growth just as much as experience.  

  

**Why this role exists…**  

This role is designed to strengthen our delivery capability across our most strategic accounts in industries like Consumer Goods, Financial Services and Energy.  

As the demand for data and AI\-driven transformation grows, so does the need for structured, proactive project leadership. At Snap Analytics, we help clients unlock the full potential of their data, and we’re scaling fast**.**  

  

We’re building DBT capability on a project. As a small, agile organisation, we’re investing in people who can help us deliver quickly and grow our competency in India with support from UK colleagues. You’ll have clear impact from day one and room to move across projects as you develop.### **What you’ll be doing…**

  

You’ll play a central role in designing and delivering data transformations that power a high‑visibility project. You’ll work closely with project leads, project managers, and senior engineers to ship quality outcomes with increasing autonomy.  

  

**Your responsibilities will include:**
* **Data Modelling:** Design, develop, and maintain complex data models using dbt Core to support various business functions.
* **Pipeline Optimization:** Build and manage scalable data transformation pipelines within Snowflake, ensuring high performance and cost\-efficiency.
* **Code Quality:** Implement software engineering best practices in the data stack, including version control (Git), modularity, and CI/CD.
* **Testing \& Documentation:** Ensure data integrity by writing robust dbt tests and maintaining comprehensive documentation via dbt docs.
* **Performance Tuning:** Optimize Snowflake compute and storage by managing clustering keys, materialized views, and efficient SQL querying.
* **Stakeholder Collaboration:** Work closely with Data Analysts and Business Leads to translate business requirements into technical data schemas.

**In your first 3–6 months, success might look like:*** Delivering the majority of your assigned work independently, to a high standard (quality \+ on‑time)
* Demonstrating holistic project understanding \- how your work fits the wider data flow and business goals
* Building healthy working relationships across the India team and, over time, with UK stakeholders

  

### **What you’ll need to succeed…**

  

We’re looking for someone who brings a mix of experience, curiosity, and collaboration.  

  

**You might be a great fit if you have:**
* **2 years’ experience** in dbt Core, including macros, packages (like dbt\-utils), and Jinja templating (we’re not considering freshers for this role)
* Strong **SQL** fundamentals and practical exposure to **DBT**
* Deep understanding of Snowflake\-specific features such as Tasks, Streams, Snowpipe, and Zero\-copy cloning.
* Familiarity with **Git/Bitbucket** and awareness of **CI/CD** concepts (nice to have)
* **Clear communication \-** you can articulate your thinking to technical and non‑technical partners
* **A** **learning mindset**: proactive, curious, and willing to work “a notch above” expectations (automation, generalising code, improving process)
* **Transparency** and ownership \- comfortable asking for help early and taking accountability for outcomes

**This role might not be the right fit if you’re looking for:*** Highly siloed work with very narrow task scopes (we value holistic project thinking)
* Constant step‑by‑step guidance (we expect growing autonomy and initiative)

  

### **Why choose Snap**

  

* **Impact from day one** on a new, high‑visibility project
* **Growth in a small, agile company** with opportunities to rotate across projects as you develop
* **Supportive team culture \-** mentorship from seniors, collaboration with India \& UK colleagues, open feedback and help‑seeking encouraged

### **About Snap Analytics**


We're a high\-growth data analytics consultancy on a mission to help enterprise businesses unlock the full potential of their data. With offices in the UK, India, and South Africa, we specialise in cutting\-edge cloud analytics solutions, transforming complex data challenges into actionable business insights.  

  

We partner with some of the biggest brands worldwide to modernise their data platforms, enabling smarter decision\-making through Snowflake, Databricks, Matillion, and other cloud technologies. Our approach is customer\-first, innovation\-driven, and results\-focused, delivering impactful solutions with speed and precision.  

  

At Snap, we’re not just consultants, we’re problem\-solvers, engineers, and strategists who thrive on tackling complex data challenges. Our culture is built on collaboration, continuous learning, and pushing boundaries, ensuring our people grow just as fast as our business.  

  

Join us and be part of a team that’s shaping the future of data analytics!

title: Junior Civil Engineer- Product listing BajriX
description:
