Company: BajriX Private LimitedLocation: Jaipur, RajasthanJob Type: Part\-timeExperience: 0–2 YearsQualification: Diploma / B.Tech / B.E. in Civil Engineering or related fieldLaptop Requirement: Candidate must have their own laptop

About BajriX

BajriX is a technology\-enabled platform focused on simplifying the construction and home\-building ecosystem. We help buyers discover building materials, suppliers, and service professionals while enabling local sellers to take their businesses digital.

We are looking for a Junior Civil Engineer – Product Catalog \& Seller Onboarding who can support our seller onboarding and catalog operations team by understanding construction products, researching product information, and creating accurate and structured product listings.

Role Overview

This is primarily an office\-based product catalog and operations role, not a site\-engineering role.

The ideal candidate should have a basic understanding of construction and building materials and should be comfortable with product research, Excel/data entry, internet research, and communicating with sellers and our sales team.

You will convert seller\-provided information such as catalogues, price lists, product photos, WhatsApp messages, brochures, and handwritten lists into accurate and structured product listings on BajriX.

Key Responsibilities

* Support the Sales and Seller Onboarding team in creating product listings for newly onboarded sellers.
* Understand and classify construction products into the correct BajriX categories.
* Research product information using manufacturer websites, official catalogues, brochures, and other reliable sources.
* Identify the correct brand, product name, model, variant, SKU or product family.
* Capture important product attributes such as size, thickness, grade, finish, material, packaging, application, unit, model number, etc.
* Convert unstructured seller information into standardized and structured product data.
* Review seller\-provided product names and descriptions and correct inconsistencies.
* Coordinate with sellers or the onboarding team when important product information is missing.
* Upload and maintain product details, images, specifications, pricing, MOQ, stock information, and other listing data.
* Ensure that duplicate or incorrect products are not created.
* Perform quality checks before product listings are approved or published.
* Maintain product/catalog data in Excel, Google Sheets, and internal BajriX systems.
* Help improve and expand BajriX’s master construction\-product catalogue.

Product Categories You May Work With

Cement, TMT Steel, Sand, Aggregate, Bricks, AAC Blocks, Tiles, Marble \& Granite, Plywood, Laminates, Hardware, Paints, Waterproofing, Plumbing, Sanitaryware, Electricals, Roofing, Doors \& Windows, Furniture Fittings, Construction Chemicals and other building materials.

Required Skills

* Basic understanding of construction materials and terminology.
* Strong internet and product research skills.
* Good attention to detail and accuracy.
* Comfortable working with Excel / Google Sheets.
* Ability to understand technical specifications and product catalogues.
* Good computer and data\-entry skills.
* Ability to differentiate between similar construction products and variants.
* Good Hindi communication skills.
* Basic written English.
* Willingness to learn new product categories.
* Ability to work closely with sales and operations teams.
* Must have a personal laptop and be comfortable using it for day\-to\-day work.

Preferred Candidate

We would particularly like to hear from candidates who:

* Have completed or are pursuing Diploma/B.Tech/B.E. in Civil Engineering.
* Are freshers, students, or have up to 2 years of experience.
* Have worked with a construction\-material supplier, dealer, distributor, contractor, or builder.
* Have exposure to procurement, estimation, billing, BOQ, construction materials, or site work.
* Have knowledge of brands and products commonly used in the Jaipur/Rajasthan construction market.
* Enjoy research and working with structured data.

Important

This position is not primarily a site supervision role.

It is a part\-time role suited for someone who understands construction products and is interested in working in technology, catalog operations, research, and the digital construction ecosystem.

Having your own laptop is mandatory for this role.

Why Join BajriX?

You will get exposure to hundreds of construction\-product categories, brands, suppliers, and real\-world market data while working closely with the sales, product, technology, and founding teams.

You will contribute directly to building one of the most important parts of BajriX — its structured construction\-product catalogue.

If you understand construction materials, enjoy research, and are comfortable working with data and technology, we would love to hear from you.

* USB
* Ethernet
* TCP/IP

You will be part of the team developing and integrating:

Laboratory software \+ Instrument Integration \+ Data Capture \+ Laboratory Workflow

**ViSetu**  
Industrial IoT \+ Sensors \+ Embedded Devices \+ Wireless Monitoring \+ Data Communication

* Modbus

* Embedded IoT devices
* Data loggers
* PLC / automation systems
* Instrument\-to\-PC communication

Salary

**Competitive salary \+ performance\-based growth**, based on technical skills and relevant experience.

Apply

If you enjoy working at the intersection of **Electronics \+ Embedded Systems \+ Instruments \+ Software \+ Industrial IoT** apply online via https://www.vinfro.in/apply

**About Company** 




 A venture\-backed startup founded in 2023, revolutionizing the space component supply chain. The company delivers low\-cost, reliable spacecraft components for LEO satellites.
 



 They specialize in Attitude Determination and Control System components like reaction wheels, star trackers, and torque rods. The team of 6 engineers has raised $2\.2M and operates across the US and India.
 



 They're helping satellite manufacturers reduce costs and lead times while making high\-quality space components more accessible.
 



  





**Position Overview** 




 You'll develop cutting\-edge image processing algorithms that power ground\-based telescopes for satellite navigation systems. You'll design ML/DL models for astronomical object detection, focusing on star tracking and celestial object classification that directly supports the company's ADCS systems. This role offers direct impact on space technology that keeps satellites operational, with exposure to both hardware integration and algorithm optimization for real\-sky conditions.
 



  





**Role \& Responsibilities** 



* You design and develop high\-performance ML/DL models for object detection in astronomical images, identifying stars as spots/blobs and objects as streaks/lines
* You implement detection and classification algorithms to distinguish between stellar blobs and object streaks with sub\-pixel accuracy
* You train and test models using synthetic and real astronomical image datasets
* You document model performance evaluation and report coordinate retrieval with sub\-pixel precision
* You optimize algorithms for real\-sky conditions including various signal and noise environments
* You collaborate with hardware teams to integrate image processing solutions with ADCS components
* You deliver technical documentation and briefings on algorithm performance and implementation



  





**Must Have Criteria** 



* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics, Physics, Data Science, Astronomy, or related technical field

* Strong proficiency in Python with Object\-Oriented Programming (OOP) implementation skills
* Academic or project experience with CNN architectures for object detection and classification
* Hands\-on experience with PyTorch and TensorFlow/Keras through coursework or personal projects
* Familiarity with scientific Python libraries: Astropy, Scikit\-learn, and SciPy
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with ability to learn independently



  





**Nice to Have** 



* Understanding of astronomical images and signal/noise conditions in real\-sky imaging
* Knowledge of Bayesian methods and probabilistic models for orientation estimation
* Experience with OpenCV for computer vision tasks and image preprocessing
* Git repository management experience and version control best practices
* Academic projects or internships in aerospace, astronomy, or satellite imaging applications



  





**What We Offer** 



* Opportunity to work on cutting\-edge space technology at a venture\-backed startup
* Direct impact on revolutionizing the space component supply chain
* Collaborative environment with experienced engineers from high\-volume scaleups
* Exposure to both US and India operations in the growing commercial space ecosystem
* Ground\-floor opportunity in a mission\-focused, rapidly scaling organization

 39k Group is a high\-frequency trading firm operating globally across centralized crypto exchanges. We specialize in ultra\-low\-latency strategies and market making, scaling infrastructure to handle billions of events daily with microsecond\-level performance.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 We’re hiring a Analyst \- Trading to design and drive trading strategies that sit at the heart of our business. You’ll work at the intersection of markets, quantitative research, and technology — generating ideas, testing them in simulation, and bringing them to live execution with the support of developers and researchers.
 



  





 This role is ideal for those who combine strong quantitative intuition with a love of real\-time markets. You’ll be empowered to experiment, measure, and iterate quickly — with your decisions directly impacting PnL.
 



  





**What You’ll Do** 



* Generate trading hypotheses across spot, perpetuals, and futures markets.
* Develop, backtest, and refine alpha signals and strategy logic using large\-scale tick and order book data.
* Collaborate with quantitative developers to bring strategies into ultra\-low\-latency production environments.
* Monitor strategy performance and adapt parameters in real time based on market conditions.
* Analyze execution quality, slippage, and queue positioning to optimize fills and PnL.
* Stay ahead of market microstructure changes, exchange mechanics, and competitive landscape.

**Must Have** 




  




* 1–2 years of experience in a trading, quant research, or systematic strategy role.
* Strong grasp of probability, statistics, and time\-series analysis.
* Comfort working with tick\-level data and large datasets.
* Familiarity with market microstructure, order books, and execution mechanics.
* Hands\-on experience with at least two of: Python, C\+\+, or Rust.

* Experience trading crypto or FX markets.
* Ability to formulate strategies under real\-time constraints.
* Cross\-functional ability to communicate with developers on latency, execution, and system constraints.



  





**Why Join Us?** 



* Run live strategies with direct impact on firm PnL.
* Collaborate closely with world\-class quants and developers in a fast\-moving environment.
* Access global markets with cutting\-edge low\-latency infrastructure.
* Hybrid flexibility, high ownership, and exposure to every layer of trading — from signal to execution.



  





 If you thrive in fast markets, love testing ideas, and want your strategies to shape live trading, we’d love to hear from you.

description:
We are looking for a **Technical Associate – Labicon \& ViSetu** to support the promotion, demonstration, implementation and first\-level technical support of our **Labicon Software** and **ViSetu Industrial IoT / Environmental Monitoring Solutions**.

This is a **technical customer\-facing role** combining product promotion, application understanding, customer visits, demonstrations, basic installation/configuration and troubleshooting.

The candidate will work closely with our **central R\&D and technical team** for advanced software, embedded device and integration requirements.

Key Responsibilities1\. Product Promotion \& Customer Engagement

* Visit laboratories, pharmaceutical companies, food industries, manufacturing units, warehouses and other potential customers.

* Explain product features and benefits to customers in simple technical language.
* Conduct product demonstrations at customer sites or remotely.
* Generate technical enquiries and support the sales process.
* Follow up with customers for demonstrations, trials, quotations and implementation.
* Develop relationships with customers, consultants, system integrators and channel partners.
* Identify new application opportunities for Labicon and ViSetu.

Provide first\-level technical support for **Labicon Laboratory Software and Instrument Integration**.

Responsibilities may include:

* Understanding laboratory workflows and customer requirements.
* Supporting installation and configuration of Labicon.

* Analytical balances
* Laboratory instruments
* RS232 / RS485 communication
* USB communication
* Ethernet connectivity

3\. ViSetu – Technical Support

Provide first\-level technical support for **ViSetu / ViSetu EMS** solutions.

Responsibilities may include:

* Understand environmental and industrial monitoring applications.
* Visit customer sites for basic application surveys.
* Assist in sensor/device selection based on application requirements.

* Configure sensors, gateways and communication parameters.

* Check basic device communication and connectivity issues.
* Assist customers with dashboard, alarm and monitoring functions.
* Support basic troubleshooting before escalation to the central technical team.

**4\. Demonstration \& Application Support**

The candidate should be comfortable conducting demonstrations of:

**Labicon**

* Laboratory software
* Instrument integration
* Data capture
* Laboratory workflow
* Reports and records

**ViSetu / ViSetu EMS**

* Temperature monitoring
* Humidity monitoring
* Differential pressure monitoring
* Environmental monitoring
* Wireless sensors
* Alerts and alarms
* Dashboard and trends
* Local/server/cloud monitoring

The candidate should be able to explain **how the product solves the customer's actual problem**, rather than simply presenting software features.

Instrumentation

* Laboratory instruments
* Analytical balances
* Sensors and transmitters
* Temperature / humidity instruments
* Differential pressure
* Industrial instrumentation
* Calibration concepts

Communication

* RS232
* RS485
* USB
* Ethernet
* TCP/IP
* Modbus
* Wi\-Fi
* Basic networking

Software

* Windows
* Basic database understanding
* SQL fundamentals
* Web applications
* Basic troubleshooting
* Software installation/configuration

IoT / Embedded

* Sensors
* IoT devices
* Data loggers
* Gateways
* Wireless communication
* Basic embedded\-device troubleshooting

**Deep programming knowledge is not mandatory.**

However, the candidate must have sufficient technical understanding to communicate effectively with customers and the central R\&D team.

Customer\-Facing Responsibilities

The candidate will regularly interact with:

* Pharmaceutical companies
* Laboratories
* Food and FMCG companies
* Chemical industries
* Manufacturing companies
* Warehouses
* Cold storage facilities
* Hospitals / healthcare facilities
* Research institutions
* Instrument dealers
* System integrators

The candidate should therefore have:

* Good communication skills
* Professional customer handling
* Willingness to travel locally and regionally
* Good presentation ability
* Logical troubleshooting skills
* Ability to understand customer requirements

Coordination With Central R\&D Team

The Technical Associate will **not be expected to independently solve every advanced technical issue**.

The candidate will:

**Customer → First\-Level Technical Support → Technical Diagnosis → Central R\&D/Application Team → Resolution**

For complex cases involving:

* Firmware changes
* New instrument integration
* Database issues
* Advanced software customization
* Embedded\-device development
* API/server\-level problems

the candidate will collect the required technical information and coordinate with the central team.

Education

Preferred:

* Diploma / BE / BTech – Instrumentation
* Electronics
* Electrical
* Industrial Electronics
* Automation
* Mechatronics
* Mechanical with relevant industrial experience

Also considered:

* BSc / MSc – Physics, Chemistry, Microbiology or related laboratory disciplines
* Candidates with relevant laboratory/instrumentation experience

Experience

**1–5 years of experience preferred.**

Candidates with experience in any of the following will be preferred:

* Instrumentation
* Laboratory equipment
* Industrial automation
* Technical support
* Application engineering
* IoT products
* Environmental monitoring
* Pharmaceutical equipment
* Laboratory software
* Instrument integration
* Technical sales / business development

**Freshers with strong technical aptitude and good communication skills may also be considered.**

We are looking for someone who can become the **local technical face of Labicon and ViSetu in Hyderabad \& South States**.

The ideal candidate should be:

**Technical \+ Customer Friendly \+ Willing to Travel \+ Good at Demonstrations \+ Good at Troubleshooting**

This is **not a pure telecalling or conventional sales position**.

It is a combination of:

**Product Promotion \+ Application Support \+ Technical Demonstration \+ Customer Support \+ Basic Implementation**

* Develop relationships with laboratories, industries and dealers.

Higher compensation may be considered for candidates with strong relevant experience in instrumentation, industrial automation, laboratory equipment, IoT or established customer relationships.

Career Opportunity

**Laboratory Software \+ Instrument Integration \+ Industrial IoT \+ Sensors \+ Environmental Monitoring \+ Embedded Devices \+ Technical Applications**

Successful candidates can grow into:

**Senior Technical Associate → Application Engineer → Regional Technical \& Business Development Manager**

description:
**Are you ready to trade your job for a journey? Become a FlyMate!**
  

  

  

 Passion, excitement \& global collaboration are all core to what it means to be a FlyMate. At Flywire, we’re on a mission to deliver the world’s most important and complex payments. We use our Flywire Advantage \- the combination of our next\-gen payments platform, proprietary payment network and vertical specific software, to help our clients get paid, and help their customers pay with ease \- no matter where they are in the world.
   

  





 What more do we need to truly be unstoppable? Perhaps, that is you!
   

  





**Who we are:**




 Flywire is a global payments enablement and software company, founded more than a decade ago to solve high\-stakes, high\-value payments. We’ve scaled into new regions and industry verticals and expanded our product offerings to deliver meaningful value to our clients around the world.
   

  





 Today we support more than 5,300 clients across the global education, healthcare, travel \& B2B industries, with diverse payment methods across 240 countries \& territories and more than 140 currencies.
   

  





 With over 1,400\+ global FlyMates, representing more than 40 nationalities, and in 15 offices world\-wide, we’re looking for FlyMates to join the next stage of our journey as we continue to grow.
   

  





  

  

  

  




**Job Description**

**Job Summary:**




 As a
 **Security Engineer II** 
 on the Active Operational Defender track you will build hands on experience across penetration testing, threat detection and incident response, working under the direction of senior and lead engineers. You will support live operational work within a high velocity fintech environment, developing the manual testing and detection engineering skills needed to take on more independent responsibility over time.
   

  





**Responsibilities and Tasks:**




**1\. Offensive Penetration Testing \& Red Teaming**



* Support penetration testing engagements across financial platforms and product architectures under senior guidance, building practical exploit research experience.
* Assist with manual security reviews including source code audits, API testing and cloud configuration checks, working towards independent delivery of smaller engagements.
* Contribute to adversarial testing of AI features where in scope, learning to identify prompt injection and related LLM specific weaknesses.



**2\. Threat Detection Engineering \& SIEM**



* Help design and tune detection rules and alert workflows within the enterprise SIEM, working from senior engineers' guidance and established detection frameworks.
* Support SecOps in reviewing detection coverage against current threats, referencing frameworks such as MITRE ATT\&CK.



**3\. Incident Response \& Forensics**



* Act as a first line responder during active security incidents, carrying out evidence collection and initial triage under senior direction.
* Support post incident analysis by pulling together logs, timelines and technical findings for senior review.



**4\. Cross Functional Collaboration \& Development**



* Take part in security operations and engineering planning to build a practical understanding of detection and response capability.
* Communicate findings from testing and incidents clearly to immediate team members and stakeholders.
* Actively seek mentorship from senior and lead security engineers on offensive tooling, detection engineering and incident response practice.


**Qualifications**
* **Education:** 
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cyber Security, Software Engineering or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* **Core Experience:** 
 indicative range
 **\[1 to 3 years]** 
 of hands on experience in penetration testing, security operations or a closely related technical role.
* **Foundational Offensive Skills:** 
 exposure to manual web application testing, CTF style exploitation or vulnerability research, gained through work experience, personal projects or study.
* **SecOps \& Forensics Familiarity:** 
 basic working knowledge of SIEM concepts, EDR tooling or network packet analysis, and an interest in frameworks such as MITRE ATT\&CK.
* **Technical Language Foundation:** 
 comfort reading and, ideally, writing scripts in a language such as Python to support testing and automation.
* **AI Security Awareness:** 
 a working interest in the OWASP Top 10 for LLMs and how adversarial testing of AI features differs from traditional application testing.
* **Regulatory Awareness** 
 : a general understanding of standards such as PCI\-DSS, SOC 2 or DORA, with willingness to build practical depth on the job.
   

  

  

  

**Highly Preferred Certifications**
* Hands\-On Offensive \& Red Team: OSCP, OSCE or SANS GXPN (GIAC Exploit Researcher and Advanced Penetration Tester).
* Incident Response \& Defence: GCIH (GIAC Certified Incident Handler), GCFA (GIAC Certified Forensic Analyst) or a specialised Blue Team certification.
   

  

  

  

**Skills and Abilities**
* Combines an aggressive, attacker's mindset used to find vulnerabilities with the analytical discipline required to write clear, actionable detection rules.
* Stays calm and analytically clear under intense pressure during active, live breach events or business critical system failures.
* Communicates exploit chains and log anomalies clearly, turning technical detail into a plain, high impact risk profile for non\-technical leadership.
* Resilience and analytical clarity in high\-pressure scenarios, supporting transparent communication and contributing to risk\-based decisions during active security incidents or compressed financial product launch windows.
* Balances technical risk reduction with business enablement, supporting security infrastructure that serves as a competitive advantage and helps unblock global revenue and enterprise\-client acquisition.
* Modern AI Security: OffSec OSAI (Offensive Security AI Red Teamer).


**Additional Information**

**What We Offer:**



* Competitive compensation
* Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)
* Competitive time off, including Digital Disconnect and FlyBetter Days to volunteer in a cause you believe in.
* Flying Start \- Our immersive Global Induction Program (Meet our Execs \& Global Teams)
* Work with brilliant people globally Learn more about their journeys by checking out \#InsideFlywire on social media
* Wellbeing Programs (Mental Health, Wellness, Yoga/Pilates/HIIT Classes) with Global FlyMates
* Be a meaningful part in our success \- every FlyMate makes an impact
* Great Talent \& Development Programs (Managers Taking Flight – for new or aspiring managers, OneFlywire Career Mobility)



**Submit today and get started!**




 We are excited to get to know you! Throughout our process you can expect to meet with different FlyMates including the Hiring Manager, Peers on the team, the VP of the department, and a skills assessment. Your Talent Acquisition Partner will walk you through the steps and be your “go\-to” person for any questions.

title: Territory Service Representative DLF 377235
description:
Blue Dart Express Limited, a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. Founded in 1983, it is recognised for reliable, time\-bound, and secure delivery services across 55,000\+ locations in India as well as internationally. Its competencies span across evaluation and contracting, planning and transition, delivery and execution, and specific service capabilities. We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long\-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast\-paced logistics environment and ever\-evolving supply\-chains. It wholly\-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004\.
Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India\-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.  

We are proud to be consistently ranked among India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work, combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an Employer of Choice is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.
If you are looking to join a purpose\-led, people\-first, company that shapes India’s supply\-chains with integrity and safety, Blue Dart is where you belong. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross\-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.  

  

  

Position Overview:
The Territory Service Representative (TSR) – Operations is responsible for the timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within an assigned territory while delivering a superior customer experience and representing the Blue Dart brand with professionalism.
Operating as the face of Blue Dart on the ground, the role ensures safe handling of shipments, timely collections and deliveries, accurate shipment scanning, COD collections, proof of delivery (POD) compliance and adherence to operational procedures. The TSR works closely with the Shift In\-charge and branch operations team to ensure service commitments are consistently achieved while maintaining the highest standards of safety, customer service and operational discipline.  

Job Purpose:
To execute timely pickup and delivery of shipments, ensure accurate shipment handling, customer interactions and COD collections while adhering to Blue Dart's operational standards, safety requirements and service commitments.  

Key Roles \& Responsibilities:
Pickup \& Delivery Operations* Perform timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within the assigned route or territory.
* Ensure all shipments are delivered within committed service timelines.
* Verify shipment details before pickup and delivery.
* Handle shipments carefully to prevent damage or loss.
* Maintain delivery productivity and route efficiency.

  

Customer Service Excellence* Serve as the face of Blue Dart during every customer interaction.
* Maintain courteous, professional and customer\-centric behaviour at all times.
* Resolve basic customer queries during pickups and deliveries.
* Escalate customer concerns or operational exceptions promptly.
* Maintain high standards of grooming, behaviour and professionalism.

  

COD \& Documentation Management* Collect Cash on Delivery (COD) payments wherever applicable.
* Ensure accurate cash handling and timely remittance as per company procedures.
* Obtain Proof of Delivery (POD), customer acknowledgements and required shipment documentation.
* Ensure documentation accuracy and compliance with operational procedures.
* Report discrepancies immediately.

  

Operational Compliance* Scan shipments accurately using handheld devices or approved digital platforms.
* Ensure shipment status updates are completed in real time.
* Follow all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) during pickup and delivery activities.
* Adhere to company policies relating to shipment handling, documentation and customer interaction.
* Support operational requirements during peak business periods.

  

Safety \& Security* Follow all road safety guidelines while operating company or personal vehicles.
* Ensure safe handling and security of customer shipments throughout transit.
* Wear the prescribed company uniform and personal protective equipment wherever applicable.
* Report accidents, incidents or unsafe conditions immediately.
* Protect company assets and customer property.

  

Vehicle \& Asset Responsibility* Maintain the assigned vehicle or personal two\-wheeler in roadworthy condition.
* Ensure all statutory vehicle documents remain valid.
* Maintain cleanliness and basic upkeep of the vehicle.
* Report maintenance requirements promptly.

  

Workplace Discipline \& Brand Representation* Maintain high standards of personal grooming, hygiene and professional appearance.
* Wear the prescribed Blue Dart uniform and identity card while on duty.
* Demonstrate discipline, punctuality and professionalism at all times.
* Follow workplace rules, operational discipline and company policies.
* Represent the Blue Dart brand positively through behaviour, teamwork and commitment to service excellence.

  

Team Collaboration* Work closely with Shift In\-charges and branch operations teams.
* Support colleagues during operational contingencies.
* Participate in operational briefings and safety meetings.
* Contribute towards achieving branch productivity and service goals.

  

Qualifications \& Experience:
Education:* Minimum 10th Standard Pass.
* Higher educational qualifications will be an added advantage.

  

Experience:* Fresher or up to 2 years of relevant experience in courier, logistics, distribution, retail delivery or field operations.
* Experience in pickup and delivery operations will be an added advantage.

  

Eligibility Requirements:* Minimum age 18 years.
* Valid Two\-Wheeler or Four\-Wheeler Driving Licence.
* Must own a two\-wheeler where deployment requires the employee to use a personal vehicle, in accordance with Company policy.
* Physically fit to perform field operations.
* Willingness to work across shifts, weekends and holidays based on business requirements.

  

Skills \& Capabilities:  

Technical Skills:* Pickup \& Delivery Operations
* Shipment Handling
* Cash Collection (COD)
* Proof of Delivery (POD)
* Mobile Device / Scanner Usage
* Route Familiarity
* Basic Computer \& Mobile Application Skills
* Basic English Reading \& Understanding


Key Competencies:* Customer Focus
* Integrity
* Reliability
* Safety Consciousness
* Teamwork
* Discipline
* Time Management
* Accountability
* Positive Attitude
* Professional Appearance

  

Key Performance Indicators:  

KRAs KPIs
Delivery \& Pickup Performance On\-Time Delivery • Pickup Adherence • Delivery Productivity
Service Quality First Attempt Delivery • Shipment Handling Accuracy • Customer Satisfaction
COD \& Documentation COD Collection Accuracy • POD Completion • Zero Documentation Errors
Safety \& Compliance Safe Driving • SOP Adherence • Uniform \& Grooming Compliance
Operational Productivity Shipments Delivered/Picked Up • Scanner Compliance • Route Efficiency  

Why join DHL Blue Dart?
When you join us, you’re not just taking a job—you’re becoming part of a purpose\-led movement that’s reshaping the future of logistics across India and the world. At Blue Dart, we don’t just deliver parcels—we deliver excellence, innovation, and opportunity every day.
Here’s what makes us stand out:* Great Place to Work® Certified—a testament to our people\-first culture, inclusive environment, and commitment to your growth and well\-being.
* Competitive pay and performance\-linked rewards that truly recognize your impact.
* Structured learning, global exposure, and on\-the\-job coaching to help you grow faster than ever.
* Best\-in\-class benefits—from comprehensive medical cover (including optional parental care) to financial wellness and generous time off.
* A culture that celebrates diversity, innovation, and bold thinking—where your voice is heard and your contributions matter.
* Global career paths across the DHL Group, opening doors to opportunities in 220\+ countries and territories.
* The pride of working with India’s most awarded logistics brand, trusted by millions and driven by purpose.


This is your chance to do meaningful work, build a career without borders, and thrive in a company that’s not just a logistics leader—but a Great Place to Work. Come grow with us.

Job Overview

Maskoid Technologies is looking for a **multi\-skilled IT Network \& Hardware Administrator** to manage and maintain the company's complete IT infrastructure.

The role involves **office IT support, hardware troubleshooting, system and network administration, server management, website hosting and deployment, DNS/SSL management, WordPress administration, backups, security, monitoring, and basic Python automation**.

The ideal candidate should be comfortable handling day\-to\-day employee IT issues as well as independently managing servers, networks, hosting environments, website deployments, and infrastructure\-related tasks.

Roles \& Responsibilities1\. Office IT Support \& Hardware

* Troubleshoot employee IT issues including system slowness, keyboard/mouse, monitor, audio, and peripheral issues.
* Install and configure operating systems, office applications, security tools, and required software.
* Maintain desktops, laptops, printers, scanners, and other IT peripherals.
* Ensure all office IT systems are operational, secure, and properly maintained.
* Maintain inventory and stock of IT accessories, spare hardware, and components.

2\. System \& Network Administration

* Install, configure, and maintain **Windows and Linux servers**.
* Manage **Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, Group Policies, and user accounts**.
* Configure and troubleshoot routers, switches, firewalls, Wi\-Fi access points, and NAS devices.
* Troubleshoot LAN, Wi\-Fi, Internet, and connectivity\-related issues.
* Perform OS updates, security patches, driver installations, and firmware upgrades.
* Manage basic firewall and VPN configurations.

3\. Website Hosting, Deployment \& Server Management

* Deploy websites on **cPanel, Plesk, VPS, and cloud hosting environments**.
* Manage DNS records including **A, CNAME, MX, TXT, SPF, DKIM, and SRV**.
* Perform website and server migrations.
* Install, renew, and troubleshoot SSL certificates.
* Troubleshoot server and hosting issues such as:
* High CPU/RAM usage
* HTTP 500/503 errors
* Database errors
* Email delivery issues
* Maintain backups of hosting accounts, databases, and website files.
* Monitor website uptime and server performance.

4\. WordPress Website Management

* Install and configure WordPress on hosting environments.
* Manage WordPress themes, plugins, and updates.

* Perform WordPress website backup and restoration.
* Perform basic performance optimization including caching, image optimization, and plugin cleanup.

5\. System Monitoring \& Performance

* Perform daily server and system health checks.
* Monitor server load, storage, memory, and network performance.
* Ensure high uptime and reliability of internal systems and services.
* Identify performance bottlenecks and take corrective action.
* Implement and maintain monitoring and alerting systems.

6\. Backup, Security \& Compliance

* Manage daily and weekly backups of systems, servers, databases, and critical data.
* Perform periodic restoration tests to verify backup integrity.
* Manage endpoint protection, antivirus, and IT security controls.
* Manage access controls and password management systems.

7\. Domain, SSL \& IT Documentation

* Manage domain purchases, renewals, transfers, and DNS updates.
* Manage SSL installation, renewal, and troubleshooting.
* Maintain IT documentation, including:
* SOPs
* Network diagrams
* DNS documentation
* Server and hosting documentation
* IT asset information
* Access and configuration records

8\. Vendor \& Service Provider Coordination

* Coordinate with hosting providers, cloud vendors, IT suppliers, and service providers.
* Manage AMC agreements, warranty claims, and technical support escalations.
* Coordinate software and service renewals.
* Track licenses, subscriptions, and related IT services.

9\. Automation \& Python Scripting

* Develop basic Python scripts to automate repetitive IT tasks.
* Automate tasks such as system checks, log monitoring, and backup validation.
* Create simple automation tools for deployment, reporting, and monitoring.
* Maintain and improve existing IT automation scripts.

* Desktop and laptop troubleshooting

JOB DESCRIPTIONVideo Editor \& Graphic Designer

**Company:** DPFXPERT Private Limited  
**Department:** Marketing \& Growth  
**Role:** Video Editor \& Graphic Designer  
**Employment:** Full\-Time  
**Reports To:** Marketing / Management

ABOUT DPFXPERT

DPFXPERT is **The Pioneers of DPF Cleaning in India**, building a complete DPF solutions ecosystem covering professional DPF cleaning services, DPF cleaning machines, franchise operations, training, technology and technical support.

We are looking for a **fast, creative and execution\-focused Video Editor \& Graphic Designer** who can turn ideas, raw footage and briefs into high\-quality marketing content quickly.

For this role, **what you can create matters more than your degree or years of experience.**

ROLE PURPOSE

To create **high\-quality videos and graphic content at exceptional speed** for DPFXPERT's digital marketing, sales, branding and internal communication requirements.

The ideal candidate should be someone who can:

**Understand the idea → Visualize it → Create it → Edit it → Deliver it FAST.**

Speed is important, but **speed should not compromise brand quality.**

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES1\. Video Editing

Create and edit:

* Instagram/Facebook Reels
* YouTube Shorts and videos
* Promotional videos
* Customer testimonials
* Machine demonstration videos
* DPF cleaning process videos
* Franchise and machine marketing videos
* Educational and technical videos
* Event and corporate videos
* Recruitment and internal communication videos

The editor should be comfortable working with raw footage from mobile phones, cameras and other sources and converting it into professional content.

2\. Graphic Design

Create:

* Social media creatives
* Carousel posts
* Posters
* Thumbnails
* Infographics
* Advertisements
* Promotional banners
* WhatsApp marketing creatives
* Presentation graphics
* Recruitment creatives
* Event creatives
* Simple brochures and marketing materials

All designs must consistently follow DPFXPERT's brand guidelines.

3\. Fast Content Execution

This is a **high\-speed content production role**.

The candidate should be capable of receiving a brief and producing the first usable output with minimum turnaround time.

Simple social\-media creatives and edits should ideally be completed **within hours rather than days**.

The person should be comfortable handling urgent marketing requirements and quick revisions without compromising quality.

4\. Creative Contribution

We do not want someone who only waits for detailed instructions.

The candidate should:

* Suggest better visual approaches
* Convert rough ideas into engaging content
* Identify opportunities from available footage
* Suggest hooks, transitions and storytelling formats
* Follow current social\-media content trends
* Experiment with new editing styles and formats
* Use AI and modern creative tools wherever they improve speed or quality

5\. Brand Consistency

Every output should maintain DPFXPERT's professional and authoritative positioning.

The candidate must maintain consistency in logo usage, typography, colours, layouts and overall visual identity.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

The ideal candidate is:

* Extremely fast in execution
* Creative and visually strong
* Good at both video editing and graphic design
* Comfortable with short\-form social\-media content
* Able to understand briefs quickly
* Capable of working independently
* Detail\-oriented without becoming unnecessarily slow
* Comfortable receiving feedback and making quick revisions
* Able to prioritize urgent content
* Curious about new editing, AI and content\-creation tools
* Focused on completed output rather than activity

SOFTWARE / SKILLS

Candidates may use tools such as:

**Video:** Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, CapCut or equivalent.

**Graphics:** Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, Canva, Figma or equivalent.

Knowledge of **AI\-powered video, image, audio, subtitle and content\-generation tools** will be an added advantage.

We are not particular about which software is used.

**The final quality and speed of execution matter more than the tool.**

PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS

Performance will primarily be measured on:

**Speed \+ Quality \+ Creativity \+ Brand Consistency \+ Reliability**

Key expectations include:

* Turnaround time
* Number of usable creatives/videos delivered
* Quality of final output
* Accuracy of branding
* Ability to understand briefs correctly
* Number of revisions required
* Ability to meet deadlines
* Creative contribution and new ideas

QUALIFICATIONS

Formal educational qualifications are **not the primary selection criterion**.

Candidates from any educational background may apply if they can demonstrate strong creative ability.

Freshers with exceptional portfolios are welcome.

Experienced candidates must also demonstrate their capability through actual work.

SELECTION PROCESSSelection will be based primarily on actual work.Stage 1 – Portfolio / Sample Work Review

Candidates must submit samples of:

* Short\-form videos / Reels
* Promotional or corporate videos
* Graphic designs / social\-media creatives
* Any work demonstrating creativity and editing capability

Applications without relevant sample work may not be shortlisted.

Stage 2 – Practical Trial

Shortlisted candidates will be given DPFXPERT content/raw material and a brief.

They may be asked to create:

**1 short\-form video \+ 1 graphic creative**

within a defined time.

The trial will evaluate:

**1\. Speed of execution**  
**2\. Video editing quality**  
**3\. Graphic design quality**  
**4\. Creativity**  
**5\. Understanding of the brief**  
**6\. Brand consistency**  
**7\. Attention to detail**  
**8\. Ability to produce publish\-ready content**

Stage 3 – Final Discussion

The final discussion will focus on:

* Creative thinking
* Work attitude
* Ability to work under deadlines
* Response to feedback
* Ownership
* Alignment with DPFXPERT's work culture and LIFE values

IMPORTANT

**We are not looking for someone who takes two days to create something that can be professionally completed in two hours.**

At the same time, speed without quality is not acceptable.

We want someone who continuously asks:

**“How can I make this better — and deliver it faster?”**

**About DHL Blue Dart Express India:**


  

**Blue Dart Express Limited**, a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. Founded in 1983, it is recognised for reliable, time\-bound, and secure delivery services across 55,000\+ locations in India as well as internationally. Its competencies span across evaluation and contracting, planning and transition, delivery and execution, and specific service capabilities. We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long\-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast\-paced logistics environment and ever\-evolving supply\-chains. It wholly\-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004\.


Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India\-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.


We are proud to be consistently ranked among **India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work**, combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an **Employer of Choice** is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.


If you are looking to join a purpose\-led, people\-first, company that shapes India’s supply\-chains with integrity and safety, **Blue Dart is where you belong**. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross\-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.


**Position Overview:**


  

The **Territory Service Representative (TSR) – Operations** is responsible for the timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within an assigned territory while delivering a superior customer experience and representing the Blue Dart brand with professionalism.


Operating as the face of Blue Dart on the ground, the role ensures safe handling of shipments, timely collections and deliveries, accurate shipment scanning, COD collections, proof of delivery (POD) compliance and adherence to operational procedures. The TSR works closely with the Shift In\-charge and branch operations team to ensure service commitments are consistently achieved while maintaining the highest standards of safety, customer service and operational discipline.


**Job Purpose:**


  

To execute timely pickup and delivery of shipments, ensure accurate shipment handling, customer interactions and COD collections while adhering to Blue Dart's operational standards, safety requirements and service commitments.


**Key Roles \& Responsibilities:**


  

**Pickup \& Delivery Operations**

* Perform timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within the assigned route or territory.
* Ensure all shipments are delivered within committed service timelines.
* Verify shipment details before pickup and delivery.
* Handle shipments carefully to prevent damage or loss.
* Maintain delivery productivity and route efficiency.

**Customer Service Excellence**

* Serve as the face of Blue Dart during every customer interaction.
* Maintain courteous, professional and customer\-centric behaviour at all times.
* Resolve basic customer queries during pickups and deliveries.
* Escalate customer concerns or operational exceptions promptly.
* Maintain high standards of grooming, behaviour and professionalism.

**COD \& Documentation Management**

* Collect Cash on Delivery (COD) payments wherever applicable.
* Ensure accurate cash handling and timely remittance as per company procedures.
* Obtain Proof of Delivery (POD), customer acknowledgements and required shipment documentation.
* Ensure documentation accuracy and compliance with operational procedures.
* Report discrepancies immediately.

**Operational Compliance**

* Scan shipments accurately using handheld devices or approved digital platforms.
* Ensure shipment status updates are completed in real time.
* Follow all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) during pickup and delivery activities.
* Adhere to company policies relating to shipment handling, documentation and customer interaction.
* Support operational requirements during peak business periods.

**Safety \& Security**

* Follow all road safety guidelines while operating company or personal vehicles.
* Ensure safe handling and security of customer shipments throughout transit.
* Wear the prescribed company uniform and personal protective equipment wherever applicable.
* Report accidents, incidents or unsafe conditions immediately.
* Protect company assets and customer property.

**Vehicle \& Asset Responsibility**

* Maintain the assigned vehicle or personal two\-wheeler in roadworthy condition.
* Ensure all statutory vehicle documents remain valid.
* Maintain cleanliness and basic upkeep of the vehicle.
* Report maintenance requirements promptly.

**Workplace Discipline \& Brand Representation**

* Maintain high standards of personal grooming, hygiene and professional appearance.
* Wear the prescribed Blue Dart uniform and identity card while on duty.
* Demonstrate discipline, punctuality and professionalism at all times.
* Follow workplace rules, operational discipline and company policies.
* Represent the Blue Dart brand positively through behaviour, teamwork and commitment to service excellence.

**Team Collaboration**

* Work closely with Shift In\-charges and branch operations teams.
* Support colleagues during operational contingencies.
* Participate in operational briefings and safety meetings.
* Contribute towards achieving branch productivity and service goals.


**Qualifications \& Experience:**


  

**Education**:


* Minimum **10th Standard Pass**.
* Higher educational qualifications will be an added advantage.

**Experience**:

* Fresher or up to **2 years** of relevant experience in courier, logistics, distribution, retail delivery or field operations.
* Experience in pickup and delivery operations will be an added advantage.

**Eligibility Requirements:**

* Minimum age **18 years.**
* Valid **Two\-Wheeler** or Four\-Wheeler Driving Licence.
* Must own a two\-wheeler where deployment requires the employee to use a personal vehicle, in accordance with Company policy.
* Physically fit to perform field operations.
* Willingness to work across shifts, weekends and holidays based on business requirements.

**Skills \& Capabilities:**


  

**Technical Skills:**

* Pickup \& Delivery Operations
* Shipment Handling
* Cash Collection (COD)
* Proof of Delivery (POD)
* Mobile Device / Scanner Usage
* Route Familiarity
* Basic Computer \& Mobile Application Skills
* Basic English Reading \& Understanding

**Key Competencies:**

* Customer Focus
* Integrity
* Reliability
* Safety Consciousness
* Teamwork
* Discipline
* Time Management
* Accountability
* Positive Attitude
* Professional Appearance


**Key Performance Indicators:**


  

**KRAs**

  

**KPIs**

  

  

Delivery \& Pickup Performance

  

On\-Time Delivery • Pickup Adherence • Delivery Productivity

  

  

Service Quality

  

First Attempt Delivery • Shipment Handling Accuracy • Customer Satisfaction

  

  

COD \& Documentation

  

COD Collection Accuracy • POD Completion • Zero Documentation Errors

  

  

Safety \& Compliance

  

Safe Driving • SOP Adherence • Uniform \& Grooming Compliance

  

  

Operational Productivity

  

Shipments Delivered/Picked Up • Scanner Compliance • Route Efficiency


  

**Why join DHL Blue Dart?**


  

When you join us, you’re not just taking a job—you’re becoming part of a purpose\-led movement that’s reshaping the future of logistics across India and the world. At Blue Dart, we don’t just deliver parcels—we deliver excellence, innovation, and opportunity every day.


Here’s what makes us stand out:

* **Great Place to Work® Certified**—a testament to our people\-first culture, inclusive environment, and commitment to your growth and well\-being.
* **Competitive pay** and performance\-linked rewards that truly recognize your impact.
* Structured learning, **global exposure**, and on\-the\-job coaching to help you grow faster than ever.
* **Best\-in\-class benefits**—from comprehensive medical cover (including optional parental care) to financial wellness and generous time off.
* A culture that celebrates **diversity, innovation, and bold thinking**—where your voice is heard and your contributions matter.
* **Global career paths** across the DHL Group, opening doors to opportunities in 220\+ countries and territories.
* The pride of working with **India’s most awarded logistics brand**, trusted by millions and driven by purpose.

This is your chance to do meaningful work, build a career without borders, and thrive in a company that’s not just a logistics leader—but a Great Place to Work. **Come grow with us.**

**Disclaimer:**  

At Blue Dart Express Limited, all recruitment is conducted through a fair, transparent, and merit\-based process aligned with our commitments to Human Rights and Diversity, Equity, Inclusion \& Belonging (DEIB).


Blue Dart does not request or accept any fees, deposits, or payments from candidates at any stage of the recruitment or onboarding process. Any such request is fraudulent and unauthorized.


Blue Dart shall not be responsible for any loss arising from such fraudulent activity. For verification, candidates may write to bdjobs@bluedart.com.

**About DHL Blue Dart Express India:**


  

**Blue Dart Express Limited**, a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. Founded in 1983, it is recognised for reliable, time\-bound, and secure delivery services across 55,000\+ locations in India as well as internationally. Its competencies span across evaluation and contracting, planning and transition, delivery and execution, and specific service capabilities. We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long\-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast\-paced logistics environment and ever\-evolving supply\-chains. It wholly\-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004\.


Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India\-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.


We are proud to be consistently ranked among **India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work**, combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an **Employer of Choice** is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.


If you are looking to join a purpose\-led, people\-first, company that shapes India’s supply\-chains with integrity and safety, **Blue Dart is where you belong**. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross\-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.


**Position Overview:**


  

The **Territory Service Representative (TSR) – Operations** is responsible for the timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within an assigned territory while delivering a superior customer experience and representing the Blue Dart brand with professionalism.


Operating as the face of Blue Dart on the ground, the role ensures safe handling of shipments, timely collections and deliveries, accurate shipment scanning, COD collections, proof of delivery (POD) compliance and adherence to operational procedures. The TSR works closely with the Shift In\-charge and branch operations team to ensure service commitments are consistently achieved while maintaining the highest standards of safety, customer service and operational discipline.


**Job Purpose:**

**Key Roles \& Responsibilities:**

* Verify shipment details before pickup and delivery.
* Handle shipments carefully to prevent damage or loss.
* Maintain delivery productivity and route efficiency.

**Customer Service Excellence**

* Ensure documentation accuracy and compliance with operational procedures.

* Ensure shipment status updates are completed in real time.

* Support operational requirements during peak business periods.

* Wear the prescribed company uniform and personal protective equipment wherever applicable.

* Protect company assets and customer property.

* Ensure all statutory vehicle documents remain valid.
* Maintain cleanliness and basic upkeep of the vehicle.
* Report maintenance requirements promptly.

* Wear the prescribed Blue Dart uniform and identity card while on duty.
* Demonstrate discipline, punctuality and professionalism at all times.
* Follow workplace rules, operational discipline and company policies.
* Represent the Blue Dart brand positively through behaviour, teamwork and commitment to service excellence.

\- Maintain proper records of hardware received, repaired, replaced, and delivered.

\- Ensure timely closure of customer complaints and service requests.

\- Follow company SOPs and maintain proper service documentation.

\- Have good knowledge of Delhi NCR areas, routes, and localities.

\- Be comfortable travelling independently for customer visits.

\- Have knowledge of major areas in Delhi, Noida, Greater Noida, Ghaziabad, Gurugram, and Faridabad.

\- Be familiar with Delhi Metro routes and major metro stations.

\- Be able to identify the most convenient route using Metro, bus, or other local transport.

\- Reach customer locations on time and manage multiple field visits efficiently.

Required Skills

\- Good knowledge of computer hardware and troubleshooting.

\- Knowledge of Windows installation and configuration.

\- Knowledge of RAM, SSD/HDD, motherboard, SMPS, battery, adapter, charger, etc.

\- Basic knowledge of networking and peripherals.

\- Good communication and customer\-handling skills.

\- Problem\-solving and diagnostic abilities.

\- Good knowledge of Delhi NCR locations and transportation.

\- Ability to work independently in field conditions.

Qualification \& Experience

\- Diploma/B.Tech/BCA/ITI or equivalent qualification in Computer Hardware, IT, Electronics, or a related field.

\- 1–10 years of experience in hardware support/field support is preferred.

\- Freshers with good technical knowledge and strong Delhi NCR route knowledge may also be considered.

Preferred Candidate Profile

\- Field\-support experience preferred.

\- Must be comfortable with daily travel within Delhi NCR.

\- Should have good knowledge of Delhi Metro and NCR routes.

\- Should be punctual, responsible, and customer\-oriented.

\- Should have a willingness to learn and handle different types of IT hardware.

title: Associate Key Account Manager (Sales) - Delhi
description:
**Openings –** 1 in Delhi  
**Experience \-** 1\-3 years in any service selling: insurance, edtech, fintech, real estate, hospitality, SaaS, staffing, telecom. Freshers with genuine hustle welcome.

**Build, Plan \& Close ₹1 crore worth multi media campaigns before you turn 25\.**

Excellent Publicity is a full\-service advertising and media agency. Since 2011 we have planned and bought media for 5,000\+ brands including the likes of Google, RBI, IIM\-A, Amazon, Uber and Apple, across 3,00,000\+ successful campaigns, spanning hoardings, airports, metro and transit, newspapers, radio, cinema, television, digital, performance, influencer \& sports.

We are an energetic young team of almost 100 people across Ahmedabad, Mumbai, Delhi, Bengaluru \& Dubai, with a strong in\-house tech team building superlative AI\-powered products, having built \& released two such products already: EPitch, which builds detailed media plans \& strategies in hours that most agencies take a fortnight to produce, and Atlas, which makes offline advertising as measurable \& transparent as digital.

We are hiring Associate Key Account Managers into four sales pods. This is not a support role. From month three you carry your own accounts, your own target and your own incentive cheque.

**What you will actually do:**

* Entire World is your territory. You decide which brands are worth chasing and you build the list yourself, along with the inbound inquiries, referrals \& research based potentials.
* Get to the decision maker. Marketing Heads, CMOs, founders. Cold calls, LinkedIn, email, WhatsApp, walk\-ins, industry events. We do not prescribe the method, we look at the meetings.
* Sit in the pitch. In the room from week one. Presenting parts of it yourself by the end of quarter one.
* Build the commercial. Work with our media team to turn a client brief into a media plan, a costing and a proposal that wins.
* Close, then keep. Renewals and upsells on your own accounts earn you incentive again. The book you build is the book you are paid on.

**Your first 90 days:**

1st \& 2nd Week\- Media 101, how OOH, print, radio, cinema, TV and digital are actually bought and priced. Shadow live client calls. Be in the room in real client meetings.

3rd – 6th Week \- Build your prospect list. First 100 outbound conversations. Sit in on live pitches. Also handle our inbound inquiries from our Media buying platform as well as the GTM we run.

7th – 12th \- Run your own first\-meeting pitches. Co\-own live proposals. First closure expected inside month four.

**What you will earn:**

Salary Range \- ₹4,80,000 \- ₹6,00,000 p.a.

Incentive \- Uncapped, linked to gross profit on every deal you close, paid quarterly

Realistic Year\-1 total, on target ₹6,20,000 \- ₹8,00,000

Fixed band is benchmarked to experience. The incentive is where the money is, and there is no ceiling on it. Our strongest performers have crossed ₹10 L in total earnings inside two years.

**Where this goes:**

Month 0 – 3 \- Learn the media landscape. Shadow live pitches. Build your prospect list.

Month 3 – 12 \- Carry an individual target. Close your first accounts.

Month 12 – 18 \- Promotion to Key Account Manager. Larger mandates, key accounts, materially higher fixed band.

Beyond City or category ownership. We are opening new markets and we promote from inside.

**Who we are looking for:**

* You can hold a conversation with someone twenty years senior without folding.
* You are fine being told "no" eight times before you get a "yes".
* You write a clear email and put together a decent PowerPoint.
* You are curious about brands, why they advertise where they do, and why they spend what they spend.
* Fluent English and Hindi.
* Any graduate. A track record of selling something, even a college fest sponsorship, matters more than the degree.

Not required: advertising experience, an MBA, or a marketing degree. We have built strong sellers out of people from insurance, edtech inside sales, telecom, real estate and retail.

**How to apply:**

Do not send only a CV. We get hundreds and most read identical.  
Send two things to chahal@excellentpublicity.com or WhatsApp \+917486031011

1\. Your CV.  
2\. A 60\-second voice note answering: "Pick any brand you have noticed advertising in your city in the last month. Where did you see it, and who do you think they were trying to reach?"  
There is no right answer. We are listening for how you think and how you speak, which is the job.

Pay: ₹480,000\.00 \- ₹600,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Experience:

* Sales: 1 year (Preferred)

Location:

* Delhi (Preferred)

Willingness to travel:

* 25% (Preferred)

title: Digital Marketing Specialist
description:
Digital Marketing Executive

**Job Location:** Hoshiarpur, Punjab  
**Job Type:** Full\-Time  
**Department:** Marketing  
**Experience:** 1–3 Years  
**Industry:** Digital Marketing / Advertising / E\-commerce / Lead Generation

About the Role

We are looking for a **performance\-driven Digital Marketing Executive** to join our team in **Hoshiarpur**. The ideal candidate should have hands\-on experience in **Meta Ads (Facebook \& Instagram Ads)** and be capable of planning, launching, monitoring, and optimizing paid advertising campaigns to generate quality leads, sales, and business growth.

This role is ideal for someone who understands that digital marketing is not just about posting content \- it is about **generating measurable results through smart targeting, creative testing, campaign optimization, and data analysis.**

Key Responsibilities Meta Ads Management

* Plan, create, launch, and manage **Facebook \& Instagram advertising campaigns** through Meta Ads Manager.
* Manage campaigns for **lead generation, conversions, sales, traffic, engagement, and remarketing**.
* Conduct audience research and create relevant targeting strategies.
* Set up and manage **Custom Audiences, Lookalike Audiences, retargeting campaigns, and interest\-based targeting**.
* Monitor campaign performance and optimize campaigns based on key metrics.
* Regularly test different **ad creatives, copy, audiences, placements, and campaign objectives**.
* Identify underperforming campaigns/ad sets/ads and take corrective action.
* Manage advertising budgets efficiently and work toward improving **ROAS, CPL, CTR, conversion rate, and overall campaign profitability**.
* Scale successful campaigns while maintaining performance and cost efficiency.
* Stay updated with changes to the Meta advertising platform, policies, targeting options, and best practices.

Campaign \& Performance Analysis

* Track and analyze campaign performance on a daily basis.
* Prepare performance reports and communicate key insights to management.
* Identify trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement.
* Use data to make informed decisions about budget allocation and campaign strategy.
* Monitor lead quality and work with the sales team to improve lead\-to\-customer conversion.

Creative \& Content Coordination

* Provide creative briefs and recommendations based on campaign performance.
* Suggest new hooks, ad angles, offers, headlines, captions, and creative concepts.
* Understand what type of content works best for different audiences and stages of the customer journey.

Digital Marketing

* Assist in developing and executing the overall digital marketing strategy.
* Monitor industry trends and identify new opportunities for customer acquisition.
* Support website, landing page, and conversion\-rate optimization initiatives where required.
* Coordinate with internal teams to ensure marketing campaigns are aligned with business objectives.

Required Skills

* Strong hands\-on knowledge of **Meta Ads Manager**.
* Good understanding of Facebook and Instagram advertising.
* Experience in **lead generation and/or performance marketing**.
* Understanding of campaign structures, audiences, placements, budgets, bidding, and optimization.
* Ability to analyze metrics such as **CPL, CTR, CPM, ROAS, conversion rate, and frequency**.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Good understanding of digital marketing funnels and customer journeys.
* Ability to conduct audience and competitor research.
* Basic knowledge of ad copywriting and creative strategy.
* Good communication and coordination skills.
* Ability to work independently and take ownership of campaigns.
* Strong attention to detail and a results\-oriented mindset.

Preferred Skills

Candidates with knowledge or experience in the following will be preferred:

* Meta Pixel / Meta Events Manager
* Conversion API
* Landing page optimization
* CRM and lead management
* Canva or basic creative tools
* Lead\-generation funnels
* Retargeting and remarketing strategies

Candidate Profile

We are looking for someone who:

* Has **practical experience managing Meta Ads campaigns**, not just theoretical knowledge.
* Understands how to optimize campaigns based on performance data.
* Is comfortable working with budgets and performance targets.
* Takes initiative and continuously looks for ways to improve campaign results.
* Can identify why a campaign is not performing and suggest actionable solutions.
* Is willing to experiment with new audiences, creatives, offers, and strategies.
* Can work in a fast\-paced environment and meet deadlines.
* Is focused on **business outcomes rather than vanity metrics**.

Experience

**1–3 years of relevant experience** in digital marketing/performance marketing is preferred.

Freshers with strong practical knowledge of Meta Ads and demonstrable campaign experience may also be considered.

Education

Bachelor's degree/diploma in **Marketing, Digital Marketing, Business Administration, Mass Communication, or a related field** is preferred but not mandatory for candidates with relevant practical experience.

What We Offer

* Competitive salary based on experience and skills.
* Performance\-based growth opportunities.
* Hands\-on exposure to performance marketing and customer acquisition.
* Learning and career growth opportunities.
* Supportive and professional work environment.
* Opportunity to take ownership of digital marketing campaigns and contribute directly to business growth.

How to Apply

Interested candidates are encouraged to apply with their **updated resume**.

Candidates with previous Meta Ads experience are encouraged to mention:

* Types of campaigns managed
* Approximate monthly ad budgets handled
* Average CPL/CPA/ROAS achieved, where applicable
* Industries/niches worked with
* Examples of campaigns or results they have generated

**Location:** Hoshiarpur, Punjab  
**Position:** Digital Marketing Executive  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

Pay: ₹10,000\.00 \- ₹20,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Data Engineer
description:
**About Zeno** 




 An unprecedented energy transition has begun. To meet 2040 net zero goals, over 2 billion electric two\-wheelers (motorcycles) must be sold and $11 trillion in fuel consumption replaced. Zeno is building a tech platform to electrify this two\-wheeler market, currently responsible for more than 4% of the world’s GHG emissions. Our mission is to accelerate the energy transition and democratize the benefits across Africa, India, and Latin America. With a focus on East Africa as a starting point, Zeno is building a new energy ecosystem with ground\-up development of a fundamentally better electric motorcycle and associated battery swap network to drive a better experience for our customers.
 



 We are looking for audacious, creative, and committed people to join us on this important mission. You will be joining a bold team consisting of leading engineers, operators, and entrepreneurs hailing from companies that include Tesla, Apple, Google, SRAM, Ola Electric, Dott, LiveWire, Lucid, Bolt, Microsoft, SafeBoda, Sun Mobility, among many others. Zeno has just closed its seed round with Lowercarbon, Silicon Valley’s leading climate tech venture fund, Toyota Ventures, the VC of the world’s largest automotive company, and 4DX Ventures, a leading early\-stage investor in Africa.
 



  





**The Role** 




 Zeno is seeking a highly skilled and hands\-on
 **Data Engineer** 
 to design, build, and scale our global data ecosystem. Sitting within our core
 **Global Insights Node** 
 , this role is not a traditional corporate dashboard\-building job. You will bridge the gap between heavy hardware telematics and high\-fidelity operational intelligence.
 



 You will design and build a resilient, local\-first data architecture capable of handling high\-frequency telemetry from moving vehicles and distributed battery swap stations operating in environments with variable network connectivity.
 



 The ideal candidate combines strong systems engineering fundamentals with an analytical mindset, a passion for first\-principles problem solving, and a refusal to rely on bloated enterprise templates when a leaner, more elegant solution exists.
 



  





**What You’ll Do** 




**1\. Data Architecture \& Edge Ecosystem Design** 



* Design, build, and maintain a highly resilient, scalable data architecture capable of syncing, storing, and processing massive datasets from both centralized cloud services and distributed edge devices (battery swap stations and vehicles).
* Establish robust strategies for partition tolerance and local\-first data caching to handle intermittent cellular connectivity in emerging markets.



**2\. High\-Performance Pipeline Development** 



* Develop, test, and optimize batch and stream\-processing pipelines to handle real\-time IoT telematics, state\-of\-charge tracking, and transactional business data.
* Build efficient ingestion mechanisms from internal systems, IoT hardware modules, APIs, and third\-party operational platforms using languages like Go, Rust, or Python.



**3\. First\-Principles Infrastructure Optimization** 



* Constantly challenge the data\-stack status quo. Focus on building lightweight, cost\-effective, and highly performant data systems, selecting tools based on architectural suitability rather than industry hype.
* Optimize data storage layouts, partitioning schemes, and query mechanics to handle high data volumes with minimal latency and infrastructure cost.



**4\. Unified Semantics \& Intelligence Enablement** 



* Architect clean, well\-documented semantic layers and structured transformations (using SQL and modern modeling frameworks) to expose reliable datasets.
* Support both traditional analytical queries (BI dashboards in Grafana, Looker, or Kibana) and downstream machine learning and automated agentic pipelines.



**5\. Data Quality, Reliability \& Observability** 



* Implement strict data validation, monitoring, and proactive alerting frameworks to ensure absolute consistency and accuracy across the network.
* Define and maintain strict access control, governance, and data privacy standard practices across the global insights platform.



**6\. Engineering Hygiene \& DevOps** 



* Packaged and deploy data services using Docker and Kubernetes.
* Maintain elegant CI/CD automation pipelines for data code deployments and infrastructure\-as\-code updates.
* Ensure impeccable Git/version control hygiene (clean commit histories, thorough documentation, and rigorous peer code reviews).



  





**What You Bring** 



* **The Mindset:** 
 A true first\-principles thinker. You are energized by physical constraints (like network drops or limited hardware memory) and prefer elegant, custom\-tailored solutions over bloated, off\-the\-shelf enterprise software.
* **Core Technical Expertise:** 
 Strong programming fundamentals in systems\-adjacent or highly performant languages (
 **Go, Rust, or Python** 
 ) alongside advanced mastery of
 **SQL** 
 .
* **IoT \& Telematics Experience:** 
 Proven experience dealing with high\-volume, time\-series, or streaming telematics/IoT data.
* **Distributed Systems Knowledge:** 
 Hands\-on experience with modern streaming and orchestration tools (such as Kafka, Redpanda, Airflow, Spark, or Beam) and an understanding of how to run them efficiently.
* **Modern Warehouse Proficiency:** 
 Practical experience leveraging cloud\-native data warehouses or lakehouses (such as BigQuery, Snowflake, ClickHouse, or Redshift) for high\-performance analytics.
* **Cloud \& DevOps Foundations:** 
 Solid working knowledge of cloud ecosystems (AWS and/or GCP) and experience deploying robust services via Docker and Kubernetes.
