title: Process Quality Engineer [Power Electronics Manufacturing]
description:
**About Us**

Statcon Electronics India Limited is a leading power electronics company specializing in the design and manufacture of reliable power electronics solutions for critical applications across Railways, Defence, Power, and Solar sectors. With decades of industry experience, we are committed to delivering high\-quality products through strong engineering, manufacturing, and quality practices.

**Position Overview**

Statcon Electronics India Limited is seeking a Quality Control / Process Quality professional to support quality assurance activities across the production process. The selected candidate will be responsible for in\-process inspection, final inspection, defect identification, process monitoring, and maintaining quality records on the shop floor.

The role requires a practical understanding of Process Quality Control, engineering drawings, dimensions, tolerances, inspection methods, and basic measuring instruments. The candidate will work closely with the Production and Quality teams to identify and resolve quality issues and ensure that products meet defined specifications.

**Roles \& Responsibilities**

* Monitor and maintain quality standards at different stages of the production process.
* Perform in\-process and final inspection of products as per defined quality standards.
* Inspect product dimensions, fitment, assembly, appearance, workmanship, and overall quality.
* Read and interpret engineering drawings, dimensions, tolerances, and specifications.
* Use basic inspection and measuring instruments such as Vernier Caliper, measuring tape, meter tape, and other relevant tools.
* Identify production defects, quality issues, and process deviations during manufacturing.
* Coordinate with the Production and Quality teams to identify root causes and resolve quality\-related issues.
* Ensure that production activities are carried out as per approved drawings, specifications, and quality requirements.
* Maintain inspection records, check sheets, rejection reports, and other quality\-related documentation.
* Report quality deviations and non\-conformities to the concerned team or reporting manager.
* Support corrective and preventive actions for recurring quality issues.
* Conduct regular shop\-floor checks to ensure adherence to defined process and quality standards.
* Assist in maintaining proper documentation and traceability of inspection activities.

**Qualifications \& Skills**

* Diploma in Electronics is mandatory.
* Freshers with strong practical understanding of Process Quality may also be considered.
* 0–2 years of experience in Quality Control, Process Quality, or a related manufacturing function will be preferred.
* Practical knowledge of In\-Process Quality Control.

Department

Job Summary

The Billing \& Customer Support Executive will be responsible for managing day\-to\-day **billing, order processing, customer support, and customer coordination** activities.

The role involves preparing accurate invoices, processing customer orders, coordinating with sales and warehouse teams, responding to customer queries, handling complaints, and ensuring timely resolution of customer requirements.

* Complaint Resolution Status

* Distributor\-wise Billing Report

The employee is expected to:

* Respond to customer enquiries promptly.

* Avoid unnecessary delays in order and billing processing.
* Maintain accurate records of customer interactions.
* Escalate important issues without delay.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree / Diploma in **Commerce, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field** preferred.

Required Skills

* Strong attention to detail.
* Problem\-solving and customer\-handling skills.

Experience

Preferred Candidate Profile

description:
**AIKAARA TECHNOLOGIES PRIVATE LIMITED** 




**Associate Project Manager — AI\-First Delivery** 




**Location:** 
 Pune, India (on\-site client placement in later phases)
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time
 



**Experience:** 
 2–3 Years
 



**Reports To:** 
 Product Head
 



**CTC:** 
 Up to ₹9 LPA (based on interview performance)
 



  




* **About the Role**



 Aikaara Technologies builds and maintains enterprise web applications for US\-based clients. We run as an AI\-first team. Claude, Claude Code and Cursor are part of daily work — used to understand codebases, draft specifications, prepare test cases and move delivery forward. This is how we work, not an occasional shortcut.
 



 We are looking for an Associate Project Manager with 2–3 years of experience who is genuinely good at working with AI tools and wants to grow into a full delivery role. You do not need to have managed large teams or hold a certification. You need to be organised, curious, clear in writing, and capable of using AI to produce the output of a much larger team.
 



 This is a hands\-on role. You will run sprints, track delivery, write documentation, test features yourself, and be the reliable point of coordination between developers, QA, UI/UX and the client.
 


* **AI Skills — What We Actually Look For**



 This section carries the most weight in our evaluation.
 



 •    Uses AI assistants (Claude, ChatGPT or similar) as part of daily work, not occasionally.
 



 •    Can write clear, well\-structured prompts and get usable output on the first or second attempt.
 



 •    Can use AI to read and understand an unfamiliar codebase or product, and explain it back in plain language.
 



 •    Can use AI to draft specifications, user stories, test cases, release notes and client emails — and then review, correct and take ownership of that output.
 



 •    Has the judgment to recognise when AI output is wrong, incomplete or invented, and verifies before acting on it.
 



 •    Willing to learn Claude Code with Cursor in depth. Structured training and time will be given.
 



 •    Advantage: has independently built something with AI — a script, a small app, an automation, a dashboard, an internal tool. Bring it to the interview.
 



  




* **Key Responsibilities**



 •    Coordinate day\-to\-day delivery across development, QA and UI/UX.
 



 •    Run Agile ceremonies — daily stand\-ups, sprint planning, reviews and retrospectives.
 



 •    Break requirements into clear user stories with acceptance criteria, and keep Jira accurate and current.
 



 •    Use AI tools to draft specifications, BRDs, test cases, meeting summaries and status reports.
 



 •    Test features on staging before they reach the client; raise clear, reproducible bug reports.
 



 •    Track progress, dependencies and blockers; escalate early rather than late.
 



 •    Join client calls, take structured notes, and convert discussion into actionable tickets.
 



 •    Prepare weekly status reports and release notes for internal and client stakeholders.
 



 •    Support UAT, production releases and post\-release checks.
 



 •    Maintain project documentation so that anyone joining the project can get up to speed quickly.
 



  




* **Required Skills**



 •    2–3 years of experience in project coordination, delivery, business analysis, QA or associate product roles in a software or product company.
 



 •    Working understanding of Agile / Scrum and the software development lifecycle.
 



 •    Hands\-on with Jira or a comparable tracking tool.
 



 •    Strong written and spoken English — you will write to US clients directly.
 



 •    Ability to document clearly and structure information well.
 



 •    Attention to detail, ownership and consistent follow\-through.
 



 •    Comfortable working from the Pune office, with some overlap with US client hours.
 



  




* **Technical Understanding**



 A functional understanding is expected in the following areas:
 



 •    Web applications and how they are structured
 



 •    React.js frontend (functional level)
 



 •    Ruby on Rails backend (functional level)
 



 •    REST APIs and basic SQL
 



 •    Git and branching basics
 



 •    Staging, UAT and production release flow
 



*Hands\-on coding experience is not mandatory. You should, however, be able to read code with AI assistance and hold a technical conversation with developers without needing everything translated.* 



* **Tools**



 •    Jira, Confluence
 



 •    Claude / Claude Code, Cursor
 



 •    GitHub
 



 •    Slack / Microsoft Teams
 



 •    Google Workspace, Excel / Sheets
 



  




* **Preferred Qualifications**



 •    Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science or Information Technology.

title: Product Designer (UX)
description:
**Don't Apply If...** 



* You love making beautiful screens but aren't particularly interested in whether the experience actually works.
* You'd rather jump straight into Figma than understand the problem you're trying to solve.
* You prefer working in isolation rather than alongside Product and Engineering.
* Your work ends at developer handoff. You want to see your designs shipped, tested and improved.
* Details like spacing, hierarchy, states and consistency don't bother you when they're slightly off.



  





**Do Apply If...** 



* You have a genuinely strong eye for design and notice the details other people miss.
* You care equally about how a product works and how it feels to use.
* You start with the user and the problem, then use design to find the simplest, strongest solution.
* You can take a complex workflow and make it feel obvious.
* You enjoy working closely with Product and Engineering, and you're comfortable challenging ideas as well as having your own challenged.
* You care about what actually gets built, not just what looks great in Figma.
* You work with structure and priorities, but bring curiosity, energy and ideas to the table.
* You want to help shape a growing product and
 **raise the design bar as we build** 
 .



  





**About the Role** 




 We’re looking for a thoughtful, structured and execution\-focused
 **Product Designer (UX)** 
 to join Doerscircle’s Product \& Technology team.
 



 Doerscircle is building a platform for independent professionals and the organisations that hire, engage and manage them. As our platform grows, we’re looking for someone who can turn complex product and business problems into experiences that feel simple, intuitive and beautifully designed.
 



 This is a hands\-on role. You’ll work closely with Product, Engineering, QA and Data, taking problems from early exploration and user flows through to polished UI, developer handoff and what ultimately gets shipped.
 



 You’ll need strong UX and product thinking, an excellent eye for design and visual detail, and a good understanding of business outcomes. You should be equally comfortable thinking through how something works and obsessing over how well it is executed.
 



  





**The Position** 




 You’ll be part of our fast\-growing commercial team, and working closely with the entire team of Doerscircle. This role involves working closely with our product development and marketing teams to design and improve our digital products and promotional materials. Ideally, you have experience with marketplace design, optimizing for revenue generation and conversions, and significantly improving the user experience journey.
 



  





**Your Responsibilities** 



* 2–4 years of hands\-on experience designing digital products.
* A portfolio showing
 **real product UX/UI work** 
 , not predominantly websites, branding or marketing design.
* Strong Figma skills, including Auto Layout, components, variants and prototyping.
* Strong visual design fundamentals such as hierarchy, typography, spacing, consistency and interaction.
* Ability to turn product requirements and user problems into flows, wireframes and polished interfaces.
* Understanding of responsive design, states, edge cases and common interaction patterns.
* Experience working directly with Product Managers and Engineers.
* Comfortable explaining design decisions, receiving feedback and iterating quickly.
* Experience working with an existing design system or component library.
* Able to work independently and reliably in a remote team.
* Translate product and business problems into clear user journeys, information architecture, flows, wireframes and high\-fidelity designs.
* Explore solutions through wireframes, prototypes and interaction designs before moving into detailed UI.



  





**How Design Works at Doerscircle** 




 Product Design and Brand Design work closely together, with distinct areas of ownership.
 



 As Product Designer, you own the experience of using our digital products, including user journeys, information architecture, interaction design, usability and product UI.
 



 Within our design system, Brand Design defines the visual foundations and overall creative language. Product Design translates those foundations into functional product components, patterns, behaviours and states.
 



 You’ll bring a strong visual sensibility and excellent design judgement, applying Doerscircle’s visual identity to create product experiences that feel polished, coherent and thoughtfully designed, while evolving the product experience in close collaboration with Brand Design.
 



 In simple terms: Brand Design defines how Doerscircle looks. Product Design makes sure the experience works beautifully.
 



  





**What We're Looking For?** 



* Proven experience as a Product Designer, UI/UX Designer or similar role designing digital products.
* A strong portfolio of shipped product work. We want to understand the problem, constraints, decisions, iterations and outcomes and not just see polished screens.
* A strong visual design sensibility and an excellent eye for design, with a sharp understanding of layout, hierarchy, typography, spacing, consistency and interaction.
* Strong UX fundamentals and the ability to simplify complex workflows and information.
* Advanced proficiency in Figma, including components, variants, Auto Layout and prototyping.
* Experience creating, maintaining or working extensively with design systems.
* Strong understanding of information architecture, interaction design and usability.
* Experience designing responsive web products.
* Ability to think through interaction states, edge cases, permissions and different user scenarios.
* Experience collaborating closely with Product Managers and Engineers from early exploration through implementation.

title: Research Analyst- Technology Futures (Solar)
company: Council on Energy, Environment and Water (CEEW)
description:
**Purpose** 




 CEEW's Technology Futures team works towards mainstreaming appropriate global and indigenous technologies that can deliver energy security and sustainable economic growth at scale. The team's work spans clean energy technology manufacturing, critical minerals, and the evolving geopolitics and governance of clean energy technology collaboration, and has previously informed India's G20 presidency\-led work on global renewable energy supply chains.
 



 CEEW seeks to hire a suitable candidate to support the Technology Futures team's work on clean energy manufacturing, with a particular focus on solar photovoltaic (PV) technology. The candidate in this role will examine manufacturing processes, machinery and materials across the solar value chain (polysilicon, ingot/wafer, cell and module), assess supply chain dependencies and bottlenecks — including critical minerals and manufacturing equipment — and track the evolving policies and regulations shaping domestic and global solar manufacturing.
 



 The researcher will undertake technology and techno\-economic assessments of manufacturing processes, track domestic and international policy developments relevant to solar manufacturing (such as production\-linked incentives, local content requirements, customs duties and other measures), analyse supply chain data, and support the team in engaging with government, industry and international stakeholders.
 



 The candidate must have a strong technical understanding of clean energy manufacturing, particularly solar PV technologies and processes, along with a keen interest in how policy and regulation shape technology and manufacturing outcomes, and have demonstrable research experience. In addition to the duties and responsibilities outlined below, the candidate should be prepared, as and when necessary, to take on additional responsibilities and respond to ongoing events and developments in the sector.
 



 CEEW offers an intellectually challenging and conducive work environment, with a focus on research rigour, innovative thinking, and strategic outreach. We are looking for an enthusiastic and detail\-oriented individual who would be excited to take research to action. We recommend that applicants visit the Technology Futures page for more details about our projects.
 



**Job duties and accountabilities** 




**Research and programme assistance** 



* Review literature and track developments in clean energy manufacturing, with an emphasis on manufacturing processes, machinery and materials used across the entire solar PV value chain.
* Map and analyse domestic and global supply chains for solar PV and other clean energy technologies, including dependencies on critical minerals, intermediate goods, and manufacturing equipment.
* Analyse the policy and regulatory landscape governing solar manufacturing in India and other geographies.
* Track the geopolitics of solar technology — including export controls, technology partnerships, and shifts in global manufacturing competitiveness.
* Collect and analyse quantitative data — production capacities and costs to support techno\-economic and policy analysis.
* Prepare appropriate memos and presentations to brief the team and stakeholders.
* Assist the team in drafting and publishing high\-value research briefs and reports.



**Stakeholder engagement** 



* Engage with industry players, and government agencies to collect data, understand manufacturing and policy challenges, and validate research findings.
* Participate in in\-person and virtual convenings to network with relevant stakeholders and understand on\-ground challenges in clean energy manufacturing.



**Selection Criteria** 




**Qualification** 



* A bachelor's or master's degree in engineering — mechanical, materials science, chemical, or renewable energy — or a related technical discipline, ideally with exposure to photovoltaic or semiconductor manufacturing.
* Familiarity with the solar PV manufacturing value chain (polysilicon, ingot/wafer, cell, module) and the associated machinery, processes and materials is highly desirable.
* Research experience of at least 1 year is preferred.
* Past experience working with secondary datasets such as UN Comtrade, trade and investment databases, WITS (World Integrated Trade Solution), India's Directorate General of Commercial Intelligence and Statistics (DGCI\&S) trade statistics or similar sources is highly desirable.
* Coursework or exposure to industrial policy and manufacturing/supply chain management is preferred.



**Skills** 



* Strong analytical and research skills, particularly in techno\-economic and quantitative analysis.
* Proficiency in tools such as multi\-criteria decision analysis, sensitivity analysis, decision trees or Monte\-Carlo simulations is preferred.
* Ability to analyse technical and policy information and present it in a clear and accurate manner, both verbally and in writing.
* Familiarity using AI tools, such as large language models and AI\-assisted research and analysis platforms, to speed up research workflows and produce quick, high\-quality outputs.
* Ability to translate complex technical concepts for non\-technical audiences, and present findings in a clear and accurate manner, both verbally and in writing.
* Ability to work in an interdisciplinary and multicultural environment.



 CEEW operates in a dynamic environment, and the candidate will be required to show flexibility in undertaking a variety of tasks.

title: Technical Content Writer
description:
**About Dreamfoot** 





 Dreamfoot is a premier corporate video production and 3D industrial animation studio based in Vadodara, Gujarat. We specialize in producing high\-impact corporate brand films, 3D technical animations, industrial process explainers, and comprehensive safety training films for leading engineering, manufacturing, and infrastructure enterprises.
 




**Role Overview** 





 We're looking for a Technical Content Writer who can research, understand, and explain complex industrial and engineering subject matter through clear, credible, long\-form writing. This is primarily a content writing role — you'll spend most of your time producing technically grounded blogs, case studies, whitepapers, and website content that build trust and establish authority with plant heads, safety VPs, and engineering leaders. A smaller part of the role involves writing narrative AV scripts for our corporate brand films, process videos, and safety training videos.
 




***This is not a copywriting role. We are not looking for persuasive, sales\-driven, conversion\-focused writing (ad copy, landing pages, CTA\-heavy campaigns). We want someone who educates and informs, not someone who sells.***




**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Technical \& B2B Content Writing — Primary Mandate (80%)** 




 •     
 **Technical Content Development:** 

 Research and write in\-depth, technically accurate long\-form content — blog posts, engineering explainers, whitepapers, and detailed guides — that build trust and establish Dreamfoot's (and our clients') technical authority.
 




 •     
 **Case Studies \& Project Stories:** 

 Turn completed video and animation projects into detailed, technically grounded case studies and client success stories for the website and LinkedIn.
 




 •     
 **Client \& SME Discovery:** 

 Participate in discovery sessions with engineers, safety leads, and project directors to translate machinery, workflows, and SOPs into clear written narratives.
 




 •     
 **Website \& SEO Content:** 

 Author SEO\-aligned website copy, service pages, and long\-form articles aimed at informing prospective clients — not pushing an immediate sale.
 




 •     
 **LinkedIn Thought Leadership:** 

 Write long\-form LinkedIn articles and posts sharing engineering insights, behind\-the\-scenes production knowledge, and studio milestones — educational in tone, not promotional.
 




 •     
 **Editorial Consistency:** 

 Maintain a clear, credible, and technically trustworthy voice across all written material.
 




**2\. Corporate \& Safety Video Scriptwriting — Secondary Mandate (20%)** 




 •     
 **AV Script Development:** 

 Write two\-column (Audio/Visual) scripts for corporate brand films, industrial process videos, and safety induction/training modules.
 




 •     
 **Narrative Structuring:** 

 Translate technical or safety information into spoken\-word narratives with clear scene direction and pacing.
 




 •     
 **Production Support:** 

 Coordinate with 3D animators, editors, and voiceover artists to keep scripts aligned with the visual storytelling.
 




**Candidate Requirements** 




 •     
 **Experience:** 

 1–3 years in technical writing, content writing, corporate communications, or B2B writing. Scriptwriting exposure is a plus, not a requirement.
 




 •     
 **Core Skill:** 

 Strong long\-form writing — able to research a technical subject and turn it into a clear, well\-structured blog, whitepaper, or case study.
 




 •     
 **Writing Style:** 

 Informative, educational, conversational — geared toward building trust over time, not toward driving immediate action or sales.
 




 •     
 **Technical Curiosity:** 

 Comfortable learning and simplifying industrial operations, heavy machinery, and technical systems without intimidation.
 




 •     
 **Secondary Skill:** 

 Basic familiarity with AV script structure (two\-column Audio/Visual format) and willingness to write narration for video — this is roughly a fifth of the role, not the core of it.
 




 •     
 **Language:** 

 Excellent written English required; Hindi or Gujarati is a plus for client interactions.
 




 •     
 **Work Mode:** 

 Full\-time, in\-office, Vadodara, Gujarat.

Customers found it challenging to avail quality services conveniently, and service professionals were struggling to make ends meet, having to rely upon several middlemen, contractors, and local aggregators. 1. **Customer love:** 
 Build a platform that offers truly delightful and differentiated services
2. **Partner empowerment:** 
 Build a deep, full\-stack partnership with service partners, helping improve their earnings and overall livelihood
3. **Technology first:** 
 Bring innovation and technology to an age\-old industry



  





**About the Role \& Team** 




**Orion is Urban Company’s in\-house frontend platform** 
 : the framework, component system, rendering layer and release infrastructure that every customer and provider facing entity at Urban Company is built on. It is not a library we adopted; we designed and own all of it.
 



 Orion is deliberately cross\-stack. It spans React Native as the base rendering engine for our customer and partner apps, a micro\-frontend architecture, and native Android and iOS layers underneath, with a single component system across all of them.
 



  





 At UC we follow a micro frontend architecture, every product flow: a booking flow, a category page, a checkout step is built as an independently developed and independently deployed micro\-frontend that renders inside the Orion shell, on both app and web. A team ships its changes without coordinating a release with anyone else.
 



  





 Our pod owns that architecture: the shell and its contracts, routing and lifecycle, isolation between micro\-frontends, shared state and navigation across them. As the number of micro\-frontends grows, holding that boundary clean while keeping the app feeling like one product is among the hardest problems on the platform.
 



  





 Orion’s server\-driven UI lets product teams change what a screen shows without shipping an app release, and its own in\-house over\-the\-air pipeline delivers JavaScript updates straight to users’ devices. Every product engineer at Urban Company builds on Orion, which means a change to the platform is felt across the entire company.
 



  





**Our pod sits inside the Orion team** 
 , and owns the following charters built on top of it:
 



  




* **Merchant Platform** 
 : Letting integrating partners sell their services from inside Urban Company. Their experience runs in a container inside our app session, integrated SSO auth, deeplinks, order lifecycle, discovery touchpoints, and their orders showing up alongside ours in the customer's bookings. The bar is performance good enough that our users cannot tell where our product ends and theirs begins while keeping in mind the security and stability repercussions.
* **Third\-Party Integrations** 
 : Taking Urban Company services into other companies' apps. Their users book us without ever leaving their product, server\-to\-server booking flows, request journeys, catalogue mapping, idempotency, and reconciliation when the other side goes quiet.
* **Release \& Over\-the\-Air Delivery** 
 : OTA bundles for customer and partner apps, Android, iOS and web release pipelines, canary rollouts.
* **Platform itself:** 
 Because the pod is part of the Orion team, whoever joins
 **also owns and contributes to Orion itself** 
 , the shared components, the rendering and navigation layer, the release pipeline. You will not just consume the platform, you will improve it, and what you build there is used by every product team at Urban Company and has a direct impact on both our customer and provider app and website ecosystem.



  





 This is a genuinely cross\-stack charter. A single feature here routinely spans a React Native container, a Node.js service and an event pipeline, which is why we hire strong frontend engineers and grow them across the full stack rather than keeping them on one side of it.
 



  





**What You’ll Do** 



* **Build the Merchant Platform:** 
 Take partner brands live inside the Urban Company app, session handoff, order lifecycle, discovery surfaces. While making it secure and fast enough that our users cannot tell where our product ends and theirs begins.
* **Take Urban Company Into Other Apps** 
 : Design and ship server\-to\-server booking flows that let another company's users book us from inside their product. From the first partner call through contract design, idempotency, rollout and reconciliation.
* **Strengthen Orion Itself:** 
 Improve the shared components, rendering layer and release infrastructure that every Urban Company product team depends on.
* **Own and Scale the Micro\-frontend Architecture** 
 : Evolve the shell, contracts and lifecycle that every product team's surface plugs into, and keep the experience feeling like one app as the number of micro\-frontends grows.
* **Grow Across the Stack:** 
 Start in React Native, then take on the Node.js services behind your own features. We expect this, we plan for it, and you will not be doing it alone.
* **Elevate Technical Standards:** 
 Write production\-grade code, drive architectural design discussions, and raise the bar on performance, correctness and observability.



  





**Technology Stack** 




 You will get hands\-on exposure to:
 


* **Frontend (primary):** 
 React Native, TypeScript, micro\-frontends architecture
* **Native:** 
 Kotlin (Android), Swift (iOS)
* **Backend:** 
 Node.js, TypeScript
* **Databases:** 
 MongoDB, MySQL, redis
* **Events:** 
 Kafka, event\-driven systems
* **Analytics:** 
 Snowflake
* **Observability:** 
 Prometheus, Grafana
* **Architecture:** 
 Micro\-frontends, server\-driven UI, microservices
* **Delivery:** 
 In\-house over\-the\-air pipeline, feature flags and experiments



  





**What We’re Looking For** 



* 2\-4 years of software engineering experience.
* At least 2 years building React Native, or modern web with React/Next.js, shipped to real users at real scale.
* Strong JavaScript and TypeScript.
* Solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, and system design fundamentals.
* Comfortable debugging on real devices: logs, traces, profilers, network waterfalls.
* You already develop with an AI agent. Claude Code is mandatory for every engineer at Urban Company, it is how we write code, debug production issues and find our way around unfamiliar services. You should be comfortable building with an AI coding agent.
* Strong ownership mindset. You have taken a feature from spec through build and release, and then watched the metrics.
* Open to writing backend. No backend experience needed on day one; genuine interest is the requirement. (Backend code in production in any language is a plus.)
* Native Android or iOS exposure, server\-driven UI, design systems, or hard performance work is a plus.
* Experience with mobile release pipelines, CI, or over\-the\-air delivery is a plus.
* Comfortable working in a large codebase you did not write.



  





**What Can You Expect at UC?** 



* Massive ownership and direct customer impact.
* An AI\-native engineering org: Claude Code is standard for every engineer here. It changes what a small pod can own, and it collapses the time it takes to understand a service you have never opened. We are still working out what good practice looks like, and you will help decide it.
* Work on the surfaces every Urban Company customer touches, and the platform every product team builds on.
* Genuine full\-stack growth, frontend to backend, web to native, rather than a single layer for years.
* A high\-performance, high\-velocity engineering culture.
* Quick iterations with real\-world feedback loops.
* Opportunity to grow into senior technical leadership roles.
* Exposure to problems involving, Cross\-platform rendering, app performance on low\-end devices, over\-the\-air delivery and safe rollback, partner API integration, idempotency and correctness.

Customers found it challenging to avail quality services conveniently, and service professionals were struggling to make ends meet, having to rely upon several middlemen, contractors, and local aggregators.  . If you are iOS\-heavy, you should be excited to work on React Native. If you are React Native\-heavy, you should be excited to go deep into native iOS. We are clear about this from day one.

 and

description:
AI\-FIRST WEB GAME ENGINEER \- GAME GENERATION \& QUALITY AUTOMATION
   

  

 Pupiltree.ai \| Full\-time \| On\-site \- Ballari, Karnataka
   

  

 ABOUT THE ROLE
   

  

 Pupiltree.ai is building a platform that can create web\-based games in bulk from reusable templates. We are looking for a hands\-on engineer who can build engaging browser\-game templates, integrate them into our AI\-powered generation harness, and create the automated quality\-control systems that make generated games reliable, testable, and continuously better.
   

  

 This is not a one\-game\-at\-a\-time development role. You will help build the factory: reusable templates, standard interfaces, generation workflows, validation rules, automated tests, release gates, feedback loops, and the golden dataset that allow game production to scale without sacrificing quality.
   

  

 WORKING ARRANGEMENT \- PLEASE READ
   

  

 This is a permanent, full\-time position and requires compulsory on\-site work in Ballari (Bellary), Karnataka. It is not a remote or hybrid role. Food and accommodation are provided. Specific arrangements will be explained during the hiring process.
   

  

 WHAT YOU WILL DO
   

  

 • Review our existing web games, templates, generation workflow, and cloud harness.
   

 • Design and build reusable templates for multiple types of browser\-based games.
   

 • Create new games and variants with clear rules, responsive controls, reliable state management, and polished player feedback.
   

 • Define standard interfaces for configuration, assets, levels, scoring, difficulty, win/loss states, telemetry, and lifecycle events.
   

 • Integrate templates into the generation harness using Claude Code and/or the Claude Agent SDK, MCP integrations, cloud SDKs, APIs, storage, queues, deployment workflows, and CI/CD where appropriate.
   

 • Make generation runs versioned and reproducible across prompts, configurations, templates, models, and code revisions.
   

 • Build automated checks for compilation, runtime errors, gameplay rules, scoring, state transitions, responsiveness, performance, assets, and browser compatibility.
   

 • Develop programmatic playtests, simulations, test agents, or deterministic replay systems where they improve confidence.
   

 • Create an automated QC and evaluation layer that scores each generated game and blocks outputs that fail agreed thresholds.
   

 • Capture structured reviewer feedback, player signals, defects, and accepted outputs.
   

 • Convert validated feedback into regression tests, improved evaluation criteria, stronger templates, better generation instructions, and updates to the golden dataset.
   

 • Add observability and reporting so the team can understand failure patterns and quality trends across batches.
   

 • Document the template specification, integration workflow, QC framework, and operating procedures.
   

  

 WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE
   

  

 • New game templates can be added through a clear, repeatable process.
   

 • Generated games are automatically built, launched, exercised, evaluated, and accepted or rejected.
   

 • Failures are traceable and easy to diagnose.
   

 • Human and player feedback becomes structured data that improves future templates, tests, evaluations, prompts, and the golden dataset.
   

 • Game output can scale without manual review effort increasing at the same rate.
   

  

 REQUIRED EXPERIENCE
   

  

 • Strong experience building web\-based games or highly interactive browser applications.
   

 • Proficiency in TypeScript/JavaScript and modern web\-development fundamentals.
   

 • Experience with Phaser, PixiJS, Three.js, Canvas/WebGL, or an equivalent browser\-game or rendering stack.
   

 • Ability to design reusable architectures, template systems, and clean integration contracts.
   

 • Experience with automated browser testing and programmatic validation using Playwright, Cypress, or similar tools.
   

 • Experience building cloud\-based workflows using SDKs, APIs, storage, queues, containers, serverless services, or CI/CD systems.
   

 • Strong understanding of game state, input handling, scoring, progression, difficulty, deterministic behaviour, and edge cases.
   

 • Ability to translate quality goals into measurable checks and useful evaluation criteria.
   

 • Strong debugging, documentation, and end\-to\-end ownership skills.
   

  

 NICE TO HAVE
   

  

 • Production experience with Claude Code, the Claude Agent SDK, MCP, or equivalent coding\-agent workflows.
   

 • Experience with LLM\-assisted code generation, AI agents, evaluation harnesses, or synthetic\-data workflows.
   

 • Experience designing golden datasets, regression corpora, rubric\-based evaluations, or human\-in\-the\-loop review systems.
   

 • Knowledge of telemetry, experimentation, player analytics, or automated gameplay simulation.
   

 • Familiarity with procedural content generation and configuration\-driven game systems.
   

 • Experience optimizing browser games for performance, accessibility, touch devices, and multiple screen sizes.
   

 • Experience operating large batch pipelines with traceability, retries, idempotency, and cost controls.
   

  

 HOW TO APPLY
   

  

 Please apply with your resume or LinkedIn profile and include:
   

  

 • Links to browser games, interactive products, developer tools, or generation systems you have built.
   

 • A short description of the most relevant game architecture or automation pipeline you owned.
   

 • An example of how you tested game logic or evaluated generated software or content at scale.
   

  

 Code samples, playable demos, technical write\-ups, and architecture diagrams are welcome. Please explain how you would use AI\-powered agents and automated QC to generate and validate many games without manually reviewing every output.

* Comfortable speaking with candidates over the phone.
* Basic knowledge of MS Excel and MS Word.
* Good organizational and documentation skills.
* Ability to handle multiple tasks and maintain proper records.

**Qualification**

* Pursuing or recently completed **BBA / MBA (HR) / PGDM (HR) / B.Com** or a related field.

**Working Details**

**Internship Duration:** 3–6 months with full time opportunity

**Work Location \& Travel Requirement**

* **Primary Location:** Janakpuri, New Delhi.

title: Talent Acquisition Intern
description:
**Company:** 
  Scale 100X.ai by Expertrons
 



**Location:** 
  Andheri East
 



**Internship Tenure** 
 : (6\-Month Internship \+ PPO Guaranteed on Performance)
 



**Stipend:** 
 Upto Rs.10,000
 



**Designation:** 
 Talent Acquisition Intern
 



  





**About the Opportunity** 




  





 This internship is a
 **career\-launchpad** 
 for individuals who want to build a strong foundation in Talent Acquisition. You will gain end\-to\-end exposure to sourcing, screening, interviewing, coordination, and hiring strategy while working closely with senior HR leaders.
 



  





 We are looking for
 **highly motivated MBA freshers and fresh graduates** 
 who wish to kickstart their career in the Talent Acquisition domain with structured learning, strong mentorship, and a clear path toward career advancement.
 



  





 After
 **6 months, a Pre\-Placement Offer (PPO)** 
 will be extended based on
 **consistent performance, ownership, and onboarding numbers.** 




  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  





**1\. Talent Sourcing \& Pipeline Development** 



* Source talent through job portals, LinkedIn, referrals \& internal databases
* Build a strong, high\-quality candidate pipeline across multiple functions, with a special focus on Sales hiring



**Screening \& Shortlisting** 



* Review resumes and conduct initial telephonic screenings
* Evaluate candidates based on job criteria
* Follow up consistently to reduce drop\-offs and improve joining rates.



**Coordination \& Candidate Experience** 



* Schedule interviews with hiring managers
* Maintain professional, timely candidate communications



**Onboarding \& Documentation** 



* Coordinate offer rollouts \& joining formalities with HR Ops



**Internal Reporting** 



* Maintain accurate daily/weekly hiring trackers
* Share recruitment insights \& performance reports



**Ideal Candidate Profile** 



* MBA fresher or fresh graduate (any discipline; HR preferred)
* Passionate about Talent Acquisition and people engagement
* Excellent communication \& interpersonal skills
* Highly organized, proactive, self\-motivated, and eager to learn
* Ability to multitask and work in a fast\-paced environment
* Comfortable with Bring Your Own Device (BYOD) policy



**Why Join Us?** 



* Guaranteed PPO based on transparent performance metrics
* High learning exposure across the full recruitment cycle
* Opportunity to grow rapidly within the HR function
* Open, collaborative, and dynamic work culture
* Opportunities to transition into HR Ops, HRBP, or Strategic HR depending on your interest \& performance



**Your Growth Path:** 




  





 Your growth here is simple: the more smoothly you manage the hiring process and support successful onboardings, the faster you grow.
 


* **Weeks 1–2: Getting Started:** 
 You quickly settle into our processes, begin sourcing for active roles, and support candidates through the early stages of the funnel — contributing to onboarding readiness from the start.
* 
* **Months 1–2: Building Confidence:** 
 You start handling roles more independently, coordinating interviews, maintaining pipelines, and assisting candidates through to offer and joining.
* 
* **Months 3–4: Taking Steady Ownership:** 
 You manage multiple roles comfortably, maintain consistent communication with selected candidates, and help ensure smooth, timely onboardings.
* 
* **Months 5–6: Full Flow \& PPO Evaluation:** 
 You handle end\-to\-end hiring with confidence, support predictable onboarding cycles, and demonstrate consistency — leading to your performance\-based PPO.



 The PPO serves as a transition into a full\-time role where you continue to grow within Talent Acquisition or explore adjacent HR verticals, depending on your interest. The more value you add and the more dependable you become in the onboarding process, the stronger your PPO pathway becomes.
 



  





**Kickstart your Talent Acquisition career, make a real impact from day one, and secure your PPO by driving successful onboardings!** 




  





**Interested candidates can fill out the form below so that we can connect with you.** 




  





**About the company \-** 
**Scale100x.ai** 




  





 We are the world’s first AI\-powered growth accelerator helping consumer brands scale through partner\-led expansion. Founded by IIT Bombay alumni and serial entrepreneurs behind Expertrons, the team has built and exited ventures to public\-listed companies and scaled 300\+ franchise networks across sectors.
 



  





 We support high\-potential brands by building 100\+ outlets or partners annually, leveraging AI\-driven sales, marketing, and operational execution, driving profitability through data\-led processes, assisting with fundraising, investor relations, and IPO preparedness, and providing a proprietary AI\-based scalability score to guide long\-term growth.
 



  





 In the last year, we’ve driven growth across EV, F\&B, Retail, Salon, EdTech, Play Areas, and more — including enabling a partner brand to raise $5\.4M in Series A.
 



  





 We are now expanding our team to build the next generation of high\-growth consumer brands in India and globally. If you want to work at the intersection of AI, growth, franchising, and venture building, Scale100x.ai is the place to be.
 



  





 Founded by 
 **IIT Bombay alumni Vivek Gupta and Jatin Solanki** 
 , 100X Growth Partners brings together deep industry expertise and a successful track record of scaling brands across sectors. Our mission is simple yet impactful—to drive rapid and profitable growth through franchising. From developing customized franchise models to providing full\-spectrum support across marketing, recruitment, legal, and operational execution, we ensure our partners are set up for long\-term success.

title: Manager - HR & Admin
description:
We are looking for an experienced and proactive **HR \& Administration Manager** to oversee the organization’s human resources functions and administrative operations. The role will be responsible for recruitment, employee relations, performance management, HR policies, payroll coordination, compliance, office administration, and maintaining a productive and professional workplace.

The ideal candidate should have strong people\-management skills, sound knowledge of HR practices and employment regulations, excellent communication abilities, and the ability to manage multiple responsibilities efficiently.

Key ResponsibilitiesHuman Resources

* Manage the complete employee lifecycle, including recruitment, onboarding, transfers, promotions, and separation.
* Develop job descriptions and coordinate recruitment and selection processes.
* Maintain accurate and confidential employee records and HR documentation.
* Manage attendance, leave, employee benefits, and HR\-related records.
* Coordinate payroll processing with the finance/payroll team.
* Develop and implement HR policies, procedures, and employee guidelines.
* Handle employee grievances, disciplinary matters, and workplace issues professionally.
* Support performance appraisal and employee development programs.
* Identify training and development needs and coordinate appropriate programs.
* Promote employee engagement, motivation, and a positive workplace culture.
* Ensure compliance with applicable labor laws, statutory requirements, and company policies.

Administration

* Oversee day\-to\-day office and administrative operations.
* Manage office facilities, housekeeping, security, transportation, and other support services.
* Coordinate procurement of office supplies, equipment, and other administrative requirements.
* Manage relationships with vendors, service providers, and contractors.

* Build, document, and continuously review and improve HR policies, SOPs, onboarding processes, and employee handbooks.
* Standardize HR workflows across departments to ensure consistency and operational efficiency.
* Recommend process improvements that increase transparency, accountability, and productivity.
* Ensure all HR documentation and organizational records are accurate and up to date.



**AI, Automation \& HR Technology** 



* Identify opportunities to automate repetitive HR tasks using AI and digital tools.
* Utilize ATS platforms, AI sourcing tools, AI screening tools, and workflow automation to improve recruitment efficiency.
* Leverage AI for job descriptions, candidate sourcing, interview coordination, HR documentation, reporting, and internal communication.
* Continuously evaluate emerging HR technologies that improve hiring speed, candidate experience, and operational excellence.



**Leadership Partnership** 



* Act as a trusted HR partner for department heads.
* Support leadership in manpower planning, organizational restructuring, and resource allocation.
* Present hiring insights, workforce analytics, and HR recommendations to management.
* Contribute towards building a scalable HR function aligned with Cocoma's long\-term growth plans.



  





**REQUIRED SKILLS \& QUALIFICATIONS** 



* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or a related field.
* 3–6 years of experience in HR, Talent Acquisition, or HR Operations.
* Experience hiring for Social Media, Creative Agencies, Media, Technology, Production, or Startup environments is highly preferred.

* Excellent communication, negotiation, stakeholder management, and interpersonal skills.

title: HR Manager – Talent Acquisition, HR Ops & Facility Management
description:
Rakhis Fashions is a well established, integrated apparel company spanning garment design, manufacturing, and export. Operating across both
 **D2C (E\-commerce/Retail)** 
 and
 **B2B (Wholesale/Corporate/Exports)** 
 channels, we combine creative innovation with robust supply chain execution to deliver high\-quality apparel nationwide and globally.
 



  




**Role Overview** 

 We are looking for a versatile, proactive
 **HR Manager** 
 to take end\-to\-end ownership of our Human Resources, Talent Acquisition, General Administration, and Facility Management functions.
 



 The ideal candidate brings a blend of
 **Non\-IT** 
 (manufacturing, pattern masters, merchandisers, retail sales) and
 **IT/E\-commerce hiring** 
 experience, alongside strong operational grit to manage facility upkeep, office administration, and employee life\-cycle governance.
 



  




**Key Responsibilities** 

  




**1\. Talent Acquisition \& Workforce Planning (IT \& Non\-IT)** 
* **Non\-IT Hiring:** 
 Source and recruit specialized apparel talent—Fashion Designers, Pattern Masters, Merchandisers, Sourcing Specialists, Quality Controllers, and Factory/Production staff.
* **IT \& Digital Hiring:** 
 Recruit for modern D2C and corporate roles—E\-commerce Specialists, Digital Marketing Executives, Software developers, and Analytics professionals.
* Manage end\-to\-end recruitment pipelines: candidate sourcing, screening, scheduling, interviewing, negotiation, and onboarding.


**2\. HR Operations, Policy \& Employee Lifecycle** 
* Manage full employee lifecycle execution: Onboarding, induction, performance management, engagement, confirmation, and offboarding.
* Enforce company HR policies, code of conduct, leave management, and attendance systems across corporate and production environments.
* Drive smooth
 **exit management** 
 , including notice period adherence, clear handover documentation, and Full \& Final (F\&F) settlements.
* Handle workplace grievance redressal, employee relations, and foster a positive workplace culture.


**3\. Office Administration \& Facility Management** 
* Oversee daily facility operations across office and factory/workshop premises to ensure a safe, organized, and functional environment.
* Manage administrative vendors, security personnel, housekeeping, cafeteria/pantry services, and utility maintenance.
* Maintain office infrastructure, IT assets, workstation allocations, and facility repairs.
* Oversee administrative procurement, vendor contracts, inventory of office supplies, and monthly admin bill clearances.


**Required Qualifications \& Key Skills** 
* **Education:** 
 Bachelor’s degree in HR, Business Administration, or related field (MBA/PGDM in HR preferred).
* **Experience:** 
 7 to 8 years of hands\-on HR experience. Prior exposure to the
 **Apparel, Garment Manufacturing, Fashion, or Retail sector** 
 is a strong advantage.
* **Recruitment Expertise:** 
 Demonstrated track record in sourcing both specialized Non\-IT manufacturing/design roles and modern IT/E\-commerce skill sets.
* **Operations \& Admin Skills:** 
 Strong organizational ability to manage facility vendors, asset inventory, and daily administrative needs simultaneously.
* **Communication \& Interpersonal Skills:** 
 Excellent written and verbal communication skills; capability to interact comfortably with floor staff, corporate teams, and senior leadership.Being Multi lingual is an added advantage withspoken Hindi a must.
* **Adaptability \& Drive:** 
 Ability to thrive in a fast\-moving, multi\-channel (D2C \+ B2B) business environment.


**Why Join Us?** 
* **Multifunctional Exposure:** 
 Play a central leadership role shaping people practices across creative design, manufacturing, and e\-commerce.
* **Growth Platform:** 
 Be an integral driver of our operational expansion as we scale our production and retail channels.
* **Competitive Compensation:** 
 Salary package commensurate with industry standards and candidate expertise.

 Build strong connect with sales team to effectively partner in building the right values\-based culture.
   

  

 Responsible for driving core HR processes efficiently and effectively with the sales team to create healthy work environment.
   

  

 Ensure capability building for the sales team as per development needs \& company priorities and create a performance\-oriented work culture
   

  

 Drive effective communication and engagement to ensure that the team is motivated to deliver.  Manage Employee related Headcount, tracking and expenses.
   

  

 Ensure Bench Planning and hiring of right talent to drive the sales agenda for the region
   

  

 Data collection, consolidating and analyzing to draw up regular reports to help drive relevant action.
   

  

 Provide effective HR/ personnel/ administrative support to the region sales team

 Core HR Processes: Ensure flawless execution of the following Core people processes
   

  

 Performance Management process –
   

  

* Objective Setting of the entire team are SMART \& in line with AOP, business \& people priorities.
* Midyear Review\- Ensure MYR is done between manager \& employee to provide directions on the progress
* Annual Appraisal\- Ensure PDRs are well written, onus for calibration of the region team and fitting the bell curve. Compilation of data to ensure high quality Calibration and pay for performance
* Focal Point Discussion\- Ensure this happens between manager, employee \& HR and employee is provided feedback with relevant data and developmental inputs.


 Management Connect Survey – Ensure participation by providing correct data and effective administration and follow\-up with sales team. Work closely with the managers to share scores \& drive action planning.
   

  

 Org. Health survey – Ascertain employee participation by ensuring accuracy in data and effective administration and follow\-up with sales team. Work closely with the managers to bring out insights, create \& drive action planning.
   

  

 People Planning process – Coach the team and build CDAPs for the region team. Support the RM in building people plan for the region team and ensure that the movements are in line with the people planning process. Implement the development action plan in line with employees CDAP.
   

  

 PMP Survey – Ensure participation of the region team and take corrective action as per employee feedback.
   

  

 Staffing
   

  

* Responsible for recruitment in the Region – Channel Wise (Traditional Trade, Modern Trade, Wholesale, Up Country) supporting region business plan in each of the channel up to L05 in the region. (Sales Trainee to Area Sales Manager)
* Own the staffing and recruitment process from end to end (manpower planning, sourcing, joining \-\-\> on Boarding) for upto L05 level. Support the induction for L6\+ population for the region.

* Ensure minimal man\-day loss on account of employee exit and replacement, quick turnaround.
* Bring in diversity of talent in the team by hiring diverse workforce from different facets.
* Ensure that the Exit interview is done and analysis of same is fed back to the relevant process/ system.


 Employee Engagement \& Culture Building
   

  

* Be an employee champion \- Reach out to the frontline to ensure good connect and resolve frontline issues in minimum time.
* Own the R\&R for the region – ROH as per plan, Area Manager of the month, Customer Executive of the month, family day, creating excitement by creating/rolling out appropriate regional contests (rollout of national contests as per BU plan)
* Partner with the RM to nominate the high performing sales employees for regional/national/international ROH
* Own up the engagement agenda for the region as per the agreed plan and ensure high employee involvement.
* Set up appropriate two way communication channel with the frontline.
* Ensure that all relevant HR processes are communicated to the frontline and build a strong PepsiCo Employer Proposition.
* Drive the organizational Values and Code of Conduct to the frontline through appropriate communication, highlighting deviation and being the role model themselves.


 Capability Building
   

  

 Drive organization capability agenda in partnership with RM \& BU HR \- Ensure employee development as per development needs highlighted thru Performance management process \& People planning. Follow 70:20:10 principle.
   

  

 Create Performance improvement plan with RM for the people in concern area.
   

  

 Implementation of change initiatives and supporting continuous improvement in sales function.
   

  

 Facilitate delivery of development and training activities for employees and monitor effectiveness for business results as per the requirement.
   

  

 Administration and MIS
   

  

* Generate, own and maintain various People Process reports/ records/ analysis and must Win Battles Report. Send the reports to HO as per timelines and as required and drive appropriate action plans in partnership with RM \& BUHR
* Ensure that relevant HR Admin support is provided to the employees in a timely manner
* Own up the Third Party Resources (TDO\- SPO, Admin resources): Process Ownership ( T\&E, Salary, Imprest, Grievance handling, complete control and processing)


**Skill/Attributes/Work Experience**
* Ability to anticipate, prioritize and Multitask
* Interpersonal relations – Collaboration and expectation management of the line
* Expert in productive communication – Be able to influence and impact without formal power
* Know the business – Good understanding of the sales levers
* Functional Excellence \- Good understanding of HR processes
* Process Orientation – Be able to maintain process integrity
* High Value Orientation with strong Drive and Execution orientation
* High Learning Agility \& high Customer Orientation

title: Manager HRBP
description:
**Job Purpose** 



* Partner with the Lead –HRBP on priorities pertaining to employee relations, talent management, employee engagement, and change management
* Enhancing employee engagement and facilitating the implementation of HR policies that contribute to the efficient and effective functioning of business supported. By focusing on talent management, performance optimization, and employee satisfaction.



**Key Accountabilities** 




**Business Partnering** 



* Collaborate with the Lead– HRBP to execute strategic plans for effective internal stakeholder communications, engagement initiatives, and project strategies aligned with the company's vision and goals.
* Execute strategic plans for talent acquisition, retention, and development specific to the business supported to ensure alignment with organizational objectives.
* Work closely with the business teams to understand their business needs and provide HR solutions that support operational efficiency and effectiveness.
* Execution of HR strategies and tactics for the business supported, using data analytics to maximize workforce productivity and achieve budget targets.
* Implement workforce planning strategies to address current and future talent needs in the business supported.



**Employee Relations and Engagement:** 



* Foster a positive employee relations environment within the business supported, assisting resolution of employee concerns, conflicts, and grievances.
* Develop and implement employee engagement initiatives to enhance the overall employee experience.



  





**Talent Management** 



* Collaborate with Lead\- HRBP to identify key talents, high\-potential employees, and succession planning strategies.
* Implement talent development programs to ensure a continuous pipeline of skilled and engaged employees in the business supported.



  





**Compliance and Policy Adherence:** 



* Ensure compliance with HR policies, procedures, and legal requirements within the business.
* Provide guidance to business leaders on HR\-related compliance matters and best practices.



**Employee Engagement Initiatives:** 



* Assist in driving engagement strategies and initiatives, supporting culture building within the business unit.
* Collaborate with managers to create a positive work environment where employees feel valued, supported, and motivated.



**HR Service Delivery:** 



* Coordinate with local HR service delivery to ensure compliance, risk mitigation, and operational efficiency within the business unit.
* Facilitate HR communications and provide support for escalated employee inquiries, offering feedback on HR policies, processes, and programs to enhance overall effectiveness.



**Performance Management:** 



* Assist in driving the Performance Management System (PMS) processes, ensuring adherence to timelines and handling grievances related to performance ratings.



**Learning and Development:** 



* Collaborate with Learning \& Development Teams to communicate business\-specific training requirements and support people development across functions.



**Change Management:** 



* Support organizational change initiatives, providing guidance and support to employees during transitions.
* Assist in implementing restructuring plans as needed to optimize organizational efficiency and effectiveness.

* Masters/MBA/PGDM/PGP/PG degree/diploma in Personnel/Human Resource Management



  




* 5\-7 years of experience in talent management, employee relations, performance management, and workforce planning.



  




* 7\+ years of experience in HR, with a substantial portion of that experience in HR Business Partnering.
* Experience in the aviation sector is an added advantage

title: Deputy Manager - Human Resource
description:
**Job Description**
**Your Responsibilities**
 The Deputy Manager – Human Resources is a critical HR role responsible for end\-to\-end HR operations, statutory compliance, and industrial relations across the Tarapur HN Plant, Mumbai office, and field associates supporting HN \& AN businesses. Reporting to the General Manager – HR, the role requires an experienced HR professional (8–10 years) with strong expertise in managing multi\-location compliance frameworks, complex labour environments, and unionized workforces.
   

  

 In addition to plant HR responsibilities, the role will also lead and support key India HR initiatives such as Rewards \& Recognition, Group Insurance (Medical, Accident, Term Life), and other country\-level people programs.
   

  

 The role demands high ownership, strong execution, and the ability to independently manage compliance, employee relations, and workforce dynamics while ensuring alignment with ADM’s standards and business prioritie
 **Your Profile**
- HR Operations \& Employee Lifecycle Management

- Oversee end\-to\-end HR operations at the plant.

- Maintain accurate employee records and digital HR database.

- Provide timely inputs for payroll processing and ensure data accuracy.

- Contractor Labour Management including compliances

- Manpower planning, assist in recruitment process.

- Statutory Compliance \& Industrial Relations

- Owner for all HR \& legal compliances/returns. Fulfill the statutory compliances on timely basis with respect to PF, ESIC, Bonus, Gratuity, MLWF etc

- Employee and industrial relations, handling union matters

- Maintain compliance documentation for audits and government inspections.

- Handle disciplinary procedures end\-to\-end as per legal requirements.

- Liaise with government authorities and regulatory bodies on HR\-related matters.

- Address employee grievances promptly and fairly to maintain industrial harmony.

- Handling/assistance in the matter related to legal and court cases in labour related matters

- Ensure employee communication and engagement in the Marathi language.

- Employee Engagement, Welfare \& CSR

- Support implementation of employee engagement initiatives and cultural programs at the plant.

- Drive ADM Cares / CSR projects in coordination with local teams.

- Facilitate employee welfare schemes such as Mediclaim, PF, and ESIC benefits.

- Learning \& Development

- Implement training programs as per the ADM training calendar.

- Maintain training records and ensure compliance with learning requirements.

- Policy Implementation \& Country HR Initiatives

- Ensure effective implementation and awareness of corporate HR policies across the plant.

- Lead and support country HR initiatives –

* R\&R policy and quarterly roll out
* Group Medical, Accident \& Term Life policies and related maintainence,
* SuccessFactors data administration,
* POSH compliance.
* Participate in broader HR projects to build capability and exposure across the HR function.
* MBA in Human Resources from a recognized university.
* 8–10 years of progressive HR experience in medium to large manufacturing environments, including exposure to field sales teams.
* Strong understanding of Indian labor laws, statutory compliance, and industrial relations practices.
* Proven experience in managing payroll inputs, attendance systems, disciplinary procedures, and third\-party workforce administration.
* Demonstrated ability to build effective relationships with employees, union representatives, and government authorities.
* Fluent in Marathi, English and Hindi, both written and spoken with the ability to communicate effectively across all workforce levels.
* Hands\-on, detail\-oriented, and capable of independently managing plant HR operations with a focus on compliance, engagement, and continuous improvement
